jobs.title: Director, Solutions Consultant
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.summary: VTS is seeking a Director, Solutions Consultant, to assist and translate new business opportunities into a successful deployment plan across VTS — the platform that extends VTS int…
jobs.description:
VTS is seeking a Director, Solutions Consultant, to assist and translate new business opportunities into a successful deployment plan across VTS — the platform that extends VTS into asset management and leasing.

This role sits at the intersection of sales, solution design, and implementation readiness. Once an opportunity is qualified, the Solutions Consultant becomes the solutions expert alongside the Account Executive — translating a customer’s needs into a tailored solution and, once the deal is won, into a complete solution design and implementation plan that hands off cleanly to the Implementation team. You will work predominantly through our major channel partners to start, expanding to the direct channel and other commercial clients over time, and partner closely with our sales, product, and account management teams.

Unlike a traditional pre-sales engineer focused only on the demonstration, or an implementation manager focused only on delivery, this position helps manage the full arc of solution implementation preparedness — from qualified opportunity, through solution design, to a clean handoff to implementation, with continued check-ins through launch.

This is a highly visible, senior individual-contributor role based in our New York office.

** Please note that this opportunity is located in New York, NY, and requires this hire to work from our office 4 days a week. **

What You'll Do

- Partner with the Account Executive as the solutions expert for complex and strategic deals, acting as the subject matter expert and partnering with customers to drive maximum value from our products

- Develop expert-level command of the feature set and tailor product messaging and demonstrations to each customer’s workflows and goals

- Solution discovery: take ambiguous, complex requirements, define them with customers and stakeholders, and shape them into a clear, cohesive solution

- Support our Account Executives with business and technical requirements, solution positioning, scoping, and alignment

- Aggregate everything learned during the sale into a single solution design — requirements, the technologies and features being deployed, and the rollout schedule — documented in the deal journal

- Produce a complete, unambiguous handoff package so the Implementation team can execute without rework

- Review the plan with Implementation at kickoff and stay engaged through deployment with defined check-in points to keep projects on track

- Collaborate day-to-day with Sales, Product, QA — primarily in Salesforce, with exposure to tools such as Jira and Airtable

- Serve as a trusted advisor to customers and internal stakeholders, and evangelize the vision across the commercial real estate ecosystem

What We're Looking For

- 3–5+ years in a pre-sales or solutioning role — Solutions Consultant, Sales Engineer, Technical Account Manager, Pre-Sales Consultant, or a Customer Success Manager ready to move into pre-sales

- SaaS background required, with a proven track record of playing the solutions/pre-sales role well and telling a compelling product-to-value story (the industry it was in matters less than how well you did it)

- Exceptional client-facing and facilitation skills — personable, credible with executives, and able to command a room and drive a meeting

- Highly process and project management oriented, able to manage complex solution definition end-to-end and bring structure to ambiguity

- Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate technical capability into measurable business value

- Ability to ramp quickly on the platform

- Comfortable working in Salesforce; exposure to implementation or ticketing tools such as Jira or Airtable a plus

- Commercial real estate or proptech experience a plus

- New York–based, able to work from our office and travel up to ~25% (a few days per month for client meetings and QBRs)

What VTS Values & How We Show It

- Strive for Excellence - We know your potential is unlimited. Take advantage of our executive coaches and our training and career development programs available to all employees!

- Be Customer Obsessed - We’re employee obsessed too! VTS offers competitive compensation, comprehensive health benefits (including dental and vision), pre-tax commuter benefits, and a 401(k) plan. Not to mention the fun stuff - quarterly happy hours, wellness events, clubs, and team lunches!

- Be Curious - Benefit from a culture that promotes new learning. VTS offers an education stipend to all employees!

- Move as One - We work in an open floor plan to promote cross-functional collaboration.

- Take Ownership - Be an owner of the company you’re building with our equity packages.

- Appreciate the Difference - VTS embraces and celebrates diversity. We understand the importance of a strong work-life balance. We offer a flexible PTO policy, generous family leave program, and more!

ABOUT VTS

VTS is the only AI-driven technology platform enabling intelligent real estate by unifying industry professionals, investors, and their customers at scale. In 2013, VTS revolutionized commercial real estate leasing operations with what is now VTS Lease. Today, VTS AI is the largest first-party insights and collaboration engine in the industry, transforming how strategic decisions are made and executed by the real estate industry globally.

With the VTS Platform, consisting of VTS Lease, VTS Market, VTS Activate, and VTS Data, every stakeholder in real estate is given real-time market information and workflow tools to do their job with unparalleled speed and intelligence. VTS is the global leader, with more than 60% of Class A office space in the U.S., and 13 billion square feet of office, residential, retail, and industrial space is managed through the platform worldwide. VTS is utilized by over 45,000 professionals and over 1.2 million total users each day, including industry-leading customers such as Blackstone, Brookfield Properties, LaSalle Investment Management, Hines, BXP, Oxford Properties, JLL, and CBRE.

VTS maintains offices in New York City, London, Toronto, Chicago.

To learn more about VTS and view our open roles, visit us at vts.com or follow us on Instagram (@WeAreVTS) or LinkedIn.

Pay Transparency

At VTS, we pride ourselves on articulating a clear and transparent philosophy around equitable, impartial compensation that will allow us to recruit and retain an exceptional team. The base salary is market-driven at the time of offer and is based on tier 1 market data. The salary for this role will range between $140,000 and $180,000 and is determined by several factors, including your skills, prior relevant experience, quality of interviews, leveling, and geography. There is a bonus structure for the position that will bring the OTE (on target earnings) to $200,000 - $240,000 depending on the base salary agreed upon and achievement to goals.

EEO Guidelines

VTS embraces diversity and equal opportunity in a serious way. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. For more information about what we collect and how we use it, please refer to the Candidate Privacy Statement.

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation at any time during the recruitment process, please let us know at ta@vts.com

jobs.description:
Alarm.com seeks a creative, analytical, and entrepreneurial Senior Digital Marketer to build and accelerate demand generation for Alarm.com’s Venture Business Units (VBUs) — a portfolio of independent, entrepreneurial companies in the Alarm.com family, each with its own brand, market, and customer base. In this startup-style environment, you’ll own programs to attract, engage, and convert qualified prospects into customers, combining creative brand building with data-driven lead generation.

You’ll partner with leadership, sales, and product teams to design and execute multi-channel programs that build pipeline, drive revenue, and scale efficiently.

This role is built for someone with several years of hands-on experience running and optimizing digital campaigns — enough reps to make informed recommendations about where our programs should go next, not just execute a plan handed to them. We're looking for someone naturally curious and analytical: you want to know what worked, what didn't, and why, and you use that answer to make the next campaign better.

Key Responsibilities:

- Campaign Management: Manage and optimize multi-channel campaigns across email, search, social media, and display media.

- Lead Generation: Create compelling web content, email copy, and content offers to generate qualified leads.

- Automation & Workflows: Implement and refine marketing automation and lead nurturing workflows.

- AI Enablement: Build AI-enabled workflows across creative production, audience targeting, reporting, and campaign optimization — increasing iteration velocity and output volume while maintaining brand quality and human review.

- SEO/GEO/AEO Optimization: Contribute to organic search and AI-answer visibility — including keyword strategy, on-page optimization, technical hygiene, and content recommendations that surface the VBU brands.

- Sales Collaboration: Collaborate closely with sales to ensure marketing-to-sales lead handoff is seamless and tracked.

- Performance Analysis: Track and report on marketing performance metrics, using data to drive continuous improvement.

- Innovation: Identify, test, and implement new digital and demand generation tactics to reach untapped audiences and ensure strategies remain current and effective.

Qualifications:

- 5+ years of hands-on digital and/or growth marketing experience — personally running and optimizing live campaigns, not directing others who do.

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.

- Hands-on fluency across paid search, paid social, email and ABM — including audience setup, budget pacing, and creative testing.

- Proven track record of creating multi-channel B2B campaigns that drive measurable results.

- Excellent analytical skills with the ability to translate data into clear reports and actionable insights — and to diagnose why performance moved, not just report that it did (Google Analytics, campaign dashboards, attribution tracking).

- Proficiency with marketing automation platforms (ideally Salesforce Marketing Cloud/Pardot).

- Excellent communication skills with the ability to align marketing to sales priorities.

- Experience with B2B marketing in SaaS or connected devices is a plus.

Personal Attributes:

- Startup mindset — creative, resourceful, comfortable with ambiguity.

- Strong sense of ownership and accountability.

- Collaborative, with the ability to work directly with leadership teams of independent venture units.

- Curious, with a growth mindset — always hunting for a better way to deliver results, and quick to fold what you learn back into the next test.

- Data-driven decision-making coupled with creative problem solving.

Typical projects will involve diverse technologies. You’ll have the opportunity to work across various technical areas using the latest technologies while using Agile development methods. Join Orchard Brokerage and grow your business with the team that’s redefining the real estate experience. You’ll get high-quality seller appointments, access to unique client products to help you close, and the support you need for you and your clients to thrive.

- No up front brokerage fees - we don’t earn until you do

- Earn equity for your performance with Orchard stock options

Lead Generation & Marketing Support

- Access to our Orchard Max program, where you can take advantage of scheduled appointments with highly motivated home sellers - no cold calls, and higher splits the more you close

- Free social media custom ad campaigns, and heavily discounted Zillow Showcase listings

- AI assisted nurture program to stay top of mind with your customer base

- A platform designed to help you win more business

- Orchard Move First: Buy your next home before you sell, skip the showings, and become a non-contingent buyer

- Orchard Concierge: Make price-boosting repairs and upgrades at no upfront cost

- Orchard Cash Offer + Upside: sell quickly for a cash offer and get the upside when your home sells on the market.

- Access to 500+ private investors through Orchard’s Cash Offer Marketplace

- Fast Track Offers: Hybrid on-market listing program designed to sell homes quickly at full market value through maximum exposure

- Proprietary and proven pricing tools

Coaching & Transaction Support

- Hands-on coaching and mentorship from master trainers and a local Market Manager

- Free transaction coordination on every deal

Mortgage & Title Benefits

- No cost rate buy downs/incentives with Orchard Mortgage, and Instant commission payments through Orchard Title

Community & Culture

- Strong agent community and culture and a consumer brand centered around delivering great customer experience

Compensation Range: This is a commission-only position. The average full-time real estate agent earns $75,000-200,000+ per year. There is no cap on earnings.

We’d Love to Hear From You if You Have

- Residential real estate transaction experience with at least 4+ closed transactions in the last twelve months

- An active and unrestricted NC real estate license and are located in the Greater Charlotte area

- Strong sales skills including the ability to handle objections effectively, build rapport quickly, and align on expectations with customers

- An analytical mindset and ability to hold yourself accountable to hitting metrics in your business

- Passion for delivering an outstanding customer experience and the adaptability to help customers on their schedule

- An ability to use technology effectively in your business and learn new systems quickly

- Strong communication skills to engage with customers and colleagues - both written and oral

- A drive for results balanced with strong collaboration skills and humility

In addition to managing marketing programs, this role will provide hands-on support for ongoing website management in WordPress, helping ensure our website content, campaign landing pages, and digital experiences remain current, accurate, and aligned with marketing initiatives.

jobs.title: Principal AI-Native Software Engineer
jobs.summary: Our Mission ButterflyMX is on a mission to empower people to open and manage doors & gates from a smartphone.
jobs.description:
Our Mission
ButterflyMX is on a mission to empower people to open and manage doors & gates from a smartphone. Our products are installed in more than 20,000+ multifamily, commercial, gated communities, and student-housing properties worldwide, including properties developed, owned, and managed by the most trusted names in real estate. Our features are designed for developers, owners, property managers, and tenants and our products lower operating costs and improve tenant satisfaction.

Our Solution
Developers and owners no longer need to run building wiring or install in-unit hardware. Property managers can grant building access, revoke permissions, and review entry logs from an online dashboard. Residents can open doors from their smartphones, issue visitor access, and see who is trying to enter the building.

Our Culture & Values
Fantastic people are the key to our success. As a distributed, primarily remote workforce, we’re looking for more intelligent, passionate, collaborative, ai-forward, and down-to-earth individuals to join our growing team. We’re driven by a shared commitment to excellence and innovation, grounded in our core values: We delight our customers, We take ownership, We are a community of collaborators, We speak up, We think big and do small, and We are tenacious.

Role Overview
We are looking for an exceptional Principal or Staff-level engineer who has fundamentally changed how they build software because of AI. This is not a traditional software engineering role with an AI assistant bolted on. We want someone who uses AI agents, especially Claude Code, to independently take well-defined product initiatives from business requirements to secure, tested, production-ready software.

The ideal candidate is an excellent backend engineer first, grounded in our stack: TypeScript services, MongoDB and relational data, and cloud infrastructure across AWS and GCP. AI dramatically increases your output, but your engineering judgment is what makes that output valuable.

In this role, you will work closely with our Product and Design teams. You will operate with unusually broad engineering ownership. You may clarify requirements with Product, develop the technical specification, work through implementation details with Design, coordinate multiple coding agents, review their work, deploy the application, manage its infrastructure, and continue improving the product after launch.

The ideal candidate is already working this way. You routinely operate several Claude Code sessions or agents in parallel. You know how to divide work across agents, provide them with the right context, establish effective feedback loops, and keep multiple workstreams moving without losing control of quality or architecture.

You believe manually writing code should become a relatively rare part of software development. But you are not impressed by code merely because an AI generated it. You recognize over-engineered "AI slop," unnecessary abstractions, sprawling diffs, weak tests, insecure implementations, and solutions that are technically functional but fundamentally poor.

Responsibilities
Partner with Product and Design
- Work closely with Product to understand business requirements, intended user outcomes, priorities, constraints, and acceptance criteria.

- Translate Product's business requirements into clear technical requirements, implementation plans, system behaviors, and engineering tasks.

- Identify technical ambiguities, dependencies, risks, edge cases, and tradeoffs that must be resolved before or during implementation.

- Ask the questions necessary to ensure the engineering solution addresses the actual product need.

- Partner with Design to understand intended user workflows and translate designs into complete, functional product experiences.

- Provide Product and Design with clear feedback when requirements or designs introduce unnecessary complexity, technical risk, security concerns, or operational challenges.

- Preserve the intent of the product requirements while making sound technical and implementation decisions.

- Communicate progress, tradeoffs, risks, and changes in scope clearly throughout development.

Build and Own Products End to End
- Take approved product initiatives from business requirements through technical design, implementation, deployment, and ongoing operation.

- Manage several products or major engineering initiatives with limited day-to-day oversight.

- Develop complete technical requirements from the business and product requirements supplied by Product.

- Make thoughtful architectural, implementation, security, infrastructure, and operational tradeoffs within an established platform direction.

- Design, build, and maintain efficient, reusable, reliable, and testable code; identify bottlenecks and bugs, devise solutions, and propose optimizations.

- Deliver working software quickly while maintaining high standards for reliability, maintainability, security, and user experience.

- Own the technical execution of a product rather than waiting for every implementation detail to be specified.

- Continue improving products after launch based on feedback, usage, defects, and changing requirements.

Operate an AI-Native Development Environment
- Use Claude Code as a primary development environment and orchestration layer.

- Run multiple agents, sub-agents, worktrees, branches, or development sessions in parallel.

- Decompose technical requirements into work that can be executed safely and effectively by different agents.

- Design reusable Claude Code skills, commands, hooks, context files, agent instructions, and development workflows.

- Provide agents with the technical requirements, architectural context, constraints, designs, examples, and verification methods necessary to produce high-quality work.

- Build feedback loops in which agents review, test, critique, and improve one another's output.

- Use agents to investigate unfamiliar systems, understand legacy code, create implementation plans, write code, generate tests, review changes, prepare pull requests, and assist with releases.

- Continuously improve the systems, instructions, and tooling that make your own AI-assisted development more reliable and scalable.

Automate the Product Development Lifecycle
- Help automate the engineering portions of the product development lifecycle, including:

- Translating business requirements into technical requirements

- Technical discovery and architecture

- Implementation planning

- Design and UX implementation

- Software development

- Automated testing

- Security analysis

- Code review

- Pull-request creation and iteration

- Infrastructure provisioning

- Deployment

- Monitoring and operational support

- Documentation and maintenance

- Create workflows in which agents can execute substantial portions of the development lifecycle while preserving appropriate human judgment and control.

- Establish clear quality gates so that agent-generated work is verified rather than accepted on faith.

- Develop methods for measuring the effectiveness, quality, cost, and speed of AI-native engineering workflows.

- Reduce the manual coordination and repetitive work required to move from an approved product requirement to deployed software.

Maintain Exceptional Engineering Quality
- Review agent-generated code with the judgment expected of a Principal or Staff engineer.

- Reject unnecessary complexity, excessive abstraction, inappropriate frameworks, duplicated logic, and changes that are much larger than the problem requires.

- Prefer focused, understandable solutions: for example, an eight-file targeted change rather than an eighty-file rewrite when both accomplish the same result.

- Ensure software is appropriately tested, observable, secure, maintainable, and production-ready.

- Understand how systems work beneath the abstraction layer rather than treating AI output as a black box.

- Debug complex issues across application code, infrastructure, data systems, third-party services, and development tooling.

- Know when the AI is wrong, when its proposed approach is risky, and when direct engineering intervention is necessary.

jobs.summary: In Person in New York City, NY About Us Obligo is a fast-growing FinTech / Real Estate Tech startup on a mission to build trust between renters and landlords worldwide.
jobs.description:
In Person in New York City, NY

About Us

Obligo is a fast-growing FinTech / Real Estate Tech startup on a mission to build trust between renters and landlords worldwide. By leveraging open banking, data, and AI, Obligo eliminates traditional security deposits and replaces them with a fair, flexible, and transparent renter experience while streamlining operations and reducing risk for property managers.

At Obligo, we believe that clear communication, thoughtful user experience, and trust-building design are just as important as strong risk models and technical execution. We build financial products that people can understand, trust, and feel confident using.

The Role

As Head of Collections, you'll lead Obligo's collections function, combining hands-on collections expertise, people leadership, data, and technology to improve recovery performance while delivering a thoughtful renter experience.

About the Position

We are looking for an experienced, analytical, and hands-on collections leader to own and continuously improve Obligo's collections operation. You will manage a team of four collectors as well as external first- and third-party collection resources and AI agents, while serving as Obligo's internal collections subject matter expert.

This role combines day-to-day leadership with strategy and execution. You'll coach the team, handle complex escalations, track and improve performance, develop new collection strategies, and lead projects that make the organization more effective and scalable.

Working in a hybrid model from our NYC office in Union Square two days per week, you'll collaborate closely with Risk, Customer Support, Legal, Product, Data, and other teams across Obligo.

Responsibilities

- Lead, coach, and develop Obligo's internal collections team, setting clear goals and driving individual and team performance.

- Own Obligo's collections strategy, including account segmentation, prioritization, outreach, negotiation, escalation, and resolution strategies. Lead projects and experiments to improve recovery rates, operational efficiency, renter experience, and team productivity.

- Help design and implement the use of AI agents, automation, and other technologies across the collections lifecycle. Develop and maintain collections playbooks, workflows, scripts, training, QA standards, and operating procedures.

- Use data to understand renter behavior, evaluate collection strategies and team performance, and identify opportunities for improvement. Identify recurring issues and emerging trends from collections activity and translate them into broader product, policy, or operational improvements.

- Serve as Obligo's collections subject matter expert and personally handle Tier-3, sensitive, unusual, and high-value collection cases when needed.

- Manage the performance of external first-party and third-party collection partners and determine how work should be allocated across internal, external, and automated resources.

- Partner closely with Support, Risk, Legal, Product, Data, Finance, and Operations on complex cases, new initiatives, product improvements, and collections policies.

Requirements

- 5+ years of relevant experience in collections, customer operations, or a similar operational environment, including 3+ years managing a team.

- Strong track record of data-led performance management—setting targets, identifying performance gaps and root causes, and turning insights into coaching and action.

- Strong analytical skills and comfort working hands-on with dashboards, spreadsheets, BI tools, and operational data to make decisions and measure results.

- Demonstrated ability to improve processes and team productivity, from identifying opportunities through implementation and measurement.

- Experienced people manager who can set clear expectations, coach and develop employees, and address underperformance.

- Meaningful collections expertise, including collection strategy, negotiation, escalations, and customer communication.

- Self-motivated and adaptable, with strong judgment and the ability to lead and execute in a fast-moving startup environment.

Nice to Have: Experience in fintech or consumer finance; managing outsourced collection partners; implementing AI or automation in operations; SQL or hands-on BI experience.

Benefits and Perks

- Competitive base salary and bonus structure

- Stock options

- Multiple health, dental, and vision plans starting day one

- Remote office expense reimbursement

- Generous PTO and holiday schedule

- Commuter benefits

- Life insurance

- Quarterly team kickoffs and regular team outings

- Amazing offices in NYC and Tel Aviv

- A chance to work with incredibly bright, creative, talented, and passionate teammates

Salary Range: 140 - 160

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, Settlement & Notary
jobs.summary: The U.S. mortgage market is a $14 trillion pillar of the economy — and much of it still runs on fax machines, overnight shipping, and manual workflows. Snapdocs is changing that.
jobs.description:
The U.S. mortgage market is a $14 trillion pillar of the economy — and much of it still runs on fax machines, overnight shipping, and manual workflows. Snapdocs is changing that. Our platform currently powers 20% of all real estate closings in the country, and we’re just getting started.
We design workflow software and AI-driven automation that connects lenders, settlement teams, notaries, and investors — eliminating friction, reducing risk, and delivering a faster, simpler closing for every borrower. Our customers range from the largest mortgage lenders to independent title companies. They trust us because we solve real operational pain with empathy, rigor, and reliability.
We’re backed by Sequoia, Y Combinator, and F-Prime, and we’re building for the long term.
The opportunity
More than one billion notarizations take place in the United States each year, supporting consequential transactions across real estate, financial services, legal services, automotive, wealth management, and other regulated industries. Yet much of the work required to schedule signings, find qualified notaries, manage documents, communicate with participants, and resolve exceptions still happens through phone calls, email, and disconnected systems.

Snapdocs provides trusted infrastructure for high-stakes transactions—transactions where the parties may not know or trust one another, mistakes carry real consequences, and the resulting records must withstand legal, regulatory, investor, and customer scrutiny. We earned our credibility by modernizing residential mortgage closings at scale, and became the market leader. Now, we’re taking on the broader notarization market, with a vision to make Snapdocs the trusted platform for every high-stakes notarization—across industries, wherever and however it happens.

Customer Success is central to realizing this opportunity. This role will help customers redesign operational workflows, adopt new in-person and remote notarization capabilities, and demonstrate measurable business value. The Customer Success Manager will also translate customer needs and early market learnings into product, operational, and go-to-market decisions as Snapdocs expands into new industries and use cases.

What you'll do
- Own the customer relationship and commercial outcome. Serve as the accountable post-sale owner for a portfolio of Notary Connect and Snapdocs RON customers, with responsibility for customer health, value realization, retention, growth, and relationship continuity.

- Develop the account strategy. Build a deep understanding of each customer’s business, operating model, notarization workflows, stakeholders, goals, and growth plans. Maintain account success plans in Salesforce that document customer objectives, stakeholder coverage, milestones, adoption gaps, risks, renewal strategy, expansion opportunities, and forecasts.

- Drive measurable value realization. Establish customer baselines, target outcomes, and success measures such as hard-cost savings, time-to-value, signing volume, utilization, service quality, exception handling, and participant experience. Quantify realized value and build the business case for continued and broader adoption.

- Build executive alignment and customer champions. Develop durable, multi-threaded relationships with executives, operational leaders, administrators, schedulers, and end users. Build champions and align decision-makers across operations, technology, finance, legal, compliance, and executive leadership.

- Lead the customer operating cadence. Run operating reviews, executive business reviews, strategic planning sessions, and escalation communications that connect product usage and service performance to realized value, customer priorities, risks, and agreed next steps.

- Accelerate adoption and utilization. Lead the post-launch customer journey in partnership with Implementation, including pilots, rollout planning, training, change management, release readiness, and ongoing optimization. Design and execute plays that close adoption and utilization gaps, introduce new capabilities, and increase customer value.

- Provide product and workflow guidance. Demonstrate Notary Connect and Snapdocs RON, answer customer questions, recommend workflow best practices, and bring in the appropriate internal expert when deeper product, technical, operational, legal, or compliance expertise is required.

- Own renewals and expansion. Lead renewal and expansion opportunities from strategy through close. Identify and qualify opportunities across business units, locations, transaction volume, signing types, mobile and remote workflows, service models, and integrations. Build the value case, develop the commercial offer, negotiate terms and tradeoffs within approved guardrails, align the customer’s buying group, and maintain accurate forecasts. Partner with Sales and Solutions Consulting when additional commercial or technical support is needed.

- Own service delivery and escalations. Coordinate across Operations, the notary network, Implementation, Support, Product, Engineering, and Accounting to keep customer commitments on track. Own escalations through resolution, communicate clearly with stakeholders, and address underlying issues—not only immediate symptoms.

- Turn customer insight into organizational advantage. Synthesize recurring customer feedback, market patterns, and competitive signals into actionable input for Product, Operations, and go-to-market teams. Build reusable playbooks, customer stories, and operating practices that help Snapdocs scale successfully across new customers, verticals, and use cases.

What We’re Looking For

Required
- At least five years of experience in customer success, account management, strategic account management, or a related customer-facing role in a software or technology-enabled services business, including experience owning mid-market or enterprise customer relationships.

- Demonstrated ownership of commercial outcomes within an installed customer base, including renewals, expansion, and upsell. You have built value cases, developed commercial offers, navigated negotiations, influenced buying groups, maintained accurate forecasts, and advanced opportunities through close.

- A track record of driving customer adoption and measurable value in a business where transaction volume, product usage, utilization, or service performance affects the value delivered.

- Experience using customer, product, service, and financial data to identify risks and opportunities, quantify business value, and recommend actions.

- Strong executive communication and business acumen. You can understand a customer’s business, define what success looks like, and explain realized and potential value clearly to executive buyers and operational stakeholders.

- Experience developing relationships across complex customer organizations, including building champions and aligning stakeholders across operations, technology, finance, legal, compliance, and executive leadership.

- Experience leading customer enablement, workflow change, and adoption programs, including training, rollout planning, and ongoing optimization.

- Strong project and portfolio management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, coordinate cross-functional teams, and own customer commitments and escalations through resolution.

- The ability to learn a complex product and service model quickly, demonstrate it confidently, and explain it clearly to customers and internal teams.

- High agency and structured judgment. You take ownership in ambiguous situations, answer questions directly, use relevant evidence, and communicate complex ideas concisely.

Strongly Preferred
- Experience across both new-business sales and post-sale account ownership, ideally including experience as an Account Executive followed by a role in Customer Success or Account Management.

- Experience in fintech, mortgage technology, real estate, legal services, financial services, or another regulated and operationally complex industry.

- Experience with a marketplace, network, service-linked, transaction-based, consumption-based, or utilization-based business model.

- Experience helping customers move human-centered or manually coordinated services toward technology-enabled delivery.

- Experience with Salesforce or a similar customer and revenue platform, including maintaining account plans, customer health information, renewal and expansion opportunities, and forecasts.

AI fluency is a requirement
AI fluency is a standard for every hire at Snapdocs. For this role, that means using approved AI tools in repeatable workflows that improve account research, customer preparation, written communication, and follow-through while protecting customer data. Be ready to walk through a real workflow, what the tool did, what you checked, and where you made the final call.

Compensation & benefits
We believe in being upfront about pay.
- Base Salary: $107,000 - $145,000

This role is also eligible for a 30% variable component, bringing total on-target earnings to:
- OTE: $139,100 - $188,500

Where you land within the range depends on your experience, skills, and how you'll make an impact in the role. In addition to base salary and variable compensation, this position includes meaningful equity and a comprehensive benefits package.
Why Snapdocs
We’re here to transform one of the most critical and complex industries in the world. That requires a team that is curious, driven, thoughtful, and practical. We value:
- Product discipline and clear reasoning

- Deep ownership of outcomes (not just tasks)

- Straightforward, honest communication

- Empathy for the people who use our software

This is a place for people who want to solve hard, meaningful problems with real economic impact — not just ship features.

Join Us
We’re expanding our product suite and the network it connects. To do that, we need people who are excited by complexity, energized by scale, and motivated to make a tangible dent in how the mortgage ecosystem works. If you’re hungry to learn, build, and lead — you’ll do the best work of your career here.
To support our team, we offer a comprehensive & thoughtful benefits package for all full-time employees, which includes:
- Excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage

- 401(k) with up to 4% company match

- 16 weeks of paid parental leave

- Flexible Paid Vacation Time Off + 10 Sick Days for exempt roles

- Generous Accrued Paid Vacation Time Off + 10 sick days for non-exempt roles

- Summer & Winter Break (~1-week each) + 9 Holidays per year

- Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA

- HSA Employer Contribution ($75-150 for individuals, $150-$250 for families)

- $15K Family Building Benefit (lifetime limit)

- Life and Disability Insurance

- $1,500 Annual Lifestyle Stipend to support your well-being

Please note: Part-time employees are not eligible for benefits at this time
Snapdocs is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

Who We Are
Invitation Homes owns and operates homes in great neighborhoods across 16+ top U.S. markets. We continue to innovate with smart home technology, an industry-leading maintenance app, and other lifestyle-enhancing services that make leasing easier than owning.

The Role
The Regional Technology Analyst I provides hands-on technology support across an assigned geographic region containing multiple corporate, field, and operational locations. Although the position may have a designated home office, it is not assigned exclusively to that location. 
 
This position supports our West Coast but may assist other regions based on business priorities, projects, outages, or staffing needs. The Analyst serves as a regional connection between Desktop Support, Helpdesk, Infrastructure, Network, Security, Telecommunications, Technology Assets, and other technology teams. 
 
The position provides advanced endpoint support while assisting with infrastructure equipment, network connectivity, office technology, conference rooms, telecommunications, deployments, office openings, relocations, and enterprise technology initiatives. 
 
What you'll do day-to-day:

Regional Technology Support: 35%
- Provide remote and on-site support for offices across an assigned region, serving as the escalation point for issues the Service Desk cannot resolve remotely.
- Troubleshoot hardware, software, connectivity, authentication, and mobile-device issues, and guide Service Desk and Desktop Support staff.
- Identify recurring problems and work with technology teams, Facilities, Security, and regional business leaders on long-term fixes.
- Assist other regions during projects, outages, or staffing needs.
- Participate in after-hours support for planned maintenance, projects, and critical incidents when needed.

Infrastructure and Network Support: 25%
- Provide hands-on assistance to Infrastructure and Network teams, including installing, labeling, testing, and documenting equipment such as switches, wireless access points, servers, and cabling, following established procedures.
- Act as “remote hands” for centralized teams, including equipment checks, approved reboots, cable tracing, and hardware replacement.
- Help troubleshoot internet circuits and telecommunications with internal teams and service providers.
- Report physical or environmental concerns that could affect equipment, such as power, cooling, or water exposure.
- Support business-continuity and major-incident response when on-site help is needed.

Office Projects and Technology Deployments: 20%
- Support office openings, closures, relocations, remodels, and employee moves.
- Coordinate, install, and validate circuits, cabling, network hardware, workstations, printers, and conference-room technology.
- Test technology to confirm it is ready before employees move in.

Endpoint and Collaboration Technology: 15%
- Support Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, Microsoft 365, and approved business applications.
- Assist with device setup, deployment, replacement, recovery, and security compliance.
- Support conference rooms, audiovisual systems, printers, and related peripherals such as docking stations, monitors, headsets, and cameras.

Asset and Vendor Support: 5%
- Help manage technology assets across the region, including deployments, transfers, inventory, audits, and approved disposal.
- Coordinate on-site vendor visits and deliveries, verify their work meets organizational standards, and escalate concerns to leadership.

What You Bring
This role calls for advanced desktop and network/infrastructure support experience (macOS and multi-office support preferred), plus an associate degree or 3-4 years of equivalent experience, with certifications like CompTIA A+/Network+, Microsoft 365, ITIL, or Apple favored. It also requires regional travel, occasional after-hours work, the ability to lift up to 50 pounds and work in tight spaces like network closets, and the ability to manage competing priorities independently.

- Experience supporting multiple offices or geographically distributed business locations is preferred. 
- Experience providing advanced desktop support and assisting with infrastructure or network-related activities. 
- Experience supporting macOS devices is preferred. 

Education/Certifications:
- Associate degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field preferred. Three to four years of relevant professional experience may be considered in place of a degree.

- CompTIA A+, Network+,   
- Microsoft 365 or Endpoint Administrator certification

jobs.summary: Unlock the Power of You At Invitation Homes, our associates are the foundation of our success.
jobs.description:
Unlock the Power of You
At Invitation Homes, our associates are the foundation of our success. We connect your work to real impact, invest in your growth, and welcome you to feel at home — because care isn't just something we say, it's something you experience.

Invitation Homes owns and operates homes in great neighborhoods across 16 top U.S. markets. We continue to innovate with smart home technology, an industry-leading maintenance app, and other lifestyle-enhancing services that make leasing easier than owning.

Our market teams — Leasing, Property Management, and Rehab, Turns & Maintenance — work together to deliver excellent resident experiences and maintain high-quality homes. Every associate plays a meaningful role in that mission.

Invitation Homes does not offer employment-based visa sponsorship for this role at this time.

What you’ll do day-to-day
The Vice President, Data Science will lead Invitation Homes’ data science function—owning the strategy, technical direction, and hands-on development of the quantitative models and machine learning systems that drive decision-making across marketing, resident acquisition and retention, customer experience, pricing, and portfolio performance. This is a hands-on leadership role split roughly evenly across three areas: partnering with senior leaders on strategy and roadmap, coaching and developing the team, and personally building and validating models. You will set the vision and standards for the team while staying close enough to the technical work to frame problems, build models, and shepherd them into production.

You will partner closely with senior marketing, operations, and technology leaders to identify high-value opportunities, shape the analytics roadmap, and deliver scalable, reliable solutions that improve the speed, consistency, and quality of business decisions. You will lead a small, high-performing team of data scientists and machine learning engineers, dividing your time between coaching and developing talent and personally contributing to the most complex, highest-impact work.

The ideal candidate is a proven technical leader who combines deep data science and machine learning expertise with strong business judgment and communication skills—someone who can translate ambiguous business problems into data-driven decision systems, mentor a growing team, and turn technical excellence into measurable business value.

Data Science Strategy & Business Partnership
- Define and own the strategy and roadmap for Invitation Homes’ data science and machine learning capabilities, aligning technical priorities with the company’s most valuable business opportunities.
- Partner with marketing, operations, revenue management, and technology leadership to identify, prioritize, and deliver analytical solutions with the greatest business impact—focused on resident acquisition, engagement, retention, and loyalty; customer experience; pricing; and long-term value.
- Translate complex business challenges into clear roadmaps, delivery plans, and measurable outcomes, and curate a backlog that sets expectations on the timing of deliverables.
- Represent data science in planning, prioritization, and investment discussions, and communicate findings and recommendations clearly to senior business stakeholders with supporting visualizations.

Technical & Analytical Leadership
- Dedicate roughly a third of your time to personal technical contribution—model development, experimentation, and validation—on the highest-impact work.
- Set technical standards and direction across modeling, experimentation, deployment, monitoring, and governance for the team.
- Provide leadership in advanced analytical methods including predictive modeling, forecasting, optimization, segmentation, and machine learning.
- Persistently assess the status quo, looking for opportunities to simplify, optimize, and improve existing analytical constructs and solutions.
- Evaluate and responsibly adopt emerging capabilities, including generative AI, where they create measurable business value.

Production Machine Learning & Decision Systems
- Own the full analytical and machine learning lifecycle—from framing business problems and developing models through production deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
- Ensure analytical and machine learning systems are designed as reliable, reproducible, and auditable end-to-end decision systems.
- Guide development of production-grade solutions on modern cloud-based data platforms.
- Institutionalize the processes of aggregating, organizing, and preparing data for analysis, and create stable refresh processes that keep findings and insights fresh.
- Advance modern engineering practices including version control, CI/CD, automation, and reusable delivery patterns.

Team Leadership & Talent
- Lead, mentor, and grow a small, high-performing team of data scientists and machine learning engineers, dedicating roughly a third of your time to coaching and developing talent.
- Attract, assess, hire, and retain exceptional technical talent, and develop team members through coaching and structured development.
- Establish a culture of accountability, ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
- Help upskill data and analytics expertise across the team and among business partners.

Quality, Governance & Continuous Improvement
- Establish high standards for reproducibility, data quality, code quality, validation, and production support.
- Ensure analytical decisions are correct, explainable, and defensible before deployment.
- Continuously improve the team’s operating model and delivery practices.
- Work closely with the business intelligence team to create on-brand visualizations and management tools that improve performance related to customer acquisition and experience.

What You Bring
Education and/or Experience
- BA/BS degree with emphasis on a quantitative discipline (e.g., Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Operations Research) required; advanced degree (MS or PhD) in a quantitative or applied science strongly preferred.
- 10+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, or applied analytics, including substantial hands-on ownership of model development and production machine learning systems.
- 5+ years of experience leading and developing data science or machine learning talent, with a demonstrated ability to build and mentor high-performing teams while remaining hands-on.
- Demonstrated experience building, deploying, and operating machine learning or optimization systems in production, with accountability across the full lifecycle from design through deployment, monitoring, and retraining.
- Demonstrated success applying predictive, prescriptive, forecasting, optimization, and segmentation methods to complex business problems.

Technical Skills
- Strong hands-on proficiency in SQL and Python (experience with R or other languages a plus).
- Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, or Azure) and modern data technologies (e.g., Snowflake, Spark, or Databricks).
- Expertise in data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau; Datorama a plus).
- Experience accessing various APIs and scripting refresh/update and ETL/ELT processes.
- Experience analyzing and assessing marketing channel performance—including digital ads, Google Ads, Facebook, and web analytics—a plus.

Other Requirements
- Demonstrated success using performance-based / ROI analysis to drive decisions and recommendations for resident and business strategy.
- Excellent verbal and written communication, with a proven ability to explain analytical concepts and results to senior business leaders.
- Demonstrated experience analyzing customer behavior and creating customer segmentation.
- Strong business judgment and the ability to shape strategy and lead cross-functional prioritization.
- Ability to be at work on a regular and consistent basis.

Why Invitation Homes
We believe when our residents thrive, our associates thrive. Here, you're not just filling a role — you're building a career at a company that invests in your growth and welcomes you for who you are.

What's in it for you
- Competitive pay and annual bonus program for all associates

Evernest is a full-service real estate and property management company with a national presence and an outstanding reputation. We operate in 50+ of the nation's most investable markets and manage over 12,000 homes. We are a high-performing team, and our culture is second to none. Our dedicated people, proprietary technology, and commitment to continuous improvement are changing an industry.
 
Our goal is to manage 250,000 homes by 2030, and we’re looking for driven individuals who share our vision. Join us on this exciting journey to build something great, and play a key role in shaping the future of property management, making a lasting impact on our clients and the communities we serve.

Evernest is seeking a motivated, proactive and highly organized Property Manager to oversee the day-to-day operations of a residential portfolio. The Property Manager’s primary responsibility is owner satisfaction which requires excellent communication and impeccable coordination. The role touches marketing, leasing, collections, resident relations, retention, maintenance and renovations so you will partner with Resident Services, Accounting, Leasing and Property Services to deliver best in class results. Ensure that all properties are in compliance with local, state, and federal regulations.

-
Partner with our Property Services team to coordinate with technicians, contractors and vendors for maintenance and repair work.

-
Manage budgets and financial records for the properties.

-
Execute portfolio level operations in line with company targets and KPIs.

-
Dispatch field team members to conduct inspections of properties to ensure they are in good condition and well-maintained.

-
Develop and implement policies and procedures to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of property management.

-

jobs.title: Property Management Analyst
jobs.summary: About the Company There are 17 million Americans who own rental property. Most don't want to be landlords anymore, but selling isn't a good option.
jobs.description:
About the Company

There are 17 million Americans who own rental property. Most don't want to be landlords anymore, but selling isn't a good option. Why? You'd lose income and appreciation, trigger tax liabilities, kick out your tenants, have to fix up the house – the list goes on! Flock is here to help.

Flock's mission is to provide every retiring landlord with the most cost-efficient and seamless exit. Our first product is a tech-enabled 721 Exchange for residential landlords. Owners contribute properties into our professionally managed Fund, in exchange for passive equity ownership. It's a direct 721 Exchange model designed for everyday owners who want access to continued cashflows, liquidity, and diversification without triggering capital gains, disturbing tenants, or dealing with disposition friction. We're growing fast and are looking for smart, entrepreneurial hustlers who want to help build something category-defining.

We're backed by top tier investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Primary Ventures, Renegade Partners, SUSA Ventures, 1Sharpe Ventures, and leaders from Invitation Homes and Opendoor.

About the Role

Flock Homes is hiring a Property Management Analyst to join our property and resident operations team in Denver. Every home we bring into the Fund carries a resident, a municipality, an HOA, a utility account, and a compliance calendar behind it. As we grow from roughly 1,000 managed units toward several thousand, you'll be the main point of contact for residents, keeping records tidy and building a positive resident experience.

You'll own the standard workflows end to end: tenant questions, rent demands, housing programs, security deposits, HOA notices, and utilities. Expect to run standard situations through a playbook, escalating unusual or risky situations as needed. This is an in-person role based out of our Denver office.

What You'll Do

- Own the resident relationship day to day: Field general tenant inquiries and routine communication, resolve standard lease, payment, property, and account questions, and spot out-of-scope issues that need to go up the chain.

- Run the delinquency cycle: Own the intra-month workflow, monitor balances, conduct standard outreach, and prepare, send, and document rent demands on the required timelines.

- Administer Section 8 and other housing programs: Handle the paperwork, inspections, rent changes, and housing authority communication, and work through compliance issues and exceptions as they surface.

- Own security deposit returns: Gather move-out documentation and charges, prepare dispositions, and conduct move-outs within statutory deadlines.

- Own HOA coordination: Track notices and violations, drive tenant-responsible items to resolution, route repair-related violations to Maintenance, keeping deadlines, fines, and CC&Rs organized.

- Keep utilities clean: Administer accounts, resolve billing and account discrepancies, coordinate tenant responsibility, and run the monthly audit that catches occupancy and vacancy mismatches before they hit the books.

About You

- At least 1 year of experience in real estate, property management, or customer service. You understand the operational rhythms of managing properties and residents. Appfolio experience is a plus.

- Meticulous and process-driven: You're careful with documentation and follow established procedures accurately across multiple properties and resident needs. You run your book like a system, not a scramble.

- Exceptional communicator: You have excellent verbal and written communication skills and deliver outstanding customer service. You're empathetic and responsive to resident needs, empowered to listen more than you talk.

- Organized problem-solver: You can prioritize tasks, manage time effectively, and proactively address operational needs. You thrive in a startup environment and are eager to take initiative and improve processes.

- Accountable and compliant: You demonstrate accountability for your responsibilities and actively participate in feedback loops for continuous improvement. You ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.

- Community-minded: You engage authentically with diverse communities, actively listen to concerns, and deliver thoughtful, solution-oriented responses. You're committed to enhancing the resident experience at every touchpoint.

Even if you don't meet 100% of the qualifications, we recommend applying to the role!

Location: Denver, CO. This is an in-person role based in our Downtown Denver office.

Compensation: $65-75k base salary, plus equity and benefits (medical/dental/vision insurance, 401k, and unlimited PTO).

jobs.summary: About Homeward Homeward takes the “what ifs” out of homebuying by creating financial products that give buyers and sellers certainty and convenience.
jobs.description:
About Homeward

Homeward takes the “what ifs” out of homebuying by creating financial products that give buyers and sellers certainty and convenience. We’re a fast-paced, remote-first real estate startup that partners with real estate agents to offer innovative products and services, helping clients buy with cash, sell with certainty, and time their move, regardless of the market.

Founder and CEO Tim Heyl, owner of one of the fastest-growing agent teams in the country, started Homeward in 2018 to fix the antiquated and broken real estate process. Today, we offer bundled cash offers, mortgage, and title services in 13 states, enabling buyers and sellers to move with certainty and convenience.

We’re a fully remote company with a diverse team spread across several countries - Grounded in three core values: The Golden Rule, One Team One Dream, and Calm Focus. Hear from our employees about what our values mean to them.

About the opportunity

As the Manager of Agent Success at Homeward, you'll lead and significantly scale our Agent Success team at a pivotal stage of growth. You'll have the opportunity to build on an established playbook for prospecting, activating, and growing agent referral relationships—and bring the leadership, operating rigor, and field expertise to expand the team quickly and effectively.

We're looking for a proven leader who has built and led high-performing field business development teams in the real estate industry, with a track record of hiring and ramping reps quickly, setting clear expectations, and consistently achieving or exceeding team quotas. You'll be responsible for translating strategy into execution in the field, developing leaders and reps, and creating the systems and culture that allow a growing team to perform at a high level.

This is an opportunity to make a significant impact as Homeward continues to grow: you'll help shape how we scale our Agent Success organization, develop a high-performing field team, and expand our network of agent partnerships across the country. If you've successfully led and scaled real estate business development teams and are energized by the opportunity to build quickly in a high-growth environment, we'd love to hear from you.

Note: This role may require travel throughout the United States.

In this role, you will:

- Scale the team. Hire, onboard, and ramp field business development reps against an ambitious growth plan, building a high-performing team that can grow with the business.

- Run and evolve the playbook. Equip new and existing business development reps to execute Homeward's established prospecting, activation, and referral-growth playbook, while identifying opportunities to improve it as the team scales.

- Coach for performance. Build a strong coaching culture through regular 1:1s, role play, call reviews, and ongoing development that helps each rep reach their full potential.

- Own the team's numbers. Set clear goals and manage to the KPIs that drive success, including in-person activity, agent referrals, pipeline, and closed deals. Review performance and pipeline regularly, identify gaps early, and take action to keep the team on track.

- Build a culture of accountability. Set a high bar for execution and performance, create clarity around expectations, and consistently coach toward results while maintaining a positive, high-performing team culture.

- Partner cross-functionally. Work closely with Sales leadership, Recruiting, Marketing, Operations, Title, and Mortgage to ensure the field team has the resources, support, and alignment needed to succeed as the organization scales.

What you'll bring

- Proven real estate business development leadership experience. 3–5+ years managing a field business development or sales team in the real estate industry, with experience leading reps who build relationships and generate business in the field.

- A track record of building high-performing teams. You've hired, onboarded, trained, and coached business development or sales reps—and ideally have experience doing so during a period of rapid growth.

- Consistent quota achievement. You have personally led teams accountable to meaningful revenue or production targets, with a track record of consistently achieving or exceeding quota.

- A high-accountability management style. You're comfortable setting clear expectations, using data to understand performance, and addressing gaps quickly and constructively.

- Strong operating discipline. You're highly organized and reliable, with the ability to establish and maintain a consistent management cadence while operating with significant autonomy.

- A player-development mindset. You know how to coach reps to improve their skills, build confidence, and deliver results—and how to recognize and develop high-potential talent as the team grows.

- An appetite for growth. You thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and are energized by the opportunity to build, improve, and scale rather than simply maintain an existing organization.

Pay & Benefits

- Compensation: $100,000 base salary + $75,000 variable compensation ($175,000 OTE)

- Remote-first environment: Our headquarters are in Austin, TX

- Equity: Exciting stock option grant for every full-time employee

- 401(k): Employer contribution match

- Health & wellness: Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance

- Time off: 20 days of vacation, 5 sick days, 12 company holidays, and 2 floating holidays each year

- Parental leave: Generous paid parental leave of up to 13 weeks

See more about how Homeward takes care of our team by providing a generous package of benefits here.
Value-Driven Employee Experience

THE GOLDEN RULE. It’s simple: Treat others the way we want to be treated. Whether we’re dealing with colleagues or customers, we don’t prioritize money or growth over people, and we practice empathy at every opportunity.

CALM FOCUS. We work in tech and build solutions for real estate. Both are fast-paced and stressful industries. But by focusing on the larger objective rather than rushing from one task to the next, we can create solutions our customers love.

ONE TEAM, ONE DREAM. Big problems require big solutions. We look at our customers’ experiences holistically and recognize that solving them requires collaboration across teams and our three affiliate companies — Homeward, Homeward Mortgage and Homeward Title.

jobs.description:
About Orchard

Orchard is radically simplifying the way people buy and sell their homes. For the average American, the home purchase and sale process takes months, creates anxiety, and is filled with uncertainty and hassle. Orchard has reimagined the end-to-end experience of buying and selling, from innovative home search tools to find the perfect home to the ability to buy a new home before selling your current one. Orchard customers manage the entire experience through a personalized online dashboard, while also getting the support of best-in-class Orchard real estate agents.

Headquartered in New York City with teammates across the US, Orchard boasts over 150+ employees. We have financing from top-tier investors including Revolution, Firstmark, Accomplice, Navitas and Juxtapose, who have also backed the likes of Pinterest, Airbnb, Shopify and Sweetgreen. We're proud to be recognized by Crain's, Inc. 5000, Glassdoor, Parity.org and Built In on their lists of best places to work.

About the Role

Orchard is looking for an Associate General Counsel to join our dynamic and expanding team. As a member of the small but highly productive Legal & Regulatory team, you are ready to roll up your sleeves and make an immediate impact. You will play a key role in our growing business, partnering with teams across the company to help build and evolve our product offerings, expand to new jurisdictions, and further develop and mature our business lines, all while balancing business objectives and legal risk across the multiple highly-regulated sectors in which we operate. As the company continues to grow, there is significant opportunity to take on additional responsibilities and leadership roles.

The ideal candidate is a highly self-motivated, business-minded attorney who enjoys operating autonomously, successfully navigates ambiguity, and can manage multiple projects and competing priorities comfortably. This person brings extraordinary judgment and interpersonal skills to the role. While highly effective and an innovative thinker, you take a humble approach to your job, allowing your work to speak for itself. By building a track record of sound advice and success, you will become a trusted advisor to executive leadership and teams across the company. We are looking for candidates who are excited about the opportunity to help grow Orchard’s business in an entrepreneurial yet compliant manner, while working with diverse groups of stakeholders to get things done in a complex and fast moving environment.

This is a full-time role that will report to the General Counsel. The preferred location is New York City where we are on a hybrid schedule, 2-days a week in office. However, we are open to fully remote candidates in any of these hiring locations: Washington DC, CA, CO, FL, GA, MA, MI, MS, NC, NJ, NY, PA, SC, TN, TX, VA, WA.

What You’ll Do Here

- Act as a legal swiss-army knife, working independently across several different legal practice areas, but with a particular focus on commercial and regulatory issues and building out Orchard’s products and services in compliance with the legal and regulatory frameworks governing residential real estate.

- Act as the go-to person for negotiation and structuring of complex commercial contracts, partnerships, and joint ventures

- Work with our real estate brokerage, mortgage, title, and closing services business lines to continue to build out their respective product and service offerings, as well as policies, controls, and structures to be compliant with applicable federal and state legal frameworks, while also taking a leadership role in expanding the reach of those business lines into additional states.

- Work with our companies to help innovate, streamline and create customer delight in the delivery of each company’s services, all while maintaining compliance with applicable state laws and regulations.

- Partner with our Product & Engineering Teams to design and iterate how our products and services are provided to customers, helping to intelligently balance innovation and growth with legal and regulatory risk.

- Engage with and build relationships with state regulators, in particular in connection with expansion of our businesses into new states, our ongoing operational compliance, and any regulatory inquiries or examinations that may arise.

- Manage outside law firms across a variety of practice areas, while balancing cost and effectiveness in the delivery of legal services to our stakeholders.

- Take a leadership role in the continued development and improvement of our Data Privacy and Information Security policies, practices and procedures.

- You also may have the opportunity to be involved in both equity and debt financings, and strategic M&A transactions.

We’d Love to Hear From You if You

- Are a broad-based attorney with 7-12 years of experience in the commercial and/or regulatory space, gained ideally through a combination of law firm and in-house roles of increasing visibility and responsibility.

- Have solid experience with commercial contracts, negotiating from a commercial perspective and reviewing from a regulatory perspective where necessary, including leading negotiations or discussions with large companies.

- Have experience negotiating and structuring partnerships and joint ventures.

- Have experience with Data Privacy regimes and implementation of the related policies and procedures.

- Have experience with the laws and regulatory framework related to real estate brokerage and/or mortgage lending, though this is a plus and is not required.

- Have prior experience with a real estate brokerage or mortgage company, in particular a tech-focused real estate brokerage or mortgage company, though this is a plus and is not required.

- Have experience navigating the application of evolving and sometimes overlapping regulations in a business context.

- Are an entrepreneur who sees ambiguity as opportunity, and obstacles as chances to build new solutions.

- Can successfully work independently with little guidance, but also use good judgment and escalate issues when needed.

- Eager to collaborate and comfortable and effective at building strong relationships with people across a variety of functional teams, skill sets and levels of professional experience.

- Have a demonstrated drive for results, work ethic and ability to prioritize risks and projects to focus on what’s important, get things done, and seize opportunities.

- Have meticulous attention to detail and excellent planning and organizational skills.

- Have a state bar admission in good standing.

For NYC residents only: The pay range for this position in New York City is $225,000-$250,000/year. jobs.summary: Join Orchard Brokerage and build a market from the ground up. We are looking for a driven, broker-minded Brokerage Leader to establish Orchard's presence in Seattle, WA, recruit an…
jobs.description:
Join Orchard Brokerage and build a market from the ground up. We are looking for a driven, broker-minded Brokerage Leader to establish Orchard's presence in Seattle, WA, recruit and develop a team of high-performing agents, and become the face of Orchard in your market. You will have the platform, the products, and the support. We need the person who can build the culture and the team around it.

Why Join Orchard

- Opportunity to build and lead Orchard's presence in a growth market from day one, with direct upside tied to team growth

- A share of your team's production

- Revenue share program — earn ongoing income from the agents you bring into the business

- No up front brokerage fees — we do not earn until you do

- Multiple revenue streams available, including downline incentives

- Earn equity for your performance with Orchard stock options

- $1,100+ in monthly marketing support — free to all agents on your team

- Access to Orchard Offers Marketplace

- Unique products that win you and your agents business:

- Orchard Move First: Buy your next home before you sell, skip the showings, and become a non-contingent buyer

- Orchard Concierge: Make price-boosting repairs and upgrades at no upfront cost

- Orchard Cash Offer + Upside: Sell quickly for a cash offer and get the upside when your home sells on the market

- Access to Orchard Mortgage and Orchard Title for a seamless transaction and incentives to help close more deals

- Transaction coordination services on every deal

- Strong agent community and culture and a consumer brand centered around delivering great customer experience

Compensation

This is a commission-only (1099) position. The average full-time fully ramped Brokerage Leader earns $120,000 to $200,000+ per year. There is no cap on earnings.

What We Are Looking For

- Active and unrestricted Washington real estate license and located in the greater Seattle, WA area

- 5+ years of experience as a licensed agent. Managing broker license preferred.

- 3+ years of experience managing or mentoring real estate agents

- At least 10 closed transactions in the last 12 months

- A track record of recruiting and building a team, not just managing one

- A proven ability to deliver an outstanding customer experience while meeting or exceeding production targets

- Demonstrated ability to coach a team, develop skills, and drive results without a company-supplied lead pipeline

- Strong communication skills — both written and verbal

Orchard is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We provide employment opportunities without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable law.

About the Role

Orchard Title is looking for a dynamic Escrow Officer who has a current book of business, to manage the closing process and provide an exceptional experience for customers for both their own deals and Orchard Brokerage closings. The ideal candidate is a seasoned real estate professional with expert knowledge of residential closings. If you are used to working with high-stakes, time-sensitive deals and managing your own pipeline, then we want to hear from you! This is a full time role that will report into the Escrow Manager for your market. We are open to any of the following locations for this role: Phoenix, Denver, Austin, Dallas, Houston, or San Antonio.

What You’ll Do Here:

- Actively seek new business by attending sales meetings, real estate events, escrow, and management meetings and interact with lending and banking to increase capture rate.

- Prepare closing disclosures, escrow agreements and all other settlement documents according to lender and/or buyer/seller instructions

- Clearly communicate and collaborate with cross-functional departments in Customer Experience, Brokerage, Contract Operations, and Funding to promptly troubleshoot and resolve any issues in the Title process to avoid delays

- Obtain clear title by curing title defects, satisfying existing liens and encumbrances against property or principals, and verifying proper vesting

- Balance all financials with corresponding invoices and tax balances

- Provide correct lender closing instructions and oversee the receipt and proper disbursement of funds; ensure all outstanding checks and escrowed funds are properly managed

- Maintain compliance with Orchard Title policies and procedures in accordance with governing laws, regulations, regulatory agencies and company standards

We’d Love to Hear From You if You Have:

- 3+ years of experience as an Licensed Escrow Officer with their own book of business. Expected to bring in a minimum of 5 closings a month from their book of business.

- Exceptional verbal and written customer service skills that help form positive relationships both internally and externally

- Confidence working with technologies (Google Suite) and speciality software (e.g. Qualia) Will train if needed.

- Working knowledge of state-level escrow rules and regulations enforced by Dept of Insurance

- A team player mentality who subscribes to the concept of “Team Before Self”

- Passion for innovation and are comfortable with change

- Organization skills and are exceptionally detail-oriented

Orchard is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We provide employment opportunities without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable law.
