jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.summary: About Orchard Orchard is transforming the way people buy and sell their homes. Simplifying it, to the way it should have always been; fair and true to market, straightforward, easy…
jobs.description:
About Orchard

Orchard is transforming the way people buy and sell their homes. Simplifying it, to the way it should have always been; fair and true to market, straightforward, easy. Every year in the U.S., $1.5 trillion of single family homes transact, generating over $120 billion of fees in a process that has changed little in decades. For the average American, the home purchase and sale process takes months, creates anxiety and is filled with uncertainty and hassle. Orchard offers a modern alternative, making one of life's biggest decisions -- the sale and purchase of a home –so stress free, fair and simple that people cannot imagine any other way. Orchard is headquartered in New York City, has 150+ employees, a network of 600 agents and has grown nearly 2x year over the last 2 years. We have raised equity financing from top tier investors including: Firstmark, Accomplice, Revolution Growth, Navitas and Juxtapose.

About the Role

Orchard’s engineering team values clarity, collaboration, and ownership. Our team builds the systems behind Orchard’s website and the tools that help agents reach new customers. We focus on helping people explore homes, book consultations, and connect with our agents. Our site serves over 150k unique visitors each month and sees about 700k pageviews. The team partners closely with marketing, product, and design to support new campaigns, track performance, and ensure the site is fast and reliable at scale.

You'll work on the systems that make this possible - backend, frontend, or both, depending on where the work takes you. That means building and improving APIs, data services, and integrations that support both customers and agents. Your work will touch many parts of the systems our team owns. We build and maintain the services that bring new customers into Orchard, from the public website and intake flows, to scheduling and consultation booking. We also support the tools that help our agents work with those customers, like managing and syncing leads, powering outreach, and maintaining privacy and consent systems that keep customer data safe and compliant.

You’ll work closely with product managers, designers, engineers, and business stakeholders to plan and ship projects. The team is small and moves quickly, so you’ll have real ownership and visibility in your work. Most of our engineering work today is agent-driven: we use tools like Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and Codex daily, and the job is less about typing code yourself and more about scoping the work well, directing AI tools effectively, and catching it when they get something wrong. We're looking for engineers who are good at that loop, not just comfortable with AI tools existing.

This is a full-time role that will report into our Senior Software Engineer and be based out of the New York office, where we are in office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays.

What You'll Do Here

- Build and maintain the services and interfaces that power Orchard's website and internal tools. Most of our stack uses Qwik on the frontend and Python with Postgres and OpenSearch on the backend, though some other services use React and TypeScript.

- Work with product and design to turn ideas into clear, well-scoped projects.

- Debug and improve core services to make them faster and more reliable as we prepare for national growth over the next 12-18 months.

- Ensure our systems can scale smoothly as our user base continues to grow.

- Write clean, tested code that’s easy to understand and maintain.

- Help improve developer workflows, testing, and documentation.

- Take part in on-call rotations and own the systems you build.

- Work with a small team that values communication, trust, and practical solutions.

- Use AI coding tools like Claude Code, Copilot, and Codex as part of your daily workflow to build and ship features efficiently.

- Comfortable reviewing code you didn't write

We'd Love to Hear From You if You Have

- At least 2+ years of experience as a software engineer.

- Strong skills in at least one language relevant to our stack (Python, TypeScript, or Go), with solid knowledge of APIs and data modeling.

- Experience with tools like AWS, Postgres, SQL, Kafka, Airflow, Docker, or CircleCI is a plus.

- Experience directing AI coding tools effectively

- A low-ego, problem-solving mindset. You take ownership, improve what you touch, and ask for help when something doesn't add up.

- Interest in a hands-on team where engineers ship quickly and have real impact.

For NYC residents only: The pay range for this position in New York City is $130,000-$150,000/year. The actual base pay offered may vary within the range provided depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location. Stock options and other incentive pay may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, depending on the position offered. This information is provided per the New York City Human Rights Law. Please note that the range provided is applicable only to New York City-based applicants. Base compensation may vary if the work location is outside of New York City.
Orchard is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We provide employment opportunities without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable law.

jobs.description:
What we do and why we do it

As the leading end-to-end investment platform for single-family rental homes (SFR), our mission is to reinvent the rental housing ecosystem for the benefit of all. We successfully merge our passion for helping investors build wealth through real estate with cutting-edge technology that transforms the way they do it.

How it’s going (and growing)

With a talented team of 750+ Roofsters, our collaborative, can-do culture is what fuels our growth. In 2022, we closed on our Series E, raising $240 million, and have offices in the Bay Area and New York City. Our growth includes recent acquisitions of Stessa (financial and asset management software), RentPrep (tenant screening and placement service for landlords), and Mynd (property management platform for both Retail and Institutional investors). In 2025, Roofstock took an ownership stake in Casago (short-term rental management services), expanding our platform to support both long-term and short-term rental investment services.

About the Role

The Property Accountant – Institutional will provide full cycle accounting support for the property management team, and function as a key member of the team. This role is responsible for communicating financial results to both external clients and management teams. The skills required to succeed in this role include strong accounting, collaboration, and communication skills.

Responsibilities

- Provide daily accounting functions for multiple regions

- Prepare and distribute monthly financial reports in accordance with GAAP –prepare monthly accrual journal entries, financial statement preparation/reconciliation and bank reconciliations.

- Prepare monthly distributions to clients

- Review and maintain accuracy of general ledgers

- G/L activity posting, Balance Sheet reconciliation and maintenance of

- subsidiary ledgers

- Support Property Accounting Managers with ad hoc projects, monthly closes and distributions

- Monitor cash receipt postings, tenant billings, billing adjustments and perform tenant ledger reconciliations when necessary

- Review invoice coding and invoice workflow to ensure adherence to capitalization policies and timely payments to vendors

- Coordinate with various departments to ensure accounting accuracy and completeness of financial packages

- Ability to independently research historical cash transactions and provide

- Portfolio Managers and Regional Directors with timely responses

- Provide accounting detail and assistance to Property Accounting Managers for all internal and/or external auditors

- Research new accounting laws and regulations for different states as needed

- Prepare annual 1099 and 1096 reporting to vendors and IRS

- Prepare quarterly 592 and 588 forms to Franchise Tax Board on as needed basis

- Performs ad hoc assignments as needed

Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or equivalent preferred

- 3+ years of Real Estate Accounting experience

- Experience in Public Accounting highly preferred

- Proficiency using Excel and Google Suite products

- High degree of accuracy and attention to detail.

- Adaptability – maintains effectiveness in varying environments, tasks and responsibilities, or with various types of people.

- Planning and Organizing – ability to establish a course of action to accomplish goals and evaluate results.

- Ability to multitask - work successfully under pressure and effectively prioritize and manage time and workload to meet client needs.

- Client Focus – dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of the external and internal client, establishes and maintains effective relationships with clients, and gains their trust and respect.

- Dealing with Ambiguity – can effectively cope with change, can shift gears comfortably, can decide and act without having the total picture, can comfortably handle risk and uncertainty.

- Drive for Results – can be counted on to exceed goals successfully, bottom line oriented, pushes self and others for results.

- Thrives in a fast-paced and start-up environment

Location

 This position must be located in Dallas, TX

Compensation

$60,000 - $80,000 annually

Compensation may be adjusted based on experience, skills, and interview performance.

Pay Transparency

Our compensation reflects several US geographic markets. The base pay for this position represents the expected salary for this position. Ultimately, your pay will be determined based on several factors, including location, job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other job-related factors. Roofstock is a total compensation company; the base salary is only a part of our total compensation package.

Competitive & Unique Benefits Package

- Generous PTO Policy

- 12 Paid Holidays

- Volunteer Time Off

- Paid Parental Leave

- 401k Program

- Wellness and home office/cell phone subsidies

- Robust health, dental, vision insurance, and more

- Wellness and home office/cell phone subsidies

Must be authorized to work in the U.S. is a precondition of employment, and we are unable to sponsor H1-B Visas at this time.

Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background investigation.

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.summary: About the Company There are 17 million Americans who own rental property. Most don't want to be landlords anymore, but selling isn’t a good option.
jobs.description:
About the Company

There are 17 million Americans who own rental property. Most don't want to be landlords anymore, but selling isn’t a good option. Why? You’d lose income and appreciation, trigger tax liabilities, kick out your tenants, have to fix up the house – the list goes on! Flock is here to help.

Flock’s mission is to provide every retiring landlord with the most cost-efficient and seamless exit. Our first product is a tech-enabled 721 Exchange for residential landlords. Owners contribute properties into our professionally managed Fund, in exchange for passive equity ownership. It's a direct 721 Exchange model designed for everyday owners who want access to continued cashflows, liquidity, and diversification without triggering capital gains, disturbing tenants, or dealing with disposition friction. We’re growing fast and are looking for smart, entrepreneurial hustlers who want to help build something category-defining.

We’re backed by top tier investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Primary Ventures, Renegade Partners, SUSA Ventures, 1Sharpe Ventures, and leaders from Invitation Homes and Opendoor.

About the Role

Flock is hiring a Full Stack Software Engineer to join our small, high-impact product team. We’re building a 10x version of Flock from the ground up, redefining how mom-and-pops invest in real estate.

This is a generalist role by design, with autonomy over what you build. You'll work across the entire stack and customer journey – frontend, backend, data, infra, and AI – picking up whatever a project needs rather than owning a single layer. Most of our work is growth engineering: driving quality leads and building the tools, automations, and AI-powered products that compound our funnel. You'll ship fast, measure everything, and make choices based on data (not roadmaps handed down from above).

What You’ll Do:

- Build across the stack: Design, ship, and iterate on the platforms and tools that power Flock's Exchange and Fund — from acquisition to fund operations to the investor experience.

- Own features end-to-end: Take features from MVP to production, working directly with Design and Ops to iterate and move fast.

- Shape the roadmap: Influence major product and engineering decisions. This is a small team where your input materially changes what gets built.

- Build for the whole company: Develop tools that make Acquisitions, Operations, and Asset Management faster and sharper, not just customer-facing features.

- Set the engineering bar: Help establish the processes, code standards, and culture that let engineering scale as Flock grows.

- Empower the team: Everyone at Flock has the power to build - non-engineers included. You’ll build the tooling that makes this possible through developing AI infrastructure that brings everyone’s ideas to life.

About You:

- 2-5 years experience building and delivering production quality software systems. Strong candidates are expected to operate independently.

- Eager to Grow: Learns unfamiliar areas fast, and leans on AI to move into them quickly.

- Full-Stack Fluency: We use TypeScript, React, Node, GraphQL/Apollo, Go, Python, AWS (ECS/Beanstalk), and Salesforce (but we care more about range and speed than any specific tool).

- AI-forward: Comfortable building with AI tools and agents—this is central to how we work.

- Collaborative: You default to an iterative approach to problem solving and work well with Product, Design, and non-technical teams across Sales, Ops, and Asset Management.

- Bias to Action: You'd rather ship and iterate than wait for a perfect spec.

- Metrics-driven: Excellent written and verbal communication skills and a proven track record of using data to measure success and inform decisions.

- Organized: Able to balance multiple projects and prioritize competing tasks.

- Ethical: Conduct business with the highest level of integrity and professionalism.

Must be excited to work in-person 5 days/week.

Even if you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications, we recommend applying to the role!

Note: This is a full-time, in-person role.

The target annual salary for this role is $156-204k OTE, plus equity and benefits (medical/dental/vision insurance, 401k, and unlimited PTO).

jobs.title: Business Automation Engineer
jobs.summary: Blend is a diverse team of problem solvers who believe that the world’s financial resources should be more accessible. Our cloud banking platform is used by Wells Fargo, U.S.
jobs.description:
Blend is a diverse team of problem solvers who believe that the world’s financial resources should be more accessible. Our cloud banking platform is used by Wells Fargo, U.S. Bank, and over 330 other financial services firms to acquire more customers, increase productivity, and deliver end-to-end digital experiences. Our software enables our customers to process an average of more than $5 billion in loans per day, making it possible for consumers to reach their financial goals faster and lead better lives. Come do work that matters.

Business Automation Engineer

As a Business Automation Engineer, you’ll partner with teams across the company to rethink and refactor how work gets done. You’ll find manual and repetitive processes and then design and build automations to improve the quality of work and day-to-day business life of our internal partners. We’re focused on deploying efficient and adaptable automations that actually solve problems.

As one of the first members of the team, you’ll help build the foundation for a scalable hub of automations and integrations, using both off-the-shelf products and custom code where appropriate. You’ll help shape the workflows that make our team an effective and reliable partner for bringing business processes into an automated, AI-augmented world. You’ll work closely with security and IT leadership from the beginning to ensure the team’s foundations and, therefore, the rest of the company’s internal automation efforts are secure, auditable, and built to last.

How You’ll Contribute

- Partner with business stakeholder to understand workflows and triage high-impact automation opportunities.

- Business, build, and deploy automations across various SaaS tooling, internal systems, and APIs.

- Leverage AI and agentic patterns when it adds value to business operations workflows and recognize when simpler, more deterministic solutions are the better choice.

- Build with a secure-by-default mindset, including the incorporation of access controls, secrets management, logging, and the proper handling of sensitive information.

- Establish team patterns and culture, including documentation, testing, and ongoing operational maintenance.

PointCentral is the leading smart property technology platform for residential rental communities — powering access, security, and automation across multifamily, single-family, build-to-rent, and short-term rental properties nationwide. We're a subsidiary of Alarm.com, which gives us the stability and infrastructure of a public company with the speed and ambition of a product-led startup.

The Senior Partner Growth Manager is responsible for accelerating revenue growth through PointCentral's channel sales model. This role owns partner-driven new-logo growth and all expansion within assigned partner-managed accounts, working alongside Service Providers, PointCentral Account Executives, and internal cross-functional teams to improve partner execution, increase the number of active producing partners, and drive a predictable growth engine. While this role does not replace direct seller ownership of enterprise new-logo opportunities, it partners closely with Account Executives on strategic opportunities where additional support is required.

Responsibilities:

- Own partner-driven new-logo growth and all expansion within assigned partner-managed accounts, with clear accountability for pipeline creation, qualification, progression, and revenue outcomes.

- Identify, recruit, onboard, and enable new Service Providers aligned to PointCentral's target markets, establishing clear success criteria to ensure newly added partners become active and productive contributors.

- Build and execute joint growth plans with Service Providers that activate more producing partners, identify expansion opportunities, and create a more diversified contribution model across the partner base.

- Lead structured business reviews and partner performance discussions using internal data and tiered productivity measures to drive intentional growth planning.

- Accelerate partner-led opportunities through common stall points — including technical validation, pricing alignment, and solution positioning — while coordinating internal resources to maintain deal momentum and improve close rates.

- Partner with Account Executives on enterprise opportunities and strategic expansions where direct-selling support is required.

- Triage, route, escalate, and drive cross-functional follow-through on revenue-impacting partner issues across onboarding, support, product, pricing, and execution.

- Maintain accurate Salesforce records and provide consistent updates on pipeline, partner activity, expansion, and productivity.

- Capture and route structured partner feedback on competitive positioning, product gaps, and implementation friction to improve the broader partner experience.

Requirements:

- Bachelor's Degree Required, and 5+ years of experience in channel sales, partner development, account growth, or enterprise sales within a partner-led model.

- Willingness to travel up to 50% within the assigned territory.

Position Overview:

Alarm.com is seeking a Quality Engineer with an interest in Software Development in Test (SDET) to join our Quality Engineering team. In this role, you will support the quality, performance, and reliability of our web and mobile applications through a combination of manual testing, test automation, and modern quality practices.

You will work closely with Product Management, Software Engineering, UX Design, DevOps, and Support while learning how quality is built into Alarm.com products throughout the development lifecycle. The ideal candidate has 0–1 years of experience in quality engineering, software testing, internships, or academic projects; is eager to grow automation skills; and is curious about emerging tools and techniques—including AI‑assisted testing solutions—to improve test coverage and efficiency.

This role is well‑suited for a motivated engineer at the start of their career who enjoys learning, collaborating with others, and developing a strong foundation in quality engineering.

Responsibilities:

- Learn and develop an understanding of Alarm.com’s products, customer workflows, and system architecture.

- Execute manual test cases, identify and document defects, and help track issues through resolution and verification.

- Assist in the development, execution, and maintenance of automated UI and API tests with guidance from more experienced team members.

- Collaborate with Product Managers and Software Engineers to understand requirements, acceptance criteria, and expected behavior.

- Participate in design and technical discussions to learn about testability, quality, and automation best practices.

- Help maintain test frameworks, tools, test data, and test environments.

- Support issue investigation by reviewing logs, validating data, and learning to read and understand code.

- Perform functional, regression, smoke, and sanity testing to support releases.

- Learn how automated tests are integrated into CI/CD pipelines and release workflows.

- Gain exposure to AI‑assisted testing tools and techniques as part of continuous improvement and skill development.

Required Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

- 0–1 years of experience in software testing, quality engineering, internships, co‑ops, or relevant academic projects.

- Basic programming or scripting experience in Java, Python, or JavaScript.

- Foundational understanding of software testing concepts such as functional and regression testing.

- Exposure to UI or API test automation tools (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Postman) through coursework, projects, or internships.

- Basic familiarity with Git or other version control systems.

- Strong attention to detail, curiosity, and a willingness to learn.

- Clear written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

- Internship, academic, or personal project experience related to QA, automation, or software development.

- Exposure to Agile/Scrum development environments.

- Basic knowledge of SQL or data validation concepts.

jobs.description:
What we do and why we do it

As the leading end-to-end investment platform for single-family rental homes (SFR), our mission is to reinvent the rental housing ecosystem for the benefit of all. We successfully merge our passion for helping investors build wealth through real estate with cutting edge technology that transforms the way they do it.

How it’s going (and growing)

With a talented team of 750+ Roofsters, our collaborative, can-do culture is what fuels our growth. In 2022, we closed on our Series E, raising $240 million, and have offices in the Bay Area and New York City. Our growth includes recent acquisitions of Stessa (financial and asset management software), RentPrep (tenant screening and placement service for landlords), and Mynd (property management platform for both Retail and Institutional investors). In 2025, Roofstock took an ownership stake in Casago (short-term rental management services), expanding our platform to support both long-term and short-term rental investment services.

About the Role

The Resident Experience Manager (RXM) serves as a vital advocate and liaison for residents, overseeing the day-to-day resident journey throughout their lease term. This role is highly customer-driven, focused on creating a positive, seamless, and responsive living experience. RXMs are responsible for building lasting relationships with residents by providing clear communication, swift issue resolution, and consistent support throughout the lease lifecycle.

Responsibilities

- Proactively engage with residents to address urgent or sensitive questions and concerns via phone calls.

- Draft thorough and empathetic responses to non-urgent matters within the resident portal, utilizing templates and training materials.

- Manage resident requests from initiation to completion using our internal case management system, ensuring tasks are performed in a timely manner.

- Review case records and draft comprehensive case summaries to provide context and clarity to all parties involved.

- Monitor productivity metrics to ensure service levels consistently meet or exceed expectations.

jobs.description:
Blend is a diverse team of problem solvers who believe that the world’s financial resources should be more accessible. Our cloud banking platform is used by Wells Fargo, U.S. Bank, and over 330 other financial services firms to acquire more customers, increase productivity, and deliver end-to-end digital experiences. Our software enables our customers to process an average of more than $5 billion in loans per day, making it possible for consumers to reach their financial goals faster and lead better lives. Come do work that matters.

Job Summary

Blend IT runs three complementary teams: Helpdesk (day-to-day employee productivity, including hands-on fleet and identity operations), Infrastructure & Projects (platform-level architecture for the systems, SaaS, and automation tooling IT depends on), and Enterprise Apps (Finance, GTM, and People Ops stacks).

We're hiring a Senior Helpdesk Engineer to be the bridge between the T1 queue and Helpdesk's project work: own escalations that go past Tier 1, and take Helpdesk-driven projects, especially the AI-and-automation-first initiatives that keep getting pulled off track by day-to-day capacity, from kickoff to finish without needing someone else to close the loop. You'll be the person asking "should a human even be doing this one?" for every recurring request, and then actually building the answer, freeing Helpdesk leadership to set direction instead of getting pulled back into the queue to keep projects moving.

This is a builder's role, not a ticket-taker's role. We're looking for someone who is genuinely self-learning: comfortable researching an unfamiliar problem from scratch, forming a hypothesis, testing it, and proposing a fix, rather than waiting to be told the answer or escalating everything that isn't already documented. You'll be expected to bring solutions to the table, not just tickets, and to own a project through to completion, not just start it.

How You Will Contribute

AI & Automation: Owning the Pivot

- Identify recurring ticket patterns and turn them into automated or AI-assisted resolutions: self-service, agentic triage, workflow automation (e.g., Workato), rather than solving the same request by hand every time.

- Propose and prototype new automation or AI approaches to Helpdesk work; bring ideas forward rather than waiting for direction.

- Continuously evaluate what should move from "a human resolves this" to "a system resolves this, with a human as backstop," and help build that system.

- Document what you automate so it survives past you. Future teammates shouldn't have to reverse-engineer a workflow to trust it.

Senior Escalation & Technical Ownership

- Be the escalation point for tickets that exceed Tier 1 scope: deeper troubleshooting, ambiguous root causes, cross-system issues.

- Research unfamiliar problems independently. Read the docs, test a hypothesis, consult the right internal owner when genuinely stuck, and drive the ticket to a real resolution rather than a workaround.

- Keep resolutions durable: document fixes so the same hard problem doesn't get re-solved from scratch next time.

Project Ownership, Start to Finish

- Own Helpdesk-driven projects end to end: scope, plan, execute, and close, without needing someone else to carry it over the finish line. New tooling rollouts, fleet or identity initiatives, cross-team asks.

- Flex between queue support and project work based on where Helpdesk needs capacity that week, without either one silently dropping.

Who You Are

- 5+ years of IT support experience, including meaningful time past Tier 1. You've already handled escalations and carried at least one real project from kickoff to done, not just followed a runbook.

- A genuinely self-learning mindset: given an unfamiliar problem, you research it, form a hypothesis, and test it. You don't wait for someone to hand you the answer, and you proactively propose solutions rather than just surfacing problems.

- Real curiosity about AI and automation tooling. You don't need to have shipped a production agent or workflow yet, but you should already be experimenting, or clearly want to.

- Comfortable owning ambiguity and moving between queue work and project work without losing track of either.

- Hands-on with a modern endpoint/identity stack (JAMF, Intune, Okta, or comparable) and a modern ITSM (Freshservice, Zendesk, Jira Service Management).

- Strong macOS and Windows troubleshooting fundamentals plus working knowledge of networking (DNS, DHCP, VPN, Wi-Fi) at the endpoint level.

- Senior peer presence: comfortable driving a project without close supervision, and giving/receiving direct feedback with teammates and stakeholders.

- Clear communicator, comfortable working async with distributed teammates across the US, India, Mexico, and Spain.

- Comfortable in a Google Workspace-first environment, with working familiarity with Confluence for documentation.

Bonus Points

- Hands-on experience with workflow automation platforms (Workato, Zapier, n8n, or similar).

- Experience building or supporting AI-assisted support tooling: ticket triage, auto-response drafting, internal copilots, agentic workflows.

- Scripting fundamentals (Bash, Python, PowerShell).

- Background in fintech, banking, or another regulated industry (SOX, SOC 2).

- Experience supporting a multi-region, distributed workforce.

Compensation:

- Base Salary Range: $90,000 to $106,000 (This applies to full time hires. Final offer determined by multiple factors, including but not limited to function, level, geographic location, job related knowledge, skills, and experience.)

- Bonus: Eligibility is contingent upon both company performance against established goals and achievement of individual performance objectives.

- Equity: Meaningful Restricted Stock Units in public company stock (NYSE: BLND) so you share in Blend’s long-term growth and success.

Our Benefits at a Glance

We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support your health and work-life balance.

Health & Wellbeing

- We offer medical, dental, and vision benefits, with a generous employer contribution that helps keep your medical insurance costs low.

- Company-paid life, short-term, and long-term disability coverage

- Generous PTO, holidays, and maternity/parental leave

- Employee Assistance Program (EAP): mental health, legal, childcare & eldercare, financial planning, college search, and more

- Voluntary benefits: accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity, identity theft, and legal insurance

- Monthly wellness stipend for fitness, mental health, and well-being

- Additional perks: Milk Stork, pet insurance, and paid volunteer time off

Growth & Future

- 401(k) retirement plan with company match

- Pre-tax savings: healthcare & dependent care FSAs, Limited Purpose FSA, and HSA

Our technology makes it easier to buy and sell homes, whether that's enabling clients to buy before they sell, find a top agent, or have certainty through a modern closing process. Each year, HomeLight facilitates billions of dollars of residential real estate business on its platform for thousands of agents and loan officers. Our vision is a world where every real estate transaction is simple, certain, and satisfying for all.

Our team breaks barriers every day while staying committed to HomeLight's goals and core values, which is a crucial element to our shared success.

We are a 100% resale/purchase business (no-refis), and we do not expect you to do business development.

Who You Are:

You are the key to home ownership. As an escrow officer, you’re the human link between our process and people. You’re there at the beginning, reviewing contracts and following instructions. You’re there in the middle, ensuring that all the associated paperwork is completed efficiently and accurately. You’re working with agents and their clients to keep the process moving forward, verifying that titles are clean, taxes are paid, and loans are funded. Finally, you’re there at the end, to ensure that no funds or property will change hands until all terms have been carried to completion.

- Trusted consultant, maintaining a positive, can-do attitude that gives agents and home buyers alike the confidence that their transaction is in reliable, good hands and will be completed on time.

- Problem solver, using your industry knowledge to identify potential issues; recognizing what’s wrong, knowing how to fix it, and avoiding unnecessary delays.

- Constant learner, staying on top of changing rules and regulations to avoid setbacks and enable transactions to close on time.

- People reader, recognizing and adapting to an agent’s or homebuyer’s personality and mood to make them feel comfortable, even when delivering bad news; showing empathy to ease their frustration and give them confidence that you’re in their corner.

- Multi-tasker, highly organized, able to work a large number of contracts with numerous agents, buyers, and sellers simultaneously under deadline pressure

What You’ll Do Here:

- A to Z: Knowing the intricacies of the contract from beginning to end, ensuring that it is closed in a timely, efficient, and error-free manner.

- Devoted to detail: Verifying all paperwork is complete so that escrow closes on time and correctly.

- Following the money: Working with lenders and underwriters to ensure that all the I’s are dotted and T’s are crossed to fund and complete transactions.

- Relationship building: Establishing and maintaining relationships with essential industry players – agents, attorneys, lenders, surveyors, and government agencies – that enable you to smoothly manage transactions.

- Business builder: Earning the confidence and trust of new agents and creating opportunities to market our business; retaining agents by providing them with white-glove service.

- Talent builder: Training escrow assistants to open opportunities for advancement; delegating, auditing work, answering questions, and giving direction.

- Sealing the deal: Being present at closing and making it a positive, memorable experience for agents and buyers.

What You Bring:

- Education: High school diploma or equivalent; take continuing education courses as required.

- Experience: Two to three years of escrow experience, both front- and back-end experience.

- Certification: Notary public and escrow officer license as per state regulatory requirements (Eg, in Texas, candidates are required to satisfy the qualifications established by Texas Department of Insurance to hold an escrow officer license.

- Industry awareness: Technical knowledge of the closing process.

- Computer skills: Proficiency with the Microsoft Office suite.

- Communication skills: Strong written and verbal skills to keep agents, buyers, sellers, and all other parties up to date with the process and work with them to resolve issues.

- Adaptable to new workflows and procedures: As HomeLight expands its joint venture partnerships across Texas, this role will oversee escrow operations across multiple entities, ensuring exceptional service, operational excellence, and seamless closing experiences.

Benefits & Perks:

- Medical (Aetna or Kaiser), Dental & Vision (Guardian)

- Long-Term Disability & Short-Term Disability

- Hospital Indemnity Insurance, Accident Plan, and Employee Critical Illness (Guardian)

- 401k (Vestwell), Life Insurance (Guardian) & Pet Insurance (Nationwide)

- Commuter benefits are offered in certain locations

- PTO, including Volunteer Days to give back to your community

- Annual Anniversary Perks, including one month paid sabbaticals!

- HomeLight Services to help you with buying and selling your home

Let’s chat!

HomeLight is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce, providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, national, social or ethnic origin, sex (including pregnancy), age, physical, mental or sensory disability, HIV Status, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital, civil union or domestic partnership status, past or present military service, family medical history or genetic information, family or parental status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. We will provide accommodations during the recruitment process upon request, and any accommodation will be addressed confidentially.

jobs.title: Asset Resolution Specialist
jobs.summary: Kiavi is one of the nation’s largest private lenders to residential real estate investors (REIs).
jobs.description:
Kiavi is one of the nation’s largest private lenders to residential real estate investors (REIs). We harness the power of data & technology to offer our customers a simpler, more reliable, and faster way to access the capital they need to scale their businesses.

Formerly known as LendingHome, we’re committed to helping REIs revitalize the approximately $25 trillion worth of aged U.S. housing stock to provide move-in ready homes and rental housing for millions of Americans across the country.

Combining our technology and industry expertise, Kiavi has grown to a team of over 500 and has won many awards over the years including Forbes Fintech 50, Finovate Awards, Best Digital Mortgage Platform, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and many more.

- Loans Funded: $30 billion in loans funded

- Homes financed: 100,000+ projects funded for our customers across the country

- Geography: 49 states + D.C. where we lend to REIs so they can revitalize neighborhoods

- Employees: Over 500 employees with competitive benefits and perks

This position can be based remotely in any of our approved hiring regions. Our hybrid distributed workforce philosophy allows us to find the best talent in the country and build diverse teams, while allowing our colleagues to work from the location that works best for them.

Identity Verification Notice: To ensure the security and integrity of our hiring process, all candidates are required to complete a secure identity verification. This process uses biometric and device validation to confirm identity and liveness. All data is handled securely in accordance with our privacy policy.

The Role

The Kiavi Special Servicing Team is the primary point of contact for our customers after a loan is approved. Our goal is to provide the best mortgage experience for our customers and keep them coming back. As an Asset Resolution Specialist (ARS) with Kiavi you will be the point of contact for customers who need workout assistance on their loan(s). You’ll use strong negotiation and customer service skills to assist customers through workout plans to bring loans current and/or avoid default. You are also able to understand investor guidelines for mortgage modifications and explain these guidelines in a clear manner with customers.

Responsibilities

- The ARS manages a portfolio of loans in default and implements loss mitigation strategies, reviews and validates documents, and answers technical foreclosure questions from borrowers

- Analyzes work-out options based on financial impact for delinquent loans, including foreclosure, short sale, reinstatement, deed in lieu and delivers a proposal for the option that yields the best return for the investor

- Works closely with our investors to negotiate loss mitigation strategies

- Sets clear expectations with borrowers and other involved parties about loan status and communicating possible difficult decisions up to the final resolution

- Manage relationships with internal departments and with business partners

- Ensures all updates, analyses, and decisions are administered/tracked in the appropriate systems

- Generates ideas for improvement or increased efficiency and supports the implementation of new ideas and initiatives

- Responsible for periodic and ad-hoc reporting

Qualifications

- Minimum of 2 years of mortgage experience

- Bachelor’s degree

- Exemplary communication skills, both written and spoken

- Must have the ability to guide customers and investors through the retention and/or liquidation process and navigate on their behalf

- General knowledge about the entire loss mitigation process

- Self-starter with the ability to independently work a pipeline effectively

Kiavi takes a market-based approach to pay, and pay may vary depending on your location. The expected annualized base pay range for this full-time role to be performed remotely is $45,000 to $67,000 plus $6,000 bonus plus benefits. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries. Within the range, the successful candidate’s starting pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Your recruiter can share more about the specific base pay range for your preferred location during the hiring process. Please note that the pay range listed above reflects the base salary only, and does not include the target value of bonus or benefits.

Benefits and Perks

- Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance: Kiavi offers free employee-only coverage for medical, dental, and vision plans. Dependents receive a heavily discounted premium, competitively placed in the 90th percentile for cost.

- Health Savings Account (HSA): For those enrolled in a High Deductible Health Plan (HDHP), Kiavi provides an annual employer contribution to HSAs: $1,000 for individual coverage and $2,000 for dependents.

- Disability and Life Insurance: Immediate access to short-term and long-term disability insurance, as well as group life and AD&D insurance, with coverage at 1x annual salary.

- Remote Work Policy: Kiavi supports working remotely for day to day activities for most roles and occasionally may ask employees to gather in person for key meetings, training, team building etc. For remote workers, Kiavi offers a one-time office setup reimbursement of up to $500 and a monthly $85 stipend for internet and phone expenses. For in-office workers, Kiavi offers employer contributions to commuter benefits account, either for parking or public transportation.

- Flexible Time Off: Employees are empowered to manage their own time off, with no strict limits, as long as it's approved by their manager.

- Paid Leaves: Up to 8 weeks of paid leave for medical or caregiver purposes, and 12 weeks of paid maternity/paternity leave. Short-term disability leave is also available for birthing mothers.

- 401(k) & Company Match: A 401(k) plan managed by Fidelity, with Kiavi matching 100% of contributions up to 3% of compensation or $8,000 (whichever is less). All employer contributions are immediately vested.

Protect yourself from recruitment scams:

- If you are offered an interview or a role with Kiavi, this will be communicated with you through email, via an official email address ending in @kiavi.com or @lendinghome.com.

- You will never be asked for payments of any kind during the process.

- We also never communicate with candidates via Whatsapp at any point during the recruitment process.

- We won’t ask for personal information or data via text message. If you have any concerns regarding how genuine a text message is, please contact your recruiter.

- You can find our official Kiavi careers page here. We advise you to check that the page details and website addresses match if you have any concerns.

jobs.title: Analytics Engineer (LatAm)
jobs.summary: About Homeward Homeward takes the “what ifs” out of homebuying by creating financial products that give buyers and sellers certainty and convenience.
jobs.description:
About Homeward

Homeward takes the “what ifs” out of homebuying by creating financial products that give buyers and sellers certainty and convenience. We’re a fast-paced, remote-first real estate startup that partners with real estate agents to offer innovative products and services, helping clients buy with cash, sell with certainty, and time their move, regardless of the market.

Founder and CEO Tim Heyl, owner of one of the fastest-growing agent teams in the country, started Homeward in 2018 to fix the antiquated and broken real estate process. Today, we offer bundled cash offers, mortgage, and title services in 13 states, enabling buyers and sellers to move with certainty and convenience.

We’re a fully remote company with a diverse team spread across several countries - Grounded in three core values: The Golden Rule, One Team One Dream, and Calm Focus. Hear from our employees about what our values mean to them.

About The Opportunity

Homeward is looking for an Analytics Engineer to help build, strengthen, and scale the data foundation that powers decision-making across the business.

This role is ideal for someone who is a confident, self-sufficient data professional with deep experience in data modeling and a passion for turning complex data into reliable, usable products. You’ll own critical pieces of our data pipeline and architecture while partnering closely with analysts, technical teams, and business stakeholders to ensure our data is accurate, dependable, and easy to consume.

A major focus of this role will be data reliability and scalability. We need someone who can identify why pipelines and models are breaking, build solutions that address the root cause, and create an architecture that can scale as our business and use of AI evolve. Most importantly, you take ownership. When you see an opportunity to make our data infrastructure more reliable, scalable, or useful, you're motivated to figure out how to make it better.

You’ll have the opportunity to shape how Homeward structures, governs, and delivers data—enabling analysts, business users, applications, and AI-powered tools to work from consistent and trusted information.

NOTE: Due to current team needs, we are only accepting candidates based in Latin America. This is intended to be a long-term contract position. It is not eligible for U.S. visa sponsorship or relocation.

What You'll Do:

- Own the health and reliability of our data pipelines, proactively identifying issues and implementing durable solutions to prevent ingestion failures and downstream disruptions.

- Design, develop, test, and optimize scalable dimensional data models and data marts using dbt.

- Structure data models around abstract business definitions, creating a reliable connection between business logic and technical implementation.

- Help architect our data environment for AI-readiness, ensuring data is structured, documented, governed, and accessible in ways that support emerging AI use cases.

- Evaluate and implement tooling and validation processes to ensure dbt models and AI-enabled data workflows produce accurate and trustworthy outputs.

- Partner closely with Product and Technology teams on internal application and system changes, identifying upstream and downstream data dependencies and minimizing disruption.

- Partner with business stakeholders to understand analytical needs and translate them into scalable solutions within our analytics platform.

- Develop deep domain expertise across key areas of Homeward's business and serve as a technical point of contact for associated data models, metrics, and workflows.

- Establish monitoring, testing, documentation, and data-quality practices that improve confidence in our data.

- Identify opportunities to improve our overall data architecture and recommend practical solutions rather than waiting for requirements to be fully defined.

What You'll Bring:

- Strong experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, business intelligence, or a similar data-focused role.

- Advanced proficiency in SQL and dimensional data modeling, with demonstrated experience designing scalable analytical datasets.

- Hands-on experience building and maintaining production data models and semantic layers using dbt.

- Demonstrated experience owning or supporting data ingestion and transformation pipelines, including diagnosing failures and improving pipeline reliability.

- Experience designing data architecture that balances scalability, maintainability, usability, and business needs.

- Experience with AWS or a comparable cloud data environment.

- Experience with modern BI and analytics tools such as Looker, Hex, Tableau, or equivalent platforms.

- Working knowledge of Python and orchestration tools such as Airflow.

- Understanding of data governance principles, including metric definitions, data quality, documentation, lineage, and access.

- Familiarity with modern AI/LLM applications and AI-enabled data tooling, with an understanding of how data architecture needs to evolve to support AI use cases.

- Ability to translate business concepts and definitions into clear, maintainable technical models.

- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to independently investigate ambiguous or complex data issues.

- Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Compensation & Details:

- Contractor engagement

- Competitive hourly rate

- Computer reimbursement

- Fully remote, LatAM-based, meaningful overlap with U.S. Central Time business hours.

Value-Driven Employee Experience

THE GOLDEN RULE. It’s simple: Treat others the way we want to be treated. Whether we’re dealing with colleagues or customers, we don’t prioritize money or growth over people, and we practice empathy at every opportunity.

CALM FOCUS. We work in tech and build solutions for real estate. Both are fast-paced and stressful industries. But by focusing on the larger objective rather than rushing from one task to the next, we can create solutions our customers love.

ONE TEAM, ONE DREAM. Big problems require big solutions. We look at our customers’ experiences holistically and recognize that solving them requires collaboration across teams and our three affiliate companies — Homeward, Homeward Mortgage and Homeward Title.

jobs.description:
Since 2003, Entrata has evolved from a visionary, student-led startup into a global leader in AI-driven property management technology. Today, we power the industry's most essential operating system, serving owners and residents worldwide through a comprehensive suite of intelligent leasing, payment, and communication tools powered by cutting-edge AI. With a proven track record of sustained growth and a global team of more than 2,200 employees, we offer the rare combination of established stability and high-velocity innovation. Recognized by the Silicon Slopes Hall of Fame and the Utah Business Fast 50, Entrata fosters a culture of radical transparency and entrepreneurial energy. At Entrata, we create an environment where different perspectives are valued and respected. Those perspectives challenge assumptions, strengthen our decisions, and raise the bar as we reshape the global living experience through AI-powered solutions.

The Senior Director, Cyber Defense is responsible for Entrata’s information security defenses, cyber defense strategy, and incident response program. This role leads the capabilities required to detect, investigate, contain, and recover from security events across Entrata’s technology environment.
The Senior Director partners with leaders across Security, Technology, Engineering, Infrastructure, Product, Compliance, Legal, and Communications to strengthen Entrata’s security posture and operational resilience. This role establishes the processes, technology, communication channels, and cross-functional discipline necessary to respond effectively to cyber threats while ensuring appropriate coverage across regions and time zones.

-
Define and execute Entrata’s cyber defense strategy and multi-year operational roadmap aligned with enterprise risk. Serve as Incident Commander for significant security incidents—coordinating technical response, triage, containment, eradication, recovery, and business decisions.

-
Lead detection, alerting, and investigation across the technology stack. Create and maintain incident response playbooks, runbooks, severity levels, decision rights, regional time-zone handoffs, and escalation paths.

-
Serve as the frontline executive interface for enterprise clients during active incidents, delivering transparent technical briefings, root-cause analyses (RCAs), and post-incident remediation updates. Partner with Legal, Privacy, Communications, and Customer Success on crisis messaging.

-
Establish and present strategic cyber metrics, threat assessments, and operational maturity benchmarks to executive leadership, audit committees, and board stakeholders.

-
Drive continuous maturity across threat detection and response to align with enterprise compliance frameworks, regulatory standards, and third-party audit requirements while making timely, risk-based decisions in high-stress environments.

-
Proactively leverage approved GenAI tools to automate routine tasks while serving as the "Human-in-the-Loop" to audit outputs, maintain prompt competency, and enforce strict data governance and PII protection protocols.

- 10–15 years of progressive, relevant experience in cybersecurity, security operations (SOC), incident response, or cyber defense.

-
Proven track record leading enterprise security operations, incident response, or cyber defense programs.

-
Expert-level incident command and incident response skills in high-stakes environments.

-
Demonstrated experience in direct, customer-facing executive engagement and client briefings during high-severity incidents.

-
Demonstrated background building or maturing SOC/IR organizations within enterprise environments subject to rigorous audit, compliance, and governance controls.

-
Deep, comprehensive understanding of information security principles, threat vectors, controls, technologies, and operating models.

-
Exceptional executive-level communication, crisis management, workload prioritization, and decision-making capabilities under pressure.

- Active executive security credentials such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, or GIAC (GCIH, GCFA).

-
Experience leading cyber defense and incident command within multi-tenant, cloud-native SaaS platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).

-
Hands-on leadership implementing security automation (SOAR), modern SIEM/XDR analytics, threat intelligence, and proactive threat hunting programs (e.g., MITRE ATT&CK framework).

-
In-depth familiarity with SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, FedRAMP, GDPR, and CCPA regulatory environments.

-
Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

-
AI Integration: Proactively leverages company-approved GenAI tools to automate routine tasks and accelerate high-value deliverables.

-
Strategic Oversight: Functions as the "Human-in-the-Loop," taking full accountability for auditing AI outputs for factual accuracy, brand alignment, and the removal of hallucinations.

-
Data Governance: Adheres strictly to AI security protocols, ensuring no proprietary or Personally Identifiable Information (PII) data is exposed to unauthorized models.

-
Prompt Competency: Demonstrates the ability to craft clear, context-rich prompts to achieve consistent, high-quality results across various business domains.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.summary: At Digible, we take pride in our collaborative, transparent, and authentic culture.
jobs.description:
At Digible, we take pride in our collaborative, transparent, and authentic culture. Since 2021, we've been recognized as a Top Workplace in Colorado and secured the #8 spot in the Best Places to Work Multifamily rankings. From our hiring process to our All Hands meetings and Town Halls, our values are at the core of everything we do.

Digible is a privately owned and operated digital marketing company founded in 2017 with a mission to bring cutting-edge solutions to the multifamily industry. We offer a full suite of digital services, alongside Fiona, our predictive analytics platform—the first of its kind.

We believe diversity fuels innovation, and we strive to create an inclusive environment where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work. If you're ready to do the best work of your career, we'd love to have you on the team!

Core Values

- Authenticity — The commitment to be steadfast and genuine with our actions and communication toward everyone we touch.

- Curiosity — The belief that a deep and fundamental curiosity (the "why") in our work is vital to company innovation and evolution.

- Focus — The collective will to remain completely devoted and ultimately accountable to our deliverables.

- Humility — The recognition and daily practice that "we" is always greater than "I".

- Happiness — The decision to prioritize passion and love for what we do above everything else.

The Role

Digible is hiring a Senior Product Manager to take full ownership of one of our product pods. The pod is relatively new, and while it has a clear mandate and a prioritized roadmap, its long-term strategy and roadmap still need to be sharpened. That's the job: make this pod's direction unmistakable and then deliver on it.

You won't be starting from zero: there's already a prioritized roadmap ready for you to execute on, so you can ship meaningful work right away. Once you've ramped, we expect you to make that roadmap your own, evolving it through your own discovery and judgment rather than just executing on existing plans. Throughout, you'll partner deeply with our agency leaders (your day-one allies and internal customers) to decide what gets solved by people, product, or automation. You'll ship experiences that make Digible dramatically more efficient internally and noticeably better to buy from and work with externally.

Like every pod, this one will also have new technology product opportunities to explore. You'll help find, validate, and shape them alongside the rest of the roadmap.

Your customers include the agency teams who deliver the work our clients hire Digible to do. You'll spend real time with them, learning how they serve clients day to day, where their hours actually go, and where the process is manual, inconsistent, or falls short of what clients need. From that understanding you'll build the strategy and plan for a mix of deterministic automation and AI-driven innovation that takes mindless manual work off their plates, frees them to be more strategic with clients, and helps Digible capture more of the value it creates. We want you to be creative here and think AI-native by default: not bolting AI onto today's process, but rethinking how the work should get done when AI is in the loop from the start. You'll also run customer discovery and research, build real relationships with customers and stakeholders, and set and communicate strategy clearly enough to bring the company with you. The work spans internal workflow products and the customer-facing experiences they power, and a good amount of it is technical. As a senior member of the team, you'll help lead AI transformation across product, design, and engineering. You'll report to a Group Product Manager.

We're a small product org inside a profitable, bootstrapped company — nine years successful before the recent AI wave, and now in the middle of an AI transformation, reinventing how an established company operates and thrives in the AI era. Profitability and bootstrapping mean you'll work on real customer and business problems, not a search for product/market fit, with a direct line to an accessible leadership team. You'll use AI throughout your workflow to move faster and more effectively than a team our size normally could.

You'll Love This Job If You Love:

Products with…

- 🔁 Workflow Products: turning how the work gets done today into products and automations that make it faster, smarter, and more consistent

- 🏢 Two Sets of Customers: internal agency teams and the clients they serve — you'll build for both

- ✨ AI: deciding what gets solved by people, product, or automation — and using AI to shift that line

Roles with…

- 🧭 Full Pod Ownership: taking over a relatively new pod, sharpening its long-term strategy and roadmap, and making it fully your own

- 🔭 New Bets: exploring new technology product opportunities and shaping what we build next

Organizations with…

- 🚀 Small Teams: working with small teams that trade scale for agility & autonomy

- 🏗️ Early Foundations: crafting the systems, rituals, and mindsets of a relatively new product org

Cultures with…

- 📅 4-day Workweek: we work Mon–Thu, so every weekend is a long weekend

- ⚖️ Modeled Balance: we know work is a part of life — boundaries are modeled by leadership

Businesses with…

- 📈 Fast Growth: this isn't a turnaround — 371% three-year growth per the 2025 Inc. 5000 (No. 1,165)

- 🥾 Bootstrapped Profitability: we control our own destiny, with no investor or burn pressure

What You'll Do:

- 💡 Customer Discovery & Research: run real discovery with customers, agency teams, and the market, and keep making time for it even when the roadmap is loud — understand how the work gets done and what clients need deeply enough to know which problems are worth solving

- 🧭 Pod Strategy & Roadmap: execute on a prioritized starting roadmap from day one, then clarify your pod's long-term strategy from the VP-level product vision and strategy (and influence both) and own the roadmap and execution from there

- 🛠️ Workflow Productization: lead discovery and delivery of the workflow products and automations, deterministic and AI-driven, that change how our agency teams work and what they can do for clients

- 🔭 New Product Exploration: explore and validate new technology product opportunities for Digible, from customer and market discovery to a clear case for what's worth building

Must Have

jobs.title: Group Product Manager
jobs.summary: Digible is a privately owned and operated digital marketing company founded in 2017 with a mission to bring cutting-edge solutions to the multifamily industry.
jobs.description:
Digible is a privately owned and operated digital marketing company founded in 2017 with a mission to bring cutting-edge solutions to the multifamily industry. We offer a full suite of digital services, alongside Fiona, our predictive analytics platform—the first of its kind.

At Digible, we take pride in our collaborative, transparent, and authentic culture. Since 2021, we've been recognized as a Top Workplace in Colorado and secured the #8 spot in the Best Places to Work Multifamily rankings. From our hiring process to our All Hands meetings and Town Halls, our values are at the core of everything we do.

We believe diversity fuels innovation, and we strive to create an inclusive environment where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work. If you're ready to do the best work of your career, we'd love to have you on the team!

Core Values

- Authenticity — The commitment to be steadfast and genuine with our actions and communication toward everyone we touch.

- Curiosity — The belief that a deep and fundamental curiosity (the "why") in our work is vital to company innovation and evolution.

- Focus — The collective will to remain completely devoted and ultimately accountable to our deliverables.

- Humility — The recognition and daily practice that "we" is always greater than "I".

- Happiness — The decision to prioritize passion and love for what we do above everything else.

The Role

Digible is hiring a Group Product Manager who is both a hands-on product manager and an experienced people leader. Your primary responsibility is being the product manager for your own pod, and showing business results for that pod's area of responsibility is your top priority. In addition, you directly manage and coach two experienced Product Managers who each run their own pod. You and your two PMs work as a unit to identify overlaps and opportunities across pods, and you resolve them strategically and proactively in your respective product strategies and roadmaps rather than letting them surface as conflicts in delivery.

In your own pod, you'll work on integrations, customer data architecture, core platform, and workflow productization, and you should be excited by exactly that kind of work. You'll also work on some customer-facing experiences and run customer discovery and research, build real relationships with customers and stakeholders, and set and communicate strategy clearly enough to bring the company with you.

As a senior member of the team, you'll help lead AI transformation across product, design, and engineering, and you'll help shape how product management is practiced at Digible (AI-native, problem-first, customer-obsessed) through your own example and your coaching. You'll report to the VP of Product.

We're a small product org inside a profitable, bootstrapped company — nine years successful before the recent AI wave, and now in the middle of an AI transformation, reinventing how an established company operates and thrives in the AI era. Profitability and bootstrapping mean you'll work on real customer and business problems, not a search for product/market fit, with a direct line to an accessible leadership team. You'll use AI throughout your workflow to move faster and more effectively than a team our size normally could.

You'll Love This Job If You Love:

Products with…

- 🧵 Connective Tissue: unifying fragmented tools, data, and services into one coherent experience for our agency teams and our customers

- 🏢 Two Sets of Customers: internal agency teams and external customers — you'll build for both

- 🧩 Portfolio Coherence: strategy that makes a group of pods add up to one story, not a collection of roadmaps

- ✨ AI: deciding what gets solved by people, product, or automation, and raising the AI-native bar for every pod in your group, not just your own

Roles with…

- ⚖️ IC + Manager Hybrid: owning your own pod's results while managing and coaching two experienced PMs who own theirs

- 🌱 Multiplier Impact: a great week includes your PMs' wins, not just your own

- 🔭 New Bets: exploring new technology product opportunities and shaping what we build next

Organizations with…

- 🚀 Small Teams: working with small teams that trade scale for agility & autonomy

- 🏗️ Early Foundations: crafting the systems, rituals, and mindsets of a relatively new product org

Cultures with…

- 📅 4-day Workweek: we work Mon–Thu, so every weekend is a long weekend

- ⚖️ Modeled Balance: we know work is a part of life — boundaries are modeled by leadership

Businesses with…

- 📈 Fast Growth: this isn't a turnaround — 371% three-year growth per the 2025 Inc. 5000 (No. 1,165)

- 🥾 Bootstrapped Profitability: we control our own destiny, with no investor or burn pressure

What You'll Do:

- 🛠️ Own Your Pod: run your own pod end-to-end as its product manager: discovery, strategy, roadmap, delivery, and business results, problem-first every time. This is the biggest part of the job

- 💡 Customer Discovery & Research: run real discovery with customers, agency teams, and the market, and keep customer conversations on your calendar no matter the load

- 🧱 Foundational Platform Work: lead discovery and delivery of integrations, customer data architecture, core platform, and workflow productization, plus the customer-facing experiences they power

- 👥 Manage & Grow Two PMs: own the performance and career growth of two experienced Product Managers through 1:1s, goals, coaching, and craft feedback that makes their work visibly better

- 🧭 Cross-Pod Strategy: with your PMs, spot the overlaps and opportunities across pods early and resolve them in your respective strategies and roadmaps, so the group adds up to one story with no seams

- 🤝 Stakeholder Partnership: align pod teams, leadership, agency partners, and customers around the group's strategy; stakeholders are customers and partners, not requesters

- 🏁 End-to-End Delivery: ship the full experience, customer-facing and internal, including enablement and change management

- 📏 Measure Impact: define success metrics at both pod and group level, and get creative or technical when the data is hard to come by

- 🤖 AI Transformation: help lead AI transformation across product, design, and engineering, and set the AI-native bar for how your PMs work

- 🧠 Product Taste: set the bar for what deserves to ship across the group, balancing creative instinct with data and business goals

- 📡 Industry Trends: stay ahead of AI and product trends and bring what matters into the group's work

How Success Will Be Measured:

Business Metrics

- $ Pod Business Impact: measurable operational efficiency and revenue outcomes from your own pod. This comes first

- $ Group Business Impact: measurable revenue and efficiency outcomes across your group's pods, with overlaps resolved rather than duplicated

Product Metrics

- Adoption & CSAT: internal teams and customers actually run on, trust, and prefer what your pods ship

- Delivery Predictability: the group ships what it commits to, quarter after quarter

People Metrics

- PM Performance & Growth: your Product Managers' performance, development, engagement, and career trajectory

What You Should Have:

Must Have

- 7+ years of product management experience, including senior-level ownership of a pod or domain with measurable business impact

- 2+ years of AI product experience

- 2+ years of formal people-management experience managing experienced product managers, with accountability for their performance, growth, and career development

- Still excellent, and happy, doing hands-on PM work as the biggest part of your job; you want an IC and manager hybrid role by choice

- Technical depth to work on integrations, customer data architecture, core platform, and workflow productization, and genuine excitement for that type of work

- Customer discovery and research fluency: you talk to customers directly, and your product decisions trace back to what you learned

- Strategic and communication range: you can set a strategy, make the case for it, and keep executives, agency leaders, engineers, and your own PMs moving in the same direction

- Track record of aligning multiple teams or product areas around one product story, and of spotting and resolving overlap across them

Preferred

- Small start-up (<150 people) experience

- Experience productizing internal operations or building workflow/integration products

- Tech-enabled services or hybrid product-service business experience

Bonus

- Digital marketing domain knowledge (strategy, metrics, and technology)

- Real estate domain knowledge (ex: rentals, multifamily, single family, etc.)

Pay, Perks and More!

- $170,000 - $200,000 annually

- 4-Day Work Week (32 Hour Work Week)

- WFA (Work From Anywhere)

- Discretionary Bonus

- We offer 3 weeks of PTO as well as Sick leave, and Bereavement.

- We offer 11 paid holidays!

- 401(k) + Match

- 75% Employer Paid Health Benefits (Medical, Dental, and Vision)

- Mental and Physical Wellness Reimbursement Benefit

- $1000/year travel fund for employees who have been with Digible 3+ years

- Financial wellness coaching for all team members!

- Weekly lunches and snacks for in office employees!

- Dog-Friendly Office

- Paid Parental Leave

- Monthly Social Events

HEADS UP! We believe in transparency throughout our hiring process. To help us ensure a great fit, we'll ask you to share a few professional references during the hiring process who can speak to your experience and skills. It’s all part of our commitment to open, honest communication and our core values: Focus, Authenticity, Humility, Curiosity, and Happiness.

jobs.description:
Since 2003, Entrata has evolved from a visionary, student-led startup into a global leader in AI-driven property management technology. Today, we power the industry's most essential operating system, serving owners and residents worldwide through a comprehensive suite of intelligent leasing, payment, and communication tools powered by cutting-edge AI. With a proven track record of sustained growth and a global team of more than 2,200 employees, we offer the rare combination of established stability and high-velocity innovation. Recognized by the Silicon Slopes Hall of Fame and the Utah Business Fast 50, Entrata fosters a culture of radical transparency and entrepreneurial energy. At Entrata, we create an environment where different perspectives are valued and respected. Those perspectives challenge assumptions, strengthen our decisions, and raise the bar as we reshape the global living experience through AI-powered solutions.

The Regional Vice President is responsible for being a subject matter expert in AI, driving strategic growth and revenue expansion within assigned enterprise accounts. This role manages high-value client relationships, identifies new business opportunities, and collaborates cross-functionally to deliver tailored solutions that meet client and company objectives. The position requires advanced knowledge of enterprise sales, account management, and strategic planning, with a focus on achieving sustained revenue growth and client satisfaction.

-
Develops and executes strategic account plans to achieve annual growth targets and multi-year revenue objectives.

-
Builds and maintains trusted, long-term client relationships across multiple organizational levels.

-
Identifies and develops cross-functional product and service expansion opportunities within assigned accounts.

-
Collaborates with internal stakeholders to align sales strategy with company goals, ensuring operational excellence and client satisfaction.

-
Analyzes market trends, client performance metrics, and emerging opportunities to guide decision-making and business planning.

-
Represents the company at client-hosted events, conferences, and industry functions to strengthen partnerships and identify growth potential.

-
Provides senior-level insights to leadership regarding account strategy, client needs, and potential risks.

-
Establishes and maintains executive-level client relationships that drive long-term account growth.

-
Develops and executes strategic account plans aligned with company objectives.

-
Analyzes financial and operational data to identify trends and guide revenue strategy.

-
Leads cross-functional collaboration to deliver client solutions and achieve business results.

-
Travels domestically for client meetings, industry events, and company gatherings as required to maintain business relationships and achieve objectives.

-
Ability to prioritize tasks effectively by meeting deadlines and managing workload efficiently.

-
Maintain professional interaction with internal and external stakeholders

-
Ability to work in a fast-paced and high-stress environment

-
Advanced understanding of enterprise technology sales and strategic account management practices with AI.

-
Proven ability to manage complex client relationships and negotiate high-value contracts.

-
Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills with the ability to interpret business data and market dynamics.

-
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present to senior leadership and client executives.

-
Demonstrated ability to operate independently with sound judgment and accountability for results.

-
Skilled in building consensus and driving alignment across departments and stakeholder groups.

-
Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred.

-
Typically requires a minimum of 8 years of related experience in enterprise sales, strategic account management, or business development; or 6 years with a Master’s degree; or equivalent experience.

-
AI Integration: Utilize company-approved GenAI tools to accelerate high-value deliverables.

-
Strategic Oversight: Exercise critical judgment as the "Human-in-the-Loop," by auditing AI outputs for factual accuracy, brand alignment, and the removal of hallucinations.

-
Data Governance: Ensures no proprietary or Personally Identifiable Information (PII) data is exposed to unauthorized models.

-
Prompt Competency: Demonstrates the ability to craft clear, context-rich prompts to achieve consistent, high-quality results across various business domains.

Work is primarily performed in an office or home office environment with frequent use of standard office equipment and computers. The role requires the ability to operate a keyboard, telephone, and other office devices for extended periods. Work is generally sedentary and involves repetitive motions of the wrists, hands, and fingers. The position requires close visual acuity for activities such as reviewing and analyzing data, reading reports, and working at a computer for extended periods. Periodic travel is required, which may involve prolonged standing, walking through client sites or event venues, and occasional lifting or carrying of materials related to business travel or client meetings.
