All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability age or protected veteran status. Entrata will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

jobs.title: Claims Adjuster (Remote Contract)
jobs.summary: Location: Remote Employment Type: Contract Steadily is hiring a contracting Claims Adjuster who is the very best at what they do.
jobs.description:
Location: Remote
Employment Type: Contract

Steadily is hiring a contracting Claims Adjuster who is the very best at what they do. You’ll be (virtually) surrounded by team members who are the best at what they do, which will just make you even better. You’ll be responsible for guiding our customers through the claims process with empathy, accuracy, and speed, making sure we create a fast, easy, and effortless experience.

What You’ll Do
- Steady opportunities: adjust assigned desk claim files through resolution in accordance with applicable claims-handling regulations and program guidelines, bringing your expertise to deliver a great experience for the customer.

- Request appraisals, estimates, cause & origin reports, and various other reports to assist in the investigation of the claim

- Communicate with customers using their preferred channel of communication (phone, text, email, mail)

- Review estimates and reports and issue payments as owed under the policy contract

- Adjust claim files with extremely high quality, exceeding the expectations of internal/external auditor security, including ample documentation, regular diary entries, and quality application of coverage and compliance with all claims related laws and regulations

- Write exterior estimates with high level of accuracy and attention to detail

What We're Looking For
- Experience: You must possess at least 2 years experience adjusting P&C Insurance claims. You must possess an adjuster license. You’re a property claims savant. Experience in homeowners, condo, or landlord insurance is required. Xactimate experience preferred.

- Nice to Have: You are also knowledgeable on 3rd party claims and 1st party litigation. AIC and/or ARM is a plus.

- Communication: You possess superior verbal and written communication skills. You can communicate concisely and diplomatically, maintaining a calm demeanor and professional communication.

- Insurance: Extensive knowledge of standard claims practices, estimating, claims processes, coverage application, subrogation, SIU and everything in between. Bonus if you have experience in subrogation, fraud investigation, or property damage estimating.

- Digital: You have above average computer skills. You’re great at independently learning new software quickly and are savvy using online resources.

- Self-Driven: You thrive under intense pressure and can manage a large workload with minimal oversight. There is no task too small or beneath you; “that’s not my job” is not in your mantra.

- Hungry: You want to roll up your sleeves and hustle – you are not looking for a traditional 9-5 job.

Compensation and Benefits
- Competitive pay per claim handled

- Set your own hours and methods, subject to regulatory and carrier timeline standards

- This position will start in 4Q 2026 and will last til approximately January 2027, with possible extensions upon mutual agreement

Independent contractor engagement (1099). This is not an employment position. Contractors are not eligible for Steadily employee benefits, and no conversion to employment is implied.

jobs.title: Product Manager II (Technical)
jobs.summary: Product Manager II (Energy Management & Home Automation) Alarm.com is the leading cloud-based platform for smart security and IoT.
jobs.description:
Product Manager II (Energy Management & Home Automation)

Alarm.com is the leading cloud-based platform for smart security and IoT. Our meaningful work gives property and business owners peace of mind, helps them conserve energy and water, and keeps them connected to loved ones and their businesses.

Do you excel when you are in the middle of a challenging project? Thrive when things get complex? If you are someone who wants to work on interesting technologies and develop award-winning consumer products while working with smart and collaborative team members, Alarm.com is for you!

Very few companies allow you to work across as broad a range of technologies as Alarm.com. As a member of the Energy Management and Home Automation team, you’ll work to create new user experiences for homeowners and professional installers across iOS, Android, and web. You’ll also get hands-on with technology tied to those UI/UX flows including ultra-low power and long-range IoT RF, edge computing, market-leading automation protocols, and machine learning-driven big data analytics.

On top of that, Alarm.com offers a friendly culture with smart and productive co-workers who are committed to delivering an outstanding experience.

Responsibilities

As a Product Manager II, you will:

- Be the go-to subject-matter expert for your product areas. Have extensive knowledge of how our dealers and their customers use our products based on first-hand experience installing, troubleshooting, and using them.

- Manage a variety of stakeholders both internally and externally, ensuring their needs are met despite competing demands on team resources.

- Utilize clear analytical thinking and communication that aligns project teams on the most critical next steps at each point in a product’s lifecycle.

- Motivate teams to deliver their best work and release products with minimal timeline slip while maintaining an unwavering commitment to delivering an excellent customer experience.

- Do whatever is needed to drive product support across its life cycle. This includes writing product specifications, testing new features, soliciting customer and dealer feedback, creating documentation including marketing materials, overseeing quality assurance efforts, and supporting existing products.

- Disseminate information based on a detailed understanding of how our home automation functionality works. This includes low-level firmware operation, cloud-based data aggregation, and information distribution to user interfaces and third parties.

- Ensure revenue, customer satisfaction, and adoption goals are met for your projects.

- Work with engineering, support, sales, business intelligence, and high-profile partners to resolve product issues.

- Plan the go-to-market strategy for new products – collaborate with engineering, sales, supply chain, data science, and other teams. Educate stakeholders and deliver product presentations.

- Conduct market research and outline proposals for delivering new product lines.

- Develop and maintain strong relationships with Alarm.com’s technology partners, all while identifying new players for our team to partner with that add value to our platform while minimizing additional overhead.

- Champion enhancements to existing products that drive enduring platform value.

- Other duties as assigned.

Requirements

- 1-4 years in product management with a track record of managing and launching successful products.

- Strong academic performance with a B.E., B.S., BA, or other more advanced degree.

- Grit and the will to dig in and persevere in the pursuit of long-term goals.

- Strong quantitative, analytical, and critical thinking abilities.

- Proven ability to successfully lead multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

- Excellent written and oral communication skills featuring attention to detail without losing sight of overarching objectives and what’s truly important.

- Passion for consumer technology and interest in developing a deep understanding of complex products and technologies.

- Effective computer skills (e.g., Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, as well as at least a basic understanding of how to use AI and a strong desire to learn more).

- General knowledge of business, economics, and/or finance.

Experience in the following areas is a plus:

- Electrical engineering, computer programming, computer networking

- Agentic development

- Math and statistics

- RF technologies, cellular/wireless technology, and smart home automation

- User interface design

- JIRA and Confluence

- Web/mobile development

- Customer service

- Home security systems

Please note that sponsorship of new applicants for employment authorization, or any other immigration-related support, is not available for this position at this time.

WHY WORK FOR ALARM.COM?

- Collaborate with outstanding people: We hire only the best. Our standards are high and our employees enjoy working alongside other high achievers.

- Make an immediate impact: New employees can expect to be given real responsibility for bringing new technologies to the marketplace. You are empowered to perform as soon as you join the Alarm.com team!

- Gain well rounded experience: Alarm.com offers a diverse and dynamic environment where you will get the chance to work directly with executives and develop expertise across multiple areas of the business.

- Community and Camaraderie: One of our core values is to 'Keep It Fun,' which to us means fostering a strong sense of community. Our culture is built on collaboration and connection, where we celebrate our successes and believe that a positive, engaging environment is key to doing our best work.

- Alarm.com values working together and collaborating in person. Our employees work from the office 4 days a week.

COMPANY INFO

Alarm.com is the leading platform for intelligently connected properties. Millions of homeowners and businesses rely on Alarm.com's technology to secure, monitor, and manage their environments from anywhere. Our comprehensive suite of solutions—including security, video surveillance, access control, active shooter detection, intelligent automation, energy management, and wellness—is delivered exclusively through a trusted network of thousands of professional service providers and commercial integrators across North America and worldwide. Alarm.com's common stock is traded on Nasdaq under the ticker symbol ALRM. Alarm.com delivers serious security for serious people.

For more information, please visit www.alarm.com.

COMPANY BENEFITS

Our total rewards package is designed to support you holistically—in your health, your finances, and your life outside of work. The package includes medical plans with company subsidies, a Health Savings Account (HSA) with a company contribution, and a 401(k) with an employer match. We encourage a healthy work-life balance with paid vacation that increases with tenure, paid holidays, wellness time, and paid maternity and bonding leave. To complete the package, we also provide company-paid disability and life insurance, all within a collaborative and casual work environment.

Alarm.com is an Equal Opportunity Employer

In connection with your application, we collect information that identifies, reasonably relates to or describes you ("Personal Information"). The categories of Personal Information that we may collect include your name, government-issued identification number(s), email address, mailing address, other contact information, emergency contact information, employment history, educational history, criminal record, and demographic information. We collect and use those categories of Personal Information about you for human resources and other business management purposes, including identifying and evaluating you as a candidate for potential or future employment or future positions, recordkeeping in relation to recruiting and hiring, conducting criminal background checks as permitted by law, conducting analytics, and ensuring compliance with applicable legal requirements and Company policies. By submitting your application, you acknowledge that we may retain some of the personal data that you provide in your application for our internal operations such as managing our recruitment system and ensuring that we comply with labor laws and regulations even after we have made our employment decision.

Notice To Third Party Agencies:
Alarm.com understands the value of professional recruiting services. However, we are not accepting resumes from recruiters or employment agencies for this position. In the event we receive a resume or candidate referral for this position from a third-party recruiter or agency without a previously signed agreement, we reserve the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to you. If you are interested in working with Alarm.com, please email your company information and standard agreement to RecruitingPartnerships@Alarm.com.
The base salary range of this opportunity is listed below and is determined within a range based on factors including qualifications, location and experience. This allows opportunity for growth and development within the role. The base salary offered is part of a total compensation package.

Base Salary Range
$110,000—$125,000 USD

jobs.description:
Why Better. Why Now.
Better is rebuilding home finance as an AI-native platform—turning a process that once took weeks into something that can happen in seconds.

With over $110B in loans funded and $1.2B+ raised, we operate at real scale while rethinking how homeownership works from the ground up.

The category hasn’t caught up yet. That’s the opportunity.
Role Summary
We are looking for a Senior IAM Engineer to own and advance our identity and access management program. You will be the subject matter expert for Okta and the broader IAM ecosystem at Better — administering the platform end to end, integrating it with the systems our teams rely on every day, and partnering closely with Security to ensure our access controls are strong, scalable, and easy to use. You will lead lifecycle automation, harden application integrations, and serve as the senior escalation point for complex identity issues. This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who enjoys solving complex identity problems and continuously improving the experience for the business.
Key Responsibilities
• Administer Okta end to end, including users, groups, applications, authentication policies, sign-on rules, network zones, and Okta Workflows across the full product suite.
• Configure and support Okta authentication and access standards, including OAuth/OIDC, SAML, SCIM, Okta FastPass, Device Trust, device-bound SSO, and Device Access.
• Integrate and manage third-party SaaS applications in Okta, including SSO setup, SCIM-based provisioning and de-provisioning, group push, and role mapping.
• Own Okta's integrations with core enterprise systems, including Microsoft (Entra ID / Active Directory) and Workday as the HR system of record driving joiner, mover, and leaver events.
• Design and operate the joiner/mover/leaver lifecycle, ensuring timely, accurate, and auditable provisioning and de-provisioning across all in-scope applications.
• Ensure application integrations meet security best practices, including least-privilege access, MFA enforcement, strong authentication policies, and well-structured group and role design.
• Partner with the Security team to design and implement Okta and application-level security controls, policies, and risk-based / adaptive access rules.
• Support audit, compliance, and access certification activities (e.g., SOX, SOC 2) with reporting, evidence collection, and periodic access reviews.
• Build and maintain Okta Workflows and other automations to streamline identity processes such as onboarding, offboarding, group membership, and access reviews.
• Provide tier 2 and tier 3 support for IAM-related issues, including triage, root-cause analysis, and remediation, and serve as the escalation point for the helpdesk.
• Document configurations, runbooks, and processes to support team continuity, onboarding, and audit readiness.
Qualifications
• 5+ years of experience in an Identity and Access Management, IT security, or systems engineering role.
• Hands-on experience administering Okta in production across the full product suite, including users, groups, applications, authentication policies, and Okta Workflows.
• Deep working knowledge of identity standards and Okta features, including OAuth/OIDC, SAML, SCIM, Okta FastPass, Device Trust, device-bound SSO, and Device Access.
• Proven experience integrating third-party SaaS applications with Okta, including SSO and SCIM provisioning.
• Experience integrating Okta with Microsoft (Entra ID / Active Directory).
• Experience integrating Okta with Workday as the HR system of record driving lifecycle events.
• Experience designing and operating joiner/mover/leaver lifecycle processes at scale.
• Experience partnering with Security teams to implement IAM controls, policies, and best practices for application integrations and access design.
• Experience providing tier 2 and tier 3 end-user support for identity-related issues.
• Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with a structured, root-cause-driven approach.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work directly with business, IT, and security stakeholders.
Nice to Have
• Okta Certified Administrator, Okta Certified Consultant, or Okta Certified Master.
• Experience building AI agents to assist with Okta and IAM management — for example, automating joiner/mover/leaver tasks, triaging access requests, running access reviews, surfacing anomalous sign-in or policy events, and providing self-service support through Slack or other channels.
• Experience scripting and integrating with REST APIs (e.g., Python, JavaScript) to extend Okta and IAM workflows.
• Experience with privileged access management (PAM) tools (e.g., CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Delinea, Keeper).
• Experience supporting IAM in regulated environments (e.g., SOX, SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI).
• Familiarity with Zero Trust principles and conditional/adaptive access design.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.summary: Our Mission ButterflyMX is on a mission to empower people to automate property access, operations, and security from a single platform.
jobs.description:
Our Mission
ButterflyMX is on a mission to empower people to automate property access, operations, and security from a single platform. Our products are installed in more than 20,000+ multifamily, commercial, gated communities, and student-housing properties worldwide, including properties developed, owned, and managed by the most trusted names in real estate. Our features are designed for developers, owners, property managers, and tenants and our products lower operating costs and improve tenant satisfaction.
 
Our Solution
Developers and owners no longer need to run building wiring or install in-unit hardware. Property managers can grant building access, revoke permissions, and review entry logs from an online dashboard. Residents can open doors from their smartphones, issue visitor access, and see who is trying to enter the building.
 
Our Culture & Values
Fantastic people are the key to our success. As a distributed, primarily remote workforce, we’re looking for more intelligent, passionate, collaborative, ai-forward, and down-to-earth individuals to join our growing team. We’re driven by a shared commitment to excellence and innovation, grounded in our core values: We delight our customers, We take ownership, We are a community of collaborators, We speak up, We think big and do small, and We are tenacious.
 
Role Overview
We are looking for a stellar Mechanical Engineer to design, develop and support the physical and mechanical aspects of our current and future hardware products. You will be working collaboratively as part of a high-performance hardware development team on-site at our Hardware Engineering lab in Southern California, providing knowledge, expertise and design engineering of mechanical, physical, and thermal solutions. This role will report to the SVP Hardware and be accountable for leading and owning all mechanical, physical, and thermal aspects of our products from requirements and concept development through design review, vendor engagement, release, validation, and production support.

Responsibilities
- Own the mechanical design of ButterflyMX products from requirements through production, including enclosures, molded plastic and metal components, mounting systems, and supporting mechanical structures.

- Translate product requirements, customer needs, and industrial design intent into robust mechanical solutions that meet functional, aesthetic, reliability, durability, cost, and manufacturability requirements.

- Rapidly develop, prototype, test, and iterate mechanical concepts using 3D printing, CNC machining, soft tooling, and other fabrication methods to resolve electromechanical challenges quickly.

- Design products for real-world and extreme conditions, including temperature, impact, vibration, moisture, and other environmental stresses; use FEA, structural analysis, and physical testing as appropriate to validate designs.

- Lead mechanical design reviews before releasing designs or significant changes to manufacturers; clearly communicate design intent, rationale, tradeoffs, risks, and open issues and incorporate stakeholder feedback before release.

- Collaborate closely with product, industrial design, electrical, firmware, quality, supply chain, and manufacturing teams to resolve conflicting inputs and drive alignment on an integrated product design.

- Proactively identify and communicate design risks, technical uncertainties, and capability gaps; develop validation, mitigation, and contingency plans when material risks remain.

- Identify, qualify, and work directly with manufacturing partners to resolve DFM, DFA, DFS, tooling, tolerance, cosmetic, material, process, and quality issues with minimal avoidable rework or schedule delay.

- Participate actively and professionally in internal and external meetings and collaborative problem-solving sessions, bringing clear mechanical engineering perspectives, decisions, and subject-matter leadership.

- Drive innovation by evaluating new materials, coatings, manufacturing techniques, and design approaches that improve product performance, aesthetics, installation, serviceability, robustness, or cost.

- Challenge assumptions and simplify designs wherever practical, reducing mechanical complexity and cost without compromising product quality, reliability, or user experience.

jobs.summary: Senior Product Manager, Commercial Video IoT Devices The Role Alarm.com is looking for a senior product manager to lead development of key commercial video hardware products, start…
jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager, Commercial Video IoT Devices

The Role

Alarm.com is looking for a senior product manager to lead development of key commercial video hardware products, starting with our PoE camera line. This is a hands-on product role for someone who can operate at both the architecture level and the last-10%-of-the-product level.

You will own products across hardware, firmware, and software over their full lifecycle. That means working with ODM partners on platform and component choices, making product and specification tradeoffs, pressure-testing real-world installation workflows, and driving the software and firmware work needed to deliver a complete product experience.

Day to day, this role can range from reviewing chipset options with a hardware partner, to tearing down a prototype to evaluate a mechanical constraint, to prioritizing launch-critical software issues with engineering. You should care as much about system architecture as you do about the details that determine whether a product actually feels finished in the field: accessory quality, LED behavior, cable routing, installation flow, and overall polish.

This role is a strong fit for product managers who have gone deep on hardware and embedded systems, or for hardware, embedded, or systems engineers who want to move into product.

What You’ll Own

- Key commercial video hardware products. Lead product development for high-priority commercial video devices, beginning with PoE cameras.

Own product direction from concept through launch and continued lifecycle improvement.

- Hardware, firmware, and software product definition. Define requirements and make tradeoff decisions across the full product experience, not just the device itself. Ensure the hardware, firmware, and software pieces come together into a product that works well for customers and installers.

- ODM partner direction and product shaping. Work directly with ODM partners to evaluate platforms, select components, solidify specifications, and drive execution. Push for quality, challenge assumptions when needed, and make sure important details do not get waved away.

- Installer and field experience. Review products from the perspective of the installer and end user. Identify friction in mounting, wiring, accessory kits, setup, and deployment, and drive improvements before those issues reach the field.

- Final product quality and finish. Be the person who notices when a product is technically functional but not actually ready. Own decisions and feedback on the details that shape quality, including industrial/mechanical details, status indicators, packaging inputs, in-box accessories, and setup experience.

- Launch readiness and lifecycle follow-through. Lead key launches end to end, including launch-critical issue resolution and post-launch prioritization. Partner with engineering, QA, operations, design, and PMM to ensure products ship at the right quality bar and continue improving after release.

- Cross-functional decision making. Work across hardware, firmware, software, operations, design, quality, and go-to-market teams. Engineering owns implementation; you own the product outcome.

What We’re Looking For

We care more about technical judgment, curiosity, and ownership than about checking every box on paper.

- Strong technical depth in hardware or embedded systems. You can engage credibly on device architecture, component tradeoffs, and system constraints. You do not need to design the hardware yourself, but you do need to understand how the pieces fit together and be able to challenge a recommendation when it does not make sense.

- Ability to operate across hardware, firmware, and software. You can reason about the full system and make good prioritization calls across disciplines. You are comfortable owning a hardware product beyond the physical device itself.

- Hands-on product instincts. You are willing to open the box, inspect the accessory bag, walk through the install flow, and test assumptions yourself. You care about the difference between a product that works in theory and one that works well in practice.

- Pragmatic problem solving. You push for excellence, but you are practical about getting products to market. When a partner says something requires a respin, delay, or escalation, you know how to dig in and evaluate whether there is a simpler path.

- Experience driving complex cross-functional work. You can keep momentum across multiple teams and external partners without losing sight of product quality or decision clarity.

- Clear written and verbal communication. You can write rigorous requirements, document decisions clearly, and communicate effectively with technical teams, external partners, and leadership.

- Strong technical foundation. Background in engineering, computer science, math, physics, or another rigorous discipline with B.S. in an engineering discipline, computer science, math, physics or related field preferred.

Bonus Points

- Experience shipping cameras, IoT devices, networking hardware, or other connected devices

- Experience working with ODM, JDM, or contract manufacturing partners

- Experience in video surveillance, physical security, or commercial device ecosystems

- Background as a hardware, embedded, systems, mechanical, or firmware engineer before moving into product

- Familiarity with installer-driven products or products deployed in real-world commercial environments

Location

- This role can be based in our Redwood City, San Diego, or Tysons, VA headquarters and is expected to be onsite 4 days per week.

- Travel is expected, including trips to Taiwan a couple times per year and occasional travel to other partner or field locations as needed.

Seeking a Lead Compensation Analyst to own global market pricing and analytics across all levels. Scope includes pricing new and emerging roles (e.g., AI/ML), leading company- and subsidiary-wide reviews, building equity/RSU models and compensation adjustment plans, and advising leaders on offers and strategy. Partners closely with Executives, HRBPs, Payroll, Finance, and Workday team to deliver competitive, compliant, and scalable programs globally.

Key responsibilities:

- Market pricing and job architecture

- Conduct compensation analyses for all levels, including executive roles.

- Price new/emerging jobs (AI/ML, etc.); recommend ranges and levels.

- Refine job architecture, leveling, descriptions, and posting ranges with HRBPs/TA.

- Build market ranges using Radford and other sources (Deel/SHRM, etc.).

- Programs and reviews

- Lead company and subsidiary merit/market/bonus reviews; deliver insights and recommendations.

- Provide compensation adjustment recommendations balancing market, equity, and budgets.

- Review offers for range alignment, internal equity, and market position.

- Partner with overseas teams to address under-competitive markets.

- Equity and modeling

- Build equity and financial models (RSU allocation, pay mix, multi-year total comp).

- Support terminations by reviewing equity vesting, proration, and forfeiture.

- Prepare and administer equity grant cycles to review recommendations, validate data, and communication of grant details.

- Compliance, audits, and pay equity

- Run pay equity analyses; support EU Pay Transparency Directive and other global requirements.

- Audit job classification with Payroll (e.g., exempt status); ensure data integrity.

- Maintain compensation governance and documentation.

- Systems, surveys, and data

- Lead the annual compensation process in Workday in partnership with our HRIS team

- Own all compensation data in the Workday system

- Partner with Workday on compensation displays, ranges, perform UAT.

- Complete and manage surveys (Radford, SHRM, etc.); reconcile data and fill gaps.

- Build dashboards and analyses for executives and HR partners.

- Stakeholder partnership

- Present strategies and outcomes to executives.

- Advise HRBPs and leaders on pricing, leveling, offers, adjustments, and bonus design.

Qualifications:

- 7–10+ years in compensation, including market pricing and exposure to executive comp.

- Strong equity experience (RSUs; PSUs/options a plus) and multi-year modeling.

- Global program experience across multiple countries.

- Advanced skills in Excel

- Advanced skills in AI tools

- Deep survey experience (Radford preferred)

- Knowledge of pay transparency/equity laws (EU PTD; US state/local)

- Excellent communication and executive influence skills.

- Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field

jobs.description:
At Alarm.com, we’re looking for a Total Rewards Partner to administer and support the organization's Total Rewards programs – someone who gets excited about making sure the benefits, programs and pay that employees receive in exchange for their time, talent, effort and results at work are well understood and working as intended.

This role serves as a knowledgeable and responsive resource for fellow HR teammates, employees and managers at all levels in the organization, delivering excellent customer service while ensuring compliance with applicable policies and regulations. While the primary focus areas of this role will be absence/workplace accommodation management and health welfare and retirement administration, we’re seeking a Total Rewards professional with some knowledge and the ability to support compensation administration too.

Key Responsibilities

Absence/Workplace Accommodation Management

- Administer and manage leave of absence programs, including FMLA, state-mandated paid family and medical leave (PFML), short-term disability (STD), long-term disability (LTD), personal and military leaves. Track, monitor, and manage leave cases from initiation through return-to-work.

- Serve as the primary point of contact for employees and managers navigating workplace accommodation requests, providing clear, empathetic, and timely guidance throughout the process. Partner with managers and HR Business Partners on interactive process meetings and reasonable accommodation assessments.

- Coordinate with third-party leave administrators and internal stakeholders to ensure seamless case management processing and accurate pay continuation.

- Update and maintain absence management procedures and employee-facing communications and resources.

Benefits Administration

- Own the day-to-day administration of the organization's employee benefits programs, including medical, dental, vision, life and AD&D insurance, flexible spending accounts (FSA), health savings accounts (HSA), voluntary benefits, and retirement plans.

- Serve as a knowledgeable and approachable resource for employee benefits inquiries, resolving issues with accuracy, professionalism, and a strong commitment to customer service.

- Process new hire enrollments, qualifying life events (QLEs), and termination/COBRA notifications in a timely and accurate manner. Analyze trends and recommend efficient and cost-effective solutions. Lead annual open enrollment activities, including system configuration testing, employee communications, vendor coordination, and post-enrollment audits.

- Partner with benefits brokers, carriers, and third-party administrators (TPAs) to resolve escalated claims issues, billing discrepancies, and eligibility matters. Assist in the evaluation and benchmarking of benefits programs to ensure market competitiveness and alignment with organizational strategy.

- Contribute to the development and delivery of benefits education and communication materials to drive employee understanding and program utilization.

Compensation

- Support administration of compensation initiatives (merit, bonus, equity) and compensation special projects as assigned.

- Assist in maintaining compensation-related documentation, tools, resources, and classification records.

What we’re looking for

Must Have

- Bachelor’s degree in human resources, business administration or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

- 5 years of progressive Total Rewards/HR experience, with targeted focus on absence/workplace accommodation case management and health, welfare and retirement benefits administration. General working knowledge/exposure to compensation initiatives and methods.

- Strong customer service orientation with the ability to communicate complex information clearly and compassionately to employees at all levels. Ability to design and deliver engaging presentations to a variety of audiences.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to interpret data and translate findings into actionable recommendations.

- Proficiency with cloud-based HRIS platforms (Workday preferred) Office 365, and third-party platforms.

- High degree of accuracy and attention to detail, with strong organizational and time management skills. Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion and professionalism.

- Ability and willingness to actively engage with a high-performing HR team that genuinely cares about each other and likes to have fun together.

- Other duties as assigned

Nice to Have

- Progress toward/completion of CBP and/or CCP or equivalent

- Prior work experience in a B2B2C SaaS or other technology-focused organization

- Experience administering concurrent FMLA and state-mandated paid family leave in Massachusetts, Minnesota, New York City, and Washington.

jobs.description:
Principal Software Engineer — emPower

Do you love working with connected devices, automation, and real-world systems? Have you automated your own home, built integrations across smart devices, or thought deeply about how cloud software should control physical systems reliably?

Alarm.com is looking for a versatile Principal Software Engineer to help lead architecture and engineering for our emPower team, which builds software for IoT, smart home automation, energy management, HVAC, water, and connected-device control experiences. This role is an IC role that sits at the intersection of cloud services, physical devices, mobile and web applications, automation logic, data processing, and customer-facing product experiences.

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will provide hands-on technical leadership across teams. You will help define architecture, guide major design decisions, mentor engineers, and lead the evolution of systems that must be reliable, scalable, maintainable, and adaptable as our connected-device platform continues to grow.

Alarm.com combines the product breadth and technical scale of a mature connected-device platform with the collaborative culture of a smaller engineering organization. This role is ideal for someone who wants to work across software, hardware, data, and product domains while helping shape systems used by millions of customers.

What You’ll Do

As a Principal Software Engineer on the emPower team, you will help design and evolve systems that coordinate physical devices, cloud services, mobile and web applications, automation engines, partner integrations, and data pipelines. You will work across product, firmware, platform, operations, and application engineering teams to turn ambiguous business and technical needs into reliable, scalable, and maintainable software systems.

You will be expected to lead through technical depth, sound judgment, and influence. You will own important architecture decisions, guide implementation strategy, and help engineers across multiple teams build better systems.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

- Provide hands-on technical leadership for systems spanning IoT device control, smart home automation, energy, HVAC, water, and connected-device experiences.

- Lead architecture and design for major software components, services, APIs, data flows, and integration patterns.

- Help evolve existing monolithic systems into more modular, scalable, reliable, and maintainable systems.

- Partner with product, firmware, platform, operations, and application teams to turn ambiguous needs into clear technical direction.

- Mentor engineers at multiple levels and help raise the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, technical guidance, and reusable patterns.

- Drive cross-team collaboration and execution across multiple technical domains.

- Evaluate new technologies, frameworks, and methodologies where they can materially improve product capabilities or engineering outcomes.

- Reason across the full product stack, including backend services, databases, APIs, web and mobile experiences, device integrations, automation logic, and operational tooling.

- Be an expert on system architecture, functionality, data flows, operational processes, and the tools needed to operate production systems effectively.

- Provide technical thought leadership for major software components, systems, and features, earning alignment and driving adoption across teams.

- Exercise strong engineering judgment: know when to move quickly, when to invest in a robust platform capability, and when to avoid unnecessary complexity.

- Bring your ideas. We want our engineers to collaborate on product development, not blindly build to a spec.

- Other duties as assigned.

What You Need

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

- 15+ years of professional software development experience.

- Proven experience designing, building, and delivering complex software systems.

- Strong object-oriented programming skills; experience with C#/.NET or a similar object-oriented language is required; direct C# and .NET experience would be a major plus.

- Significant database design, performance, and development experience.

- Experience leading technical direction across teams and influencing architecture beyond a single project or codebase.

- Experience mentoring engineers and helping develop people, practices, and reusable technical solutions.

- Ability to select appropriate frameworks, architecture patterns, and technical approaches, then educate teams and drive adoption.

- Strong analytical skills and a practical problem-solving mindset.

- Ability to lead and influence across teams without relying solely on reporting authority.

- Ability to reason across the full product stack, including backend services, data stores, APIs, device integrations, and web/mobile user experiences.

- Strong understanding of object-oriented design, software development lifecycles, and long-term maintainability concerns.

- Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to engineers, product owners, and business stakeholders.

Experience That Would Be a Major Plus

- Experience with IoT, smart home, energy management, HVAC, water, automation, or connected-device systems.

- Experience working with physical systems, hardware devices, firmware teams, or embedded-device integrations.

- Experience with event-driven systems, device telemetry, automation/rules engines, or distributed systems.

- Experience in modernizing monolithic systems or decomposing systems into modular services.

- Experience designing systems where cloud software interacts with deployed physical devices and must account for latency, reliability, compatibility, and operational visibility.

Why This Role Matters

The emPower team works on software that connects the digital and physical world: devices, homes, energy systems, water systems, HVAC systems, automation logic, and customer-facing control experiences. The systems we build must be reliable, understandable, scalable, and adaptable as new devices, integrations, and product capabilities are added.

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will help shape the architecture behind these experiences. Your work will influence multiple teams, improve the systems engineers build on, and help Alarm.com continue delivering connected-device products that are useful, reliable, and easy for customers to trust.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.summary: VTS is the category leader in commercial real estate technology with more than 13 billion square feet managed on our platform globally.
jobs.description:
VTS is the category leader in commercial real estate technology with more than 13 billion square feet managed on our platform globally. Every account in your book represents an opportunity to expand how some of the largest owners and operators in the industry leverage technology to modernize their portfolios.

As an Account Manager, you will work directly with leadership while helping drive the next phase of growth at VTS. You will own expansion revenue across a portfolio of 60 to 80 SMB and lower mid market commercial real estate accounts. Your job is simple: generate and close net new revenue within your book. That means identifying whitespace, creating urgency, and running multiple deal cycles simultaneously, not waiting for opportunities to come to you.

This is not a support role. Renewals and adoption are handled separately. You own the commercial motion including upsells, cross sells, and new product expansion, with a direct quota and meaningful upside for top performers.

Here’s what you can expect as an Account Manager:

- Proactively identify expansion opportunities across your book using product usage data, account signals, and direct customer conversations.

- Run 30 to 60 day deal cycles across multiple accounts simultaneously.

- Build relationships with decision makers and navigate 1 to 3 stakeholder buying groups to close opportunities.

- Maintain a disciplined pipeline with accurate forecasting and clear next steps on every active deal.

- Partner closely with Customer Success and Sales while maintaining ownership of the commercial opportunity.

- Create urgency and momentum across active deals instead of reacting to inbound demand.

What makes you a great fit?

- 2-4 years in a quota carrying B2B SaaS role across account management, SMB sales, or expansion focused customer roles.

- Demonstrated success sourcing and closing expansion revenue independently.

- Experience managing a high volume book of business with strong organizational discipline.

- Comfortable operating in fast paced, highly collaborative environments.

- Strong communication skills with the ability to build credibility across multiple stakeholders.

- High urgency, accountability, and a bias toward action.

- You are someone who creates opportunities instead of waiting for them.

- You run a clean pipeline and always know where your deals stand.

- You can point to deals you personally drove and closed that would not have happened otherwise.

What VTS Values & How We Show It

- Strive for Excellence - We know your potential is unlimited. Take advantage of our executive coaches and our training and career development programs available to all employees!

- Be Customer Obsessed - We’re employee obsessed too! VTS offers competitive compensation, comprehensive health benefits (including dental and vision), pre-tax commuter benefits, and a 401(k) plan. Not to mention the fun stuff - quarterly happy hours, wellness events, clubs, and team lunches!

- Be Curious - Benefit from a culture that promotes new learning. VTS offers an education stipend to all employees!

- Move as One - We work in an open floor plan to promote cross-functional collaboration.

- Take Ownership - Be an owner of the company you’re building with our equity packages.

- Appreciate the Difference - VTS embraces and celebrates diversity. We understand the importance of a strong work-life balance. We offer a flexible PTO policy, generous family leave program, and more!

ABOUT VTS

VTS is the only AI-driven technology platform enabling intelligent real estate by unifying industry professionals, investors, and their customers at scale. In 2013, VTS revolutionized commercial real estate leasing operations with what is now VTS Lease. Today, VTS AI is the largest first-party insights and collaboration engine in the industry, transforming how strategic decisions are made and executed by the real estate industry globally.

With the VTS Platform, consisting of VTS Lease, VTS Market, VTS Activate, and VTS Data, every stakeholder in real estate is given real-time market information and workflow tools to do their job with unparalleled speed and intelligence. VTS is the global leader, with more than 60% of Class A office space in the U.S., and 13 billion square feet of office, residential, retail, and industrial space is managed through the platform worldwide. VTS is utilized by over 45,000 professionals and over 1.2 million total users each day, including industry-leading customers such as Blackstone, Brookfield Properties, LaSalle Investment Management, Hines, BXP, Oxford Properties, JLL, and CBRE.

VTS maintains offices in New York City, London, Toronto, Chicago.

To learn more about VTS and view our open roles, visit us at vts.com or follow us on Instagram (@WeAreVTS) or LinkedIn.

Pay Transparency

At VTS, we pride ourselves on articulating a clear and transparent philosophy around equitable, impartial compensation that will allow us to recruit and retain an exceptional team. The base salary is market-driven at the time of offer and is based on tier 1 market data. The salary for this role will range between $90,000 and $110,000 and is determined by several factors, including your skills, prior relevant experience, quality of interviews, leveling, and geography. There is a commission structure for the position that will bring the OTE (on target earnings) between $140,000 to $170,000, depending on the base salary agreed upon and achievement to goals.

EEO Guidelines

VTS embraces diversity and equal opportunity in a serious way. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. For more information about what we collect and how we use it, please refer to the Candidate Privacy Statement.

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation at any time during the recruitment process, please let us know at ta@vts.com

Privacy Policy

jobs.title: SMB Sales Manager
jobs.summary: Envoy protects the places the world relies on most by unifying people, spaces, and communications in one secure, integrated workplace management platform and ecosystem.
jobs.description:
Envoy protects the places the world relies on most by unifying people, spaces, and communications in one secure, integrated workplace management platform and ecosystem. More than 16,000 workplaces around the world trust Envoy to run secure, compliant, and connected operations across every location.

From manufacturing sites and data centers to pharmaceutical labs, healthcare facilities, and corporate headquarters, Envoy makes safety, security and associated regulatory compliance something our customers can be proud of. The industry is littered with box-checking and arcane manual processes as the standard and we see our role as the company to bring experience, efficiency and simplicity everywhere. Great experiences bring great security – it's a requirement. We hope this problem space excites you and we hope you're ready to come sweat the details with us – we have a lot of customers counting on us! And it certainly won't be easy.

Learn more at envoy.com

About the role
Envoy is hiring an SMB Sales Manager to lead a team of 8 SMB Account Executives in. You will report to the Director of SMB Sales and partner with a peer SMB manager covering the other region.
This is a high-velocity, outbound-heavy motion. Most of what your team closes in a quarter is also created in that quarter, and roughly a third of it is sourced by the reps themselves. Every AE carries an individual self-sourced pipeline generation target alongside their bookings quota. If you have only run a team that works inbound demand, this role will feel unfamiliar.
You will own the number for your region, the pipeline that gets you there, and the development of the people building it.
This is an onsite position that requires at least 4 days a week (Monday - Thursday) in our New York City, NY office.

You will
- Lead the team. Run a team of SMB Account Executives to quota. Set the standard for activity, rigor, and how deals get worked, and hold the team to it.
Drive pipeline generation. Own your team's self-sourced pipeline number. Coach prospecting directly — sequences, call blocks, account planning, territory strategy — and inspect it weekly. Self-sourced pipeline is the share of the number your team has the most direct control over; inbound, BDR, and partner-sourced opportunities don't count toward it.
Forecast a fast-moving book. Deliver an accurate forecast for the current quarter and a defensible view of the next, in a motion where most bookings are created and closed inside the same quarter. Inspect stage integrity, call risk early, and know which deals can be pulled forward.
Coach and develop. Diagnose individual skill gaps and close them with targeted coaching — discovery, demo, negotiation, multi-threading. Contribute to onboarding and certification for new hires, and help develop BDRs moving into AE seats.
Work across the business. Partner with Marketing, Product, Enablement, Sales Ops, and Customer Success on acquisition and expansion plays, territory design, and account coverage. Bring the field's view of what is and isn't working.

You have
- 2–3+ years managing a B2B closing team, selling software in a velocity or SMB motion, with a record of the team hitting its number — not just your own as an individual contributor.

- Experience carrying a pipeline generation target. You have held a team to a self-sourced pipeline number and can show how you coached reps to build it, not just inspect it.

- Forecasting in a short-cycle business. You can call a quarter where the majority of bookings are sourced intraquarter, and you are comfortable committing to a next-quarter view.

- Pipeline management depth. You have run a mixed book of fast transactional deals and longer strategic ones, and you know where each needs different handling.

- Qualification rigor. Fluent in MEDDPPICC or a comparable framework, and able to teach it rather than just score with it.

- Stakeholder navigation. Comfortable engaging multiple stakeholders and moving deals through negotiation, security review, legal, and procurement.

- AI and data fluency. You use AI tools in your own workflow and expect your reps to. You can pull and interpret your own pipeline data rather than waiting on a report.

- Coaching instinct. You find the gap, name it plainly, and build the rep a path out of it. You give direct feedback without making it personal.

- Comfort with pace and ambiguity. Envoy moves quickly. Territory, tooling, and process change; you adapt and keep the team steady through it.

- Genuine interest in SMB. You like the segment, the speed, and the volume, and you have a consultative read on what smaller businesses actually need.

You'll get
- A high degree of trust in your ideas and execution.

- An opportunity to partner and collaborate with other talented people.

- An inclusive community where you feel welcomed and cared for as a person.

- The ability to make an immediate impact helping customers create a great workplace experience.

- Support for your personal and professional growth.
 

 
By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have fully read and understand the job requirements and received the Envoy Privacy Notice for applicants, which is linked here. Completing this application requires you to provide personal data, such as your name and contact information, which is mandatory for Envoy to process your application. Envoy is an EEO Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by local, state or federal law.

jobs.description:
Are you a creative self-starter who enjoys solving complex problems and turning ideas into real-world products? As a Product Manager at Alarm.com, you’ll help define, build, and launch a new commercial product at the intersection of software, IoT, and AI-enabled development.

This is not a traditional PM role focused only on customer discovery and requirements writing. We are looking for a technically minded, execution-oriented person who is excited to use AI tools as part of their daily work—to accelerate research, prototype ideas, analyze information, and contribute directly to the product’s technical development. You’ll work closely with engineering, design, quality, and business stakeholders to bring a new offering to market while building strong product, technical, and AI fluency along the way.

WHY THIS ROLE

This role is a chance to help shape a new product offering from an early stage, with real influence over its direction, workflows, and execution. Rather than stepping into a mature product, you’ll help define what gets built and how the team builds it.

It’s also a unique opportunity to go beyond traditional product management. In this role, you’ll use AI tools as a core part of your workflow—not just to support planning and analysis, but to prototype, automate, and contribute directly to technical execution. If you’re excited by ownership, technical problem-solving, and building something new with modern tools, this role offers an unusually hands-on start to a product management career.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Product Strategy & Roadmap Definition: Contribute to and help shape the product roadmap and vision for a new offering from concept to release. Support the translation of customer problems into requirements and technical specifications, with guidance from senior stakeholders.

- Cross-Functional Delivery & Execution: Partner closely with Software Engineering, Quality Engineering, and the UX Design team, Design to shepherd features through development. Collaborate with Quality and Beta teams to test, validate, and streamline functionality to ensure a high-value release.

- AI-Assisted Technical Contribution: Actively use AI-assisted tools to accelerate research, analyze data, and contribute to workflows. Go beyond traditional PM boundaries by using AI-assisted development tools to contribute directly to the code stack, internal tools, prototypes, or test assets—thriving in a hands-on, implementation-focused environment.

- Stakeholder Alignment & Enablement: Communicate and support alignment on product direction and priorities across teams. Collaborate with Marketing, Sales, and Support to build excitement, create training materials, and support go-to-market strategies.

- Product Lifecycle Optimization: Assist in tracking product adoption, usage metrics, and customer feedback to support future prioritization decisions. Partner with Customer Support and Operations to triage and resolve issues, ensuring an outstanding end-to-end customer experience.

About You

- Extreme Ownership: You take complete accountability for moving work forward, proactively stepping in to resolve challenges and keep the product on track.

- Continuous Learner: You possess a growth mindset and are eager to build deep expertise in our product, the market, and your own technical and AI fluency.

- Cross-Functional Collaborator: You possess exceptional communication skills and excel at bridging the gap between technical teams and non-technical stakeholders, keeping everyone aligned and excited about the product vision.

- Hands-on Problem Solver: You love getting close to the implementation and enjoy bridging the gap between strategy and technical execution.

REQUIREMENTS

- Bachelor’s degree (B.S. or B.A.) is required

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to diverse audiences

- 1–2 years of professional experience (product, engineering, project management, technical operations, or related roles)

- Demonstrated comfort learning and using AI tools to solve problems, improve workflows, and accelerate execution

- Interest in contributing directly to technical work, including prototypes, scripts, internal tools, or code-assisted implementation

- Strong interest in working at the intersection of software, IoT systems, and AI-enabled development

- Demonstrated ability to take initiative, operate in ambiguous environments, and learn quickly

- Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools, large language models, or workflow automation tools

- Exposure to software development, scripting, prototyping, or technical troubleshooting

- Experience working on technical products in a collaborative, cross-functional environment

- Interest in product roles that blend strategy, execution, and hands-on technical contribution

jobs.description:
at Evernest
Reports to: Chief Operating Officer  |  Location: Remote (U.S.)  |  Travel: Company offsites and periodic in-market working sessions  |  Compensation: $140,000–$165,000 base
Company Overview
Evernest is a full-service real estate and property management company with a national presence and an outstanding reputation. We operate in more than 50 of the nation’s most investable markets and manage approximately 12,000 homes. Our team is high-performing, our culture is second to none, and our core values drive collaboration, innovation, and the relentless pursuit of excellence.
Our people, proprietary technology, and commitment to continuous improvement are reshaping an industry. Our goal is to manage 250,000 homes by 2030, and we are looking for driven individuals who share our vision and want to shape the future of property management while making a lasting impact on our clients and communities.

Position Overview

At Evernest, property accounting is not back-office work. We are building a brand that residents, owners, and vendors genuinely trust, and for accounting, that trust is built one clean, on-time statement at a time. You and your team will own some of the most important deliverables in the company: reporting that owners, clients, and our own teams never have to question.

We are seeking an ambitious, high-ownership accounting leader to own the books behind every door we manage. This is the single seat accountable for the close and trust accounting across all three client segments (Retail SFR, Institutional SFR, and Multifamily) and for a team of roughly 25 U.S.-based and international accountants and specialists. You will report to the Chief Operating Officer as the most senior client accounting leader in the organization, and you will sit on the Evernest Senior Leadership Team, the most senior group outside the executive team. Every member of the Senior Leadership Team is responsible for owning their business and driving it toward the shared vision of the organization. Property Accounting will be yours.

This is a strategic-doer seat. As the technical authority in property accounting, you will personally own our most complex institutional client books until the team and processes maintain your standards without your day-to-day involvement. You will also be the technical escalation path and the career path for every accountant in the department. It is also a builder’s seat. Our processes and team are good; your job is to make them best in class. AI is changing how we work, and it must be core to how the department operates, not an occasional experiment: eliminating manual work, catching exceptions before they become variances, and tightening the close. In addition to paving the way with AI, you will partner with our data and technology teams to build durable processes, designed with the client in mind, that close the books earlier every month.

This is a growth seat. We are as interested in the rising accounting leader as the seasoned one, because the scale we are building toward will demand more of this role every year. There is no status quo.

Responsibilities

-
Deliver the close on time, every month. Owner statements, client packages, reconciliations, disbursements, and 1099s across all three segments, from a door’s onboarding through its disposition.

-
Keep every trust dollar clean and provable. 100% of trust and operating accounts reconciled monthly across more than 50 markets, no unexplained variances, clean audits, and full compliance with every state’s broker trust rules.

-
Own institutional client accounting. Client-specific mappings, funding requests, lender and DSCR reporting, capex policy, and fee analysis. Be the person on the call when a number is challenged.

-
Build the bench. Coach the Retail, Multifamily, and Institutional accounting leaders and develop the team beneath them so the function never depends on one person.

-
Run the operating rhythm. Weekly leadership meetings, one-on-ones, and a close-status review where every metric has a named owner and input metrics flag a missed close before it happens.

-
Inspect what you expect. Document every recurring workflow, measure adherence, and rebuild anything that depends on individual effort.

-
Run the department like a business. Own the scorecard and quarterly plans, drive cost per door down and productivity per accountant up, and stay inside budget.

-
Never cost us a door. Zero accounting-related client churn.

What You Bring

-
Experience at scale. Property accounting leadership at a multi-market, multi-entity third-party property manager, with direct accountability for thousands of doors and experience managing managers.

-
Institutional client accounting. You have owned institutional reporting and defended your numbers directly to sophisticated clients.

-
Hands-on trust accounting expertise. You have personally owned trust reconciliations, security deposits, disbursements, and 1099s, and you designed the controls rather than operating inside someone else’s.

-
Extreme ownership. You have stayed on a hard problem until it was solved when it would have been easier to escalate, and you can tell us about it.

-
A builder’s track record. Processes you built that held up after you moved on, with before-and-after results you can point to.

-
A partner, not a gatekeeper. Operations leaders want to work with you, and you can collaborate and hold the line on controls when it matters.

-
Drive to lead with AI. You are excited by what AI can do for accounting and want to be the one who brings it into the department, not the one who waits to see how it plays out.

-
Fluency in the tools. AppFolio (or an equivalent property management accounting platform), Excel, Google Workspace, and treasury management banking platforms.

-
Credentials. A Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA a plus.

-
Range. As comfortable in transaction-level detail as you are presenting to executives, institutional clients, and auditors.

jobs.description:
Alarm.com is a rapidly expanding technology company developing innovative cloud and device solutions across a wide range of cutting-edge technologies that provide a unified, connected service to millions of residential and commercial properties in the US and abroad. We are looking for a talented and passionate embedded software engineer for the Device Engineering team to help us define the future of the Internet-of-Things for residential and commercial properties by creating and integrating devices including security panels, networking gateways, and video cameras. You will be working with a team of talented engineers across a diverse set of technological backgrounds to design devices, build and manufacture hardware, architect and implement software, and collaborate in an agile and fast-paced environment.

You will build firmware for our video cameras at our Tysons, Virginia headquarters. Prior camera, multimedia, or networking experience is not required: we are looking for a strong embedded Linux and C++ generalist who is eager to learn, and the team's experienced engineers will mentor you. Your code will run on real hardware every day and ship to millions of homes and businesses.

What You'll Learn and Work On

Areas the team owns; prior exposure is a plus, not a prerequisite.

- C++ application software on embedded Linux and resource-constrained SoC hardware.

- Video and audio: capture, encoding, streaming, two-way audio, and event-driven clips and snapshots.

- On-device analytics and event detection.

- Builds, cross-compilation, and hardware bring-up and validation with senior engineers.

- Connectivity: wired and wireless networking, secure cloud communication, and over-the-air updates.

- Self-starter who scopes their own work, follows through, and communicates progress and blockers early.

- 2+ years of professional embedded software development on Linux platforms.

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

- Experience with cross-compilation and build frameworks such as Yocto, buildroot, OpenWRT, or Android.

- Knowledge of the SDLC, Git, and collaborative code review; able to present coherent designs, code changes, tests, and results.

- Python or Bash scripting to automate development and test processes.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Video, audio, or image pipelines: camera sensors, ISPs, hardware encoders, media frameworks, codecs, or streaming protocols.

- Security fundamentals: TLS, secure boot, key storage.

- AI/ML inference on embedded devices.

- Automated on-device testing or CI for embedded targets.

Responsibilities:

- Implement, test, and debug camera firmware on real hardware, owning tasks and modules from design review through code review, unit and on-target testing, documentation, and release.

- Develop platform frameworks and embedded Linux applications in C/C++ with other engineers.

- Break features into well-defined, documented tasks; justify technical decisions and propose alternatives in design discussions.

- Contribute to system-level debugging, performance profiling, and validation; quickly narrow problems to hardware or software.

- Work with electrical and mechanical engineers on device design and manufacturing, with software engineers on features that interact with the cloud, and with product managers and quality engineers to ensure products meet Alarm.com's standards.

- Take on work across areas, features, and platforms, including outside your comfort zone; write internal tools to automate frequent processes.

- Communicate effectively and collaborate with others to ensure the timely delivery of projects.

- Use AI-assisted development tools effectively within the team's engineering workflow.

Who Thrives Here

You own a problem from first symptom to shipped fix and look for the next one unasked. You are curious about where hardware meets software and comfortable with a datasheet, a kernel log, and a packet capture in the same afternoon, even when some are new to you. You learn from experienced engineers, ask for feedback, and share what you learn. You take pride in reliable code that runs on devices people depend on for their safety.

jobs.description:
VTS is looking for a Senior Content Marketing Manager to own content strategy across the full marketing funnel. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who can both set the content strategy and produce most of it themselves — from long- and short-form writing to video storyboarding and executive presentations. You'll shape how VTS shows up across every format and channel, partnering closely with Growth Marketing, Product Marketing, and cross-functional teams including Executives, Sales, and Customer Success to make sure content connects to what the business actually needs.

** Please note that this opportunity is located in New York, NY, and requires this hire to work from our office 4 days a week. **

What Makes This Job Awesome? You will...

- Own VTS's content strategy end-to-end: define the right mix of long-form, short-form, video, employee-generated content across the funnel, from top-of-funnel awareness through customer expansion.

- Take what you hear from executives, sales, customers, and prospects and work with the VP of Marketing to translate it into our overall messaging. Then bring that messaging to life in decks, presentations, and content for internal and external audiences.

- Produce the majority of our content yourself, especially written work, while knowing when to bring in our creative and video teams, or agency support, for storyboarding, production, or specialized formats.

- Develop and own our customer content program (case studies, customer stories, and other proof points), showcasing customer outcomes in ways that support both new business and expansion

- Own social content strategy and execution, including employee-generated content and thought leadership posting.

- Drive SEO and AEO strategy across our website, landing pages, and content, ensuring VTS shows up in both traditional search and AI-driven answer engines.

- Partner closely with Growth Marketing to produce the right content for our paid and owned channels, bringing a point of view on how content should be distributed to reach the right audience, and with Product Marketing to build materials that support product launches.

- Partner with the events team to turn events and other high-visibility marketing moments into content with a longer lifetime, extending their value well beyond the moment itself.

What Makes You a Great Fit?

- 5-8 years of B2B marketing experience with breadth across content formats — long-form, short-form, video, social, and customer content — rather than depth in a single specialty like case studies alone.

- A strong, versatile writer who can produce polished content independently, not just direct others to produce it.

- Comfortable holding executive-facing conversations and taking a point of view on messaging, translating what you hear from stakeholders into a clear narrative.

- A point of view on content distribution — how the right piece reaches the right audience through the right channel.

- Fluent with AI tools (e.g., Claude) as part of your everyday workflow, using them to scale output and move faster, not as an occasional aid.

- Experience with SEO and emerging AEO/answer-engine optimization practices.

- Some experience with decks and presentations — a plus, not a requirement; storytelling instinct matters more than design polish.

- Startup or enterprise background both work, provided you bring range across content types rather than a single area of specialization.

- Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, scrappy environment where you'll both set strategy and roll up your sleeves to execute it.

What VTS Values & How We Show It

- Strive for Excellence - We know your potential is unlimited. Take advantage of our executive coaches and our training and career development programs available to all employees!

- Be Customer Obsessed - We’re employee obsessed too! VTS offers competitive compensation, comprehensive health benefits (including dental and vision), pre-tax commuter benefits, and a 401(k) plan. Not to mention the fun stuff - quarterly happy hours, wellness events, clubs, and team lunches!

- Be Curious - Benefit from a culture that promotes new learning. VTS offers an education stipend to all employees!

- Move as One - We work in an open floor plan to promote cross-functional collaboration.

- Take Ownership - Be an owner of the company you’re building with our equity packages.

- Appreciate the Difference - VTS embraces and celebrates diversity. We understand the importance of a strong work-life balance. We offer a flexible PTO policy, generous family leave program, and more!

ABOUT VTS

VTS is the only AI-driven technology platform enabling intelligent real estate by unifying industry professionals, investors, and their customers at scale. In 2013, VTS revolutionized commercial real estate leasing operations with what is now VTS Lease. Today, VTS AI is the largest first-party insights and collaboration engine in the industry, transforming how strategic decisions are made and executed by the real estate industry globally.

With the VTS Platform, consisting of VTS Lease, VTS Market, VTS Activate, and VTS Data, every stakeholder in real estate is given real-time market information and workflow tools to do their job with unparalleled speed and intelligence. VTS is the global leader, with more than 60% of Class A office space in the U.S., and 13 billion square feet of office, residential, retail, and industrial space is managed through the platform worldwide. VTS is utilized by over 45,000 professionals and over 1.2 million total users each day, including industry-leading customers such as Blackstone, Brookfield Properties, LaSalle Investment Management, Hines, BXP, Oxford Properties, JLL, and CBRE.

VTS maintains offices in New York City, London, Toronto, Chicago.

To learn more about VTS and view our open roles, visit us at vts.com or follow us on Instagram (@WeAreVTS) or LinkedIn.

Pay Transparency

At VTS, we pride ourselves on articulating a clear and transparent philosophy around equitable, impartial compensation that will allow us to recruit and retain an exceptional team. The base salary is market-driven at the time of offer and is based on tier 1 market data. The salary for this role will range between $120,000 and $160,000 and is determined by several factors, including your skills, prior relevant experience, quality of interviews, leveling, and geography.

EEO Guidelines

VTS embraces diversity and equal opportunity in a serious way. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. For more information about what we collect and how we use it, please refer to the Candidate Privacy Statement.

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation at any time during the recruitment process, please let us know at ta@vts.com
