jobs.description:
What we do and why we do it

As the leading end-to-end investment platform for single-family rental homes (SFR), our mission is to reinvent the rental housing ecosystem for the benefit of all. We successfully merge our passion for helping investors build wealth through real estate with cutting edge technology that transforms the way they do it.

How it’s going (and growing)

With a talented team of 750+ Roofsters, our collaborative, can-do culture is what fuels our growth. In 2022, we closed on our Series E, raising $240 million, and have offices in the Bay Area and New York City. Our growth includes recent acquisitions of Stessa (financial and asset management software), RentPrep (tenant screening and placement service for landlords), and Mynd (property management platform for both Retail and Institutional investors). In 2025, Roofstock took an ownership stake in Casago (short-term rental management services), expanding our platform to support both long-term and short-term rental investment services.

About the Role

Roofstock is looking to hire an organized, systems-minded, and experienced Senior Legal Operations Manager to join our Legal team. This individual will own how legal work moves through the business: how it comes in, how it gets tracked, how it gets executed, and how it gets approved and paid. The Senior Legal Operations Manager will build durable workflows in place of institutional memory, keep contract turnaround predictable, maintain clean and complete records, support claims and litigation management in-house, and help manage outside counsel spend against budget. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with broad visibility, partnering closely with Finance, People Operations, Compliance, and the business teams that depend on Legal to move quickly.

Responsibilities

Legal Operations & Contract Management

- Contract Lifecycle Management: Own end-to-end contract intake, routing, workflow optimization, and status tracking using Zip.

- First-Line Agreement Review: Perform initial triage and review of incoming third-party agreements in Zip, evaluating red flags, indemnification terms, and standard boilerplate before escalating complex issues to attorneys.

- Process & Self-Service Optimization: Build and maintain contract templates, playbooks, and self-service tools to empower business teams and eliminate attorney bottlenecks on routine agreements.

- Repository & Record Management: Establish repository standards (e.g., Google Drive structure) and manage post-execution filing and signature routing so critical legal records remain organized, current, and accessible.

Financial Management & Outside Counsel Operations

- Spend Management & Billing: Oversee law firm billing guidelines, manage outside counsel engagements, and perform initial invoice reviews.

- Finance & Accounting Alignment: Track legal spend against department budgets and collaborate directly with Accounting and Finance on monthly accruals, reporting, and operational friction points.

- Vendor Negotiations: Support rate negotiations with outside counsel and evaluate third-party legal vendors.

Corporate Governance, Transactions & Claims (Paralegal Support)

- Entity Management & Cap Table: Manage corporate governance, state filings, annual reports, and registered agent coordination across multiple entities and jurisdictions. Maintain cap table and corporate records in Carta.

- Transaction Support: Coordinate document collection, diligence request tracking, and virtual data room administration (e.g., DataSite) for corporate transactions and financings.

- Litigation & Claims Support: Support in-house claims and litigation intake, issue litigation holds, corporate insurance, coordinate document collection, track deadlines, and liaise with outside litigation counsel.

Legal Technology & Department Analytics

- System Administration: Directly administer legal tooling, including Zip (CLM), Carta, e-signature tools, and billing software.

- Reporting & Metrics: Build and maintain operational dashboards that track legal work volume, spend trends, and process bottlenecks for leadership.

- AI & Automation: Identify and implement emerging AI tools and automation to reduce manual workflows while maintaining appropriate review protocols.

Qualifications

- 5+ years of total experience in legal operations, contract management, or paralegal roles, with a strong core background (3+ years) in corporate paralegal responsibilities.

- Experience in a high-growth, late-stage private company (Series B/C/E) or proptech/fintech/real estate environment preferred (public company experience is not required).

- Solid working understanding of key contract terms (indemnification, liability, boilerplate provisions), corporate entity management across multiple jurisdictions, and litigation hold procedures.

- Practical experience with litigation and claims management, including handling matter intake, issuing litigation holds, managing discovery/document collection, tracking critical deadlines, and coordinating with outside litigation counsel.

- Proven ability to partner across business functions, particularly Finance, Accounting, and Human Resources to streamline operational pain points.

- Adaptable "jack-of-all-trades" mindset and self-starter with strong ownership, high discretion, and a natural instinct to systematize and document processes.

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required

- Advanced proficiency in Google Workspace and Microsoft Excel

- Preferred practical exposure to Zip (CLM), Carta (cap table/entity management), DataSite (VDR), Serengeti/Tracker, or Ironclad

- High degree of ownership, attention to detail, and bias toward action

- Curiosity and willingness to use AI, automation, and emerging technologies to improve efficiency while maintaining proper validation and judgment

- Real estate, proptech, fintech, or other regulated-industry experience preferred

Location

This position must be based in the greater Dallas area

Pay Transparency

Our compensation reflects several US geographic markets. The base pay for this position represents the expected salary for this position. Ultimately, in determining your pay it will be based on several factors including location, job-related knowledge, skills, experience and other job related factors. Roofstock is a total compensation company; the base salary is only a part of our total compensation package.

About the Role

Alarm.com is looking for a Regulatory Compliance Engineer to lead regulatory compliance and product certification strategy across our connected residential and commercial products — security, video, and cloud-integrated IoT platforms. You’ll set the global compliance roadmap, get ahead of emerging regulations before they affect our products, and act as a key interface with testing laboratories and regulatory bodies. You’ll both shape strategy and contribute to certification work that brings products to market, partnering closely with hardware, firmware, and product teams.

- Translate regulatory standards into concrete engineering requirements, embedding life-safety, wireless, cybersecurity, and environmental standards into product architecture, test plans, and product requirements.

jobs.description:
Who We Are:

We’re building the future of real estate — today.

HomeLight is the essential technology platform used by hundreds of thousands of homebuyers and sellers to partner with top real estate agents and win at any step of the real estate journey, whether that’s finding a top agent, securing a competitive mortgage, or ensuring an on-time, easy close.

HomeLight facilitates billions of dollars of real estate on its platform every year. Our vision is a world where every real estate transaction is simple, certain, and satisfying for all.

Our team breaks barriers every day while staying committed to HomeLight's goals and core values, which is a crucial element to our shared success.

Who You Are:

We’re looking for a product-minded, AI-native engineer who doesn’t just ship features — but builds intelligent systems. AI is not an add-on here; it’s embedded into how we design, build, and scale.

If you actively leverage AI to move faster, think in systems, and enjoy operating in ambiguity — this role is for you.

What You'll Do Here

- Collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and cross-functional partners to build scalable, AI-powered product experiences.

- Design, implement, and maintain highly scalable and performant backend services using Ruby on Rails.

- Build modern, responsive frontend applications using React.js (and React Native where applicable).

- Integrate AI-driven capabilities into business workflows (LLM-powered features, intelligent automation, semantic search, copilots, or workflow agents).

- Architect systems that combine traditional service-oriented architecture with AI components (model APIs, orchestration layers, evaluation loops).

- Continuously improve code quality through refactoring, automated testing, system testing, and deployment automation.

- Leverage AI development tools responsibly to increase velocity and maintain high-quality standards.

- Review code developed by other engineers and provide thoughtful feedback on performance, scalability, security, and maintainability — including AI-generated code.

- Maintain a deep understanding of business requirements and partner with stakeholders to design thoughtful, scalable solutions.

- Collaborate across marketing, platform, DevOps, data, product, and analytics teams to ensure engineering decisions align with broader company goals.

- Use data and experimentation to make informed engineering and product decisions.

- Monitor production systems, including AI-driven features, using observability and monitoring tools.

What You Bring

- 2+ years of professional experience as a software engineer.

- 2+ years of production experience with Ruby on Rails.

- 2+ years of experience with React.js or React Native.

- Hands-on experience integrating or building AI-powered features into business workflows (e.g., LLM integrations, AI-assisted user experiences, automation pipelines).

- Experience designing, building, deploying, operating, and maintaining service-oriented architectures.

- Strong experience with relational and non-relational databases.

- Experience navigating ambiguous and complex project requirements with ownership and clarity.

- Experience with observability and monitoring systems (NewRelic, CloudWatch, Sentry).

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

- A product mindset with the ability to balance deterministic software systems and probabilistic AI systems.

Bonus Points For

- Experience building AI copilots, internal productivity tools, or intelligent automation systems.

- Familiarity with vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, or AI retrieval patterns.

- Exposure to Elasticsearch.

- Experience with React Native.

- Experience working with Docker and containerized environments.

- Familiarity with the Amazon AWS ecosystem.

- Experience working in a small, fast-moving team, ideally at a startup.

- Contributions to AI-related side projects, prototypes, or open-source initiatives.

Why This Role Is Different

- AI is embedded in our product strategy and engineering culture.

- Engineers are encouraged to experiment, prototype, and rethink workflows through intelligent automation.

- You’ll help shape how AI is implemented across the organization — not just consume APIs.

Digible Company Overview

Privately owned and operated, Digible was founded in 2017 with a mission to bring sophisticated digital marketing solutions to the multifamily industry. We offer a comprehensive suite of digital services as well as a predictive analytics platform, Fiona, that is the first of its kind.

At Digible, Inc. we love to celebrate our diverse group of hardworking employees – and it shows. We pride ourselves on our collaborative, transparent, and authentic culture. These values are pervasive throughout every step of a Digible employee's journey. Starting with our interviews and continuing through our weekly All Hands Transparency Round-up, values are at the heart of working at Digible.

We value diversity and believe forming teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is key to our success. We encourage people from underrepresented backgrounds and different industries to apply. Come join us and find out what the best work of your career could look like here at Digible.

Digible Core Values:

- Authenticity - The commitment to be steadfast and genuine with our actions and communication toward everyone we touch.

- Curiosity - The belief that a deep and fundamental curiosity (the "why") in our work is vital to company innovation and evolution.

- Focus - The collective will to remain completely devoted and ultimately accountable to our deliverables.

- Humility - The recognition and daily practice that "we" is always greater than "I".

- Happiness - The decision to prioritize passion and love for what we do above everything else.

The Role:

Digible, Inc. is looking for an SEO Strategist to join our team!

The SEO Strategist is a hands-on SEO practitioner and performance owner within Digible’s SEO practice. You manage a portfolio of local SEO campaigns across multifamily, student, senior, and single-family rental properties, applying professional judgment across technical, on-site, and off-site SEO. You directly execute when diagnosis, risk, ambiguity, or continuity materially benefits from Strategist expertise while leveraging SEO Coordinators for standardized implementation, recurring audits, listings, citations, data pulls, and other repeatable execution.

You'll love this job if:

- Take real satisfaction in making a measurable impact across a portfolio of accounts

- Are process-oriented and find genuine pleasure in improving how things work

- Learn quickly and proactively seek out knowledge from senior teammates

- Are passionate about SEO and hungry to go deeper on the technical side

- Take pride in accuracy, consistency, and never missing a deadline

jobs.title: Head of Product - Autopilot
jobs.summary: Blend is a diverse team of problem solvers who believe that the world’s financial resources should be more accessible. Our cloud banking platform is used by Wells Fargo, U.S.
jobs.description:
Blend is a diverse team of problem solvers who believe that the world’s financial resources should be more accessible. Our cloud banking platform is used by Wells Fargo, U.S. Bank, and over 330 other financial services firms to acquire more customers, increase productivity, and deliver end-to-end digital experiences. Our software enables our customers to process an average of more than $5 billion in loans per day, making it possible for consumers to reach their financial goals faster and lead better lives. Come do work that matters.

About the role

Autopilot is Blend's AI agent product for mortgage and lending operations. It works inside the lending workflow to take on the repetitive, high-volume tasks that drive cycle time, starting with in-product automation and extending toward deeper capabilities such as pre-underwriting. Autopilot is one of Blend's most important bets, with direct executive sponsorship and active co-development with some of the largest lenders in the country.

We are hiring a Head of Product to own Autopilot as a business. You will define what the agents do, how their performance is measured, and how capabilities proven with individual customers become productized offerings that every customer can adopt. You will work hand in hand with our AI engineering team, our forward-deployed teams working directly with customers, and our go-to-market organization. You will report to our Head of Product, with direct exposure to the CEO and executive leadership.

What you will do

- Own the in-product Autopilot roadmap, prioritizing agent capabilities by their measurable impact on loan cycle time, cost per loan, and operations team productivity.

- Own Autopilot's commercial model: pricing and packaging across in-product, MCP, and solution-delivery offerings, and adoption at live customers so purchased capability becomes transacted volume.

- Turn learnings from forward-deployed customer engagements into generalized, productized capabilities, deciding what graduates from custom build to core product.

- Define the evaluation and quality framework for agent behavior: accuracy, guardrails, human-in-the-loop review, and auditability appropriate for regulated lending workflows.

- Partner with AI engineering on model, tooling, and harness decisions, and translate technical capability into a roadmap with clear customer outcomes.

- Work directly with design partner customers in discovery, pilot design, and rollout, and build the feedback loop from live production usage back into the roadmap.

- Define Autopilot's measurement and reporting story so customers can see the value the agents deliver, and so Blend can price and package with confidence.

- Support go-to-market with positioning input, demo narratives, and roadmap content for customer advisory board and executive audiences.

What you will bring

- 10 or more years of product experience, including leadership of an AI, ML, or automation product with real production usage and commercial accountability for its results.
Domain experience in mortgage, home equity, or consumer lending operations, with fluency in the loan lifecycle to be credible with lending executives.

- Strong instinct for agent and LLM product design: evaluation, prompt and tool design, human-in-the-loop patterns, and knowing when a workflow is ready for autonomy.

- Comfort operating in a domain with high accuracy and compliance requirements, and designing products that earn trust from risk and operations stakeholders.

- A builder's posture: you prototype, you get into the data, and you use AI tools daily in your own work.

- Experience working directly with enterprise customers in discovery and pilots, and turning individual customer wins into repeatable products.

- Crisp written and verbal communication, with the ability to present to executives and customer leadership.

Nice to have

- Engineering background or a technical path into product, with credibility partnering with AI engineering teams.

- Experience in a forward-deployed engineering or solutions model.

- Familiarity with underwriting, income and asset verification, or loan quality processes.

Compensation:

- Base Salary Range: $163,000 – $191,000 (This applies to full time hires. Final offer determined by multiple factors, including but not limited to function, level, geographic location, job related knowledge, skills, and experience.)

- Bonus (if applicable): Eligibility is contingent upon both company performance against established goals and achievement of individual performance objectives.

- Equity : Meaningful Restricted Stock Units in public company stock (NYSE: BLND) so you share in Blend’s long-term growth and success.

Our Benefits at a Glance

We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support your health and work-life balance.

Health & Wellbeing

- We offer medical, dental, and vision benefits, with a generous employer contribution that helps keep your medical insurance costs low.

- Company-paid life, short-term, and long-term disability coverage

- Generous PTO, holidays, and maternity/parental leave

- Employee Assistance Program (EAP): mental health, legal, childcare & eldercare, financial planning, college search, and more

- Voluntary benefits: accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity, identity theft, and legal insurance

- Monthly wellness stipend for fitness, mental health, and well-being

- Additional perks: Milk Stork, pet insurance, and paid volunteer time off

Growth & Future

- 401(k) retirement plan with company match

- Pre-tax savings: healthcare & dependent care FSAs, Limited Purpose FSA, and HSA

jobs.title: IT Specialist
jobs.summary: If you’re good at what you do, you can work anywhere. If you’re the best at what you do, come work for Doma Technology.
jobs.description:
If you’re good at what you do, you can work anywhere. If you’re the best at what you do, come work for Doma Technology.

About Us 

Doma Technology LLC offers solutions for lenders, real estate professionals, title agents, and homeowners that make closings vastly simpler and more efficient, reducing cost and increasing customer satisfaction.

Our Values

- Obsessively Entrepreneurial - We encourage calculated risk-taking, and we know that some of our best learning happens by making mistakes along the way.

- People First - We communicate with honesty and respect to our customers, colleagues, and partners.

- Better Together - We believe diversity, equity and inclusion creates value through the differences in our backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

- Act with Integrity - We hold ourselves to the highest ethical standards in all of our business practices.

IT Specialist

Position Summary

This is a contract 40-hour/week position paying between $25-27.50/hr.

Doma Technology is looking for an IT Specialist to provide responsive, thoughtful support to employees across our technology environment. This early-career role is primarily responsible for Tier 1 requests and incidents, with opportunities to assist with selected Tier 2 work under guidance. You will help employees stay productive from onboarding through offboarding, document what you learn, and escalate complex or high-impact issues through defined paths. This is a development-focused opportunity for someone with approximately one to two years of experience who wants to build a strong foundation in IT operations. You will receive structured training and hands-on mentoring, gain exposure to Information Technology and Cybersecurity, and learn to work within an evolving support model that includes new AI-enabled automations.

Key Responsibilities

Service and Support

- Serve as a first point of contact for IT requests and incidents through Freshservice, email, Teams, and phone.

- Troubleshoot and resolve Tier 1 issues involving hardware, software, Windows and macOS devices, Microsoft 365, connectivity, VPN, and access.

- Assist with selected Tier 2 issues under the guidance of experienced team members, documenting the diagnosis and outcome.

- Assess impact and urgency, work within service expectations, and keep employees informed through clear and timely updates.

- Escalate unresolved, high-impact, or security-sensitive issues through defined paths to IT leadership and the appropriate Security, Engineering, or managed service resources.

- Provide courteous, patient, and discreet support to employees at every level, including executives and other users handling sensitive information.

Employee Technology Lifecycle

- Support onboarding by preparing devices, coordinating account creation, enrolling multifactor authentication, and confirming day-one readiness.

- Complete assigned offboarding tasks promptly, including approved account actions, asset recovery, and license reclamation.

- Fulfill approved identity and access requests such as password resets, MFA enrollment, mailbox permissions, and group membership changes.

- Track equipment assignments, returns, shipments, and device reimaging in Snipe-IT or the designated asset management system.

- Partner with Human Resources, IT leadership, and business teams to maintain accurate records and a clear audit trail for access changes.

Security Cross Training and Operational Readiness

- Participate in structured cross-training with the Cybersecurity Team to build practical knowledge of security operations and controls.

- Follow access governance, change control, data handling, and incident escalation procedures in every support interaction.

- Recognize and report suspicious activity, including phishing, unusual access behavior, and potentially compromised devices, using established procedures.

- As training and proficiency grow, provide documented coverage across IT Operations and Information Security when additional support is needed, while remaining within established responsibilities and escalation boundaries.

Documentation Automation and Improvement

- Record troubleshooting steps, decisions, and resolutions in the ITSM so work can be understood, measured, and repeated.

- Create and maintain knowledge articles, FAQs, and quick guides that help employees and support teammates resolve common issues.

- Use approved AI-enabled automations across support workflows, reviewing outputs for accuracy, security, and appropriate handling before acting on them.

- Identify repetitive work that may be suitable for self-service or automation and share practical feedback as new workflows are introduced.

- Participate in service reviews, share recurring issue patterns, and recommend improvements that strengthen employee support and operational readiness.

Skills and Qualifications

Required

- Approximately one to two years of experience in IT support, help desk, desktop support, or comparable hands-on technical work.

- Foundational knowledge of Windows or macOS, Microsoft 365, Teams, remote support tools, identity and access concepts, and basic network troubleshooting.

- Ability to diagnose issues methodically, explain next steps in plain language, and confirm that the solution meets the employee's need.

- A service-oriented approach marked by empathy, patience, professionalism, and respect for people with different levels of technical experience.

- Clear written and verbal communication, including accurate ticket notes and concise user-facing instructions.

- Sound judgment when prioritizing work, protecting confidential information, following procedures, and deciding when to escalate.

- Curiosity, adaptability, and an interest in building skills in automation, information security, and modern IT operations.

Preferred

- Experience with an IT service management or ticketing platform such as Freshservice, ServiceNow, or Jira Service Management.

- Familiarity with Intune, Jamf, Entra ID, or comparable endpoint and identity management tools.

- Working knowledge of common connectivity concepts and troubleshooting for Wi-Fi, VPN, DNS, and remote access.

- Awareness of ITIL practices and foundational security concepts such as least privilege, multifactor authentication, and phishing prevention.

- CompTIA A+, ITIL Foundation, an entry-level security certification (Security+), or active interest in pursuing a relevant certification.

Learning and Career Development

The IT Operations team will provide structured training, hands-on mentoring, and opportunities to pursue relevant IT certifications. You will learn alongside experienced colleagues, gain broader exposure through cross-training with Information Security and Cybersecurity, and take on more complex support work as your skills develop. Joining now also offers the chance to grow with Doma Technology's evolving support model as we introduce new processes, AI-enabled automations, and service capabilities. The role is designed to help you build confidence, sound technical judgment, and a strong foundation for continued growth in IT.
How we’ll value you and make your life a bit easier:

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits to eligible employees (FTE, non-contract): medical/dental/vision insurance, 401(k), generous vacation time, and paid bonding leave.

Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, or any other form of compensation that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole discretion, consistent with the law.

We believe the most valuable investment we can make is to build an outstanding team of colleagues and leaders who are passionate about our mission.

We currently offer the following benefits to all Full-Time employees:

- Work/Life Balance - We encourage taking Paid Time Off (PTO)!

- 12 Weeks of Paid Family Bonding Leave (Maternity and Paternity)

- Incredible medical, dental, and vision benefits options to allow you to customize to you and your family’s needs that all start in the following month following your first day of employment

- Health Savings Account (HSA)

- 401K with company match program

- Short-Term & Long-Term Disability

- Supplemental Life and AD&D Insurance

- Critical Illness, Injury and Hospital Insurance 

We believe in Equal Opportunity

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Our software enables our customers to process an average of more than $5 billion in loans per day, making it possible for consumers to reach their financial goals faster and lead better lives. Come do work that matters.

As a Software Engineer at Blend, you will design, implement, and maintain the platform that powers 20% of mortgages in the US. You'll work closely with our product development team to translate customer needs into functional, scalable software — and you'll do it the modern way: with AI coding agents woven into every stage of your development lifecycle. We're an engineering organization that builds AI-first.

How you'll contribute:

- Build features end-to-end across the stack — from responsive, accessible user interfaces to resilient, scalable back-end services.

- Use AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex daily across the software development lifecycle: planning, design, codebase analysis, implementation, testing, documentation, code review, and refactoring.

- Apply and help evolve our AI-driven development lifecycle (AIDLC) practices — spec-driven development, agentic workflows, and effective context and prompt engineering — and share what you learn with the team.

- Review, test, and harden AI-generated code to production quality. You own everything you ship, no matter who (or what) wrote the first draft.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical specifications and code.

- Work with product managers and UI/UX designers to implement new features and enhancements with a seamless, accessible user experience across devices.

- Design and develop applications that scale, with maintenance, resiliency, and robustness in mind.

- Identify and troubleshoot software defects and issues, ensuring timely resolution.

- Participate in code reviews to maintain code quality — including thoughtful review of AI-assisted contributions — and offer peer mentorship and guidance.

- Participate in the team's on-call rotation.

- Create your own story! Some of Blend's best features have come from engineering initiatives. You'll have an opportunity to propose new ideas and build features end-to-end.

Who you are:

- You have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience) with 2-5 years of experience building production software.

- You use AI to write code every day. Tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex aren't experiments for you — they're core to how you work, and you stay current as they evolve.

- You're proficient in the latest AIDLC techniques: decomposing problems into well-scoped tasks an agent can execute, writing effective specs and prompts, managing context, and critically evaluating AI output for correctness, security, and maintainability.

- You're a full-stack developer: comfortable in back-end development with languages such as Node.js, TypeScript, or Golang, and in front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern frameworks like React.

- You have experience working with databases like Postgres, MongoDB, or similar technologies.

- You're hungry to learn. You have high learning velocity, you're curious about new tools and techniques, and you treat a fast-changing toolchain as an opportunity rather than a burden.

- You're an excellent communicator who can operate independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment, driving projects to a successful outcome.

Our Benefits at a Glance

We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support your health and work-life balance.

Health & Wellbeing

jobs.summary: Envoy protects the places the world relies on most by unifying people, spaces, and communications in one secure, integrated workplace management platform and ecosystem.
jobs.description:
Envoy protects the places the world relies on most by unifying people, spaces, and communications in one secure, integrated workplace management platform and ecosystem. More than 16,000 workplaces around the world trust Envoy to run secure, compliant, and connected operations across every location.

From manufacturing sites and data centers to pharmaceutical labs, healthcare facilities, and corporate headquarters, Envoy makes safety, security and associated regulatory compliance something our customers can be proud of. The industry is littered with box-checking and arcane manual processes as the standard and we see our role as the company to bring experience, efficiency and simplicity everywhere. Great experiences bring great security – it's a requirement. We hope this problem space excites you and we hope you're ready to come sweat the details with us – we have a lot of customers counting on us! And it certainly won't be easy.

Learn more at envoy.com

About the Role: Product management here at Envoy is the most critical role in ensuring customers and their end-users love the products they use. Every decision you make will directly impact tens of thousands of workplaces around the world and their millions of occupants, be them employees, visitors, contractors, etc. Envoy seeks to deliver next-level operational efficiency, data-drivenness, safety, and security for everyone involved, and our solutions must be highly thoughtful about this at scale. You will be responsible for this for your product or product line. This isn't an easy job, but if high stakes is your game, you'll enjoy things a lot.

We are currently looking for a product leader to own and evolve a large portion of Envoy Visitors, our flagship visitor management platform used by companies all around the world. Visitors is very powerful – customers are using it to meet strict regulatory compliances in their industries. They need to do background checks to make sure people aren't from sanctioned countries, they are requiring specific OSHA trainings of their contractors, they need full audit logs of all changes over hundreds of facilities, they need to provision access control credentials for specific vendors, there's a lot going on and at scale. What you'll be working on is absolutely critical to the safety and security of their operations so thoughtfulness is critical every day. There’s a lot of surface area, a lot of different customer needs, and a lot of opportunity to make big industry-changing decisions. It's what they've been waiting for.

We're currently a small and nimble product team looking to grow from leadership previously being spread throughout product design roles, product marketing, engineering management, and we even have some IC engineers running their products externally. Needless to say, we recognize this isn't going to scale, and we want to get ahead of it with your ownership and help. This brings inward opportunity too – as the product team grows, we'll need product line leaders and organizers, and we'd much rather promote from within when possible. But for now, this is an IC PM role as that's the immediate need.

This is a full-time, 5-day onsite role in San Francisco (410 Townsend St). Please remember we are a workplace company. We build products for workplaces and we believe that we can only become experts in something when we surround ourselves in it! We're happy to help move you out here if necessary. We also help with visa transfers if needed.

We hope this all sounds great to you so far!

As a baseline, you will need
- 5+ years of experience in Product Management, preferably in B2B with enterprise exposure and 0-1 product building experience

- An undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a quantitative field

In this role, you will
- Meticulously own vision, roadmap, strategy, and execution of your products

- Launch products and be ultimately responsible for the success/failure of the products/features based on the goals/metrics you define.

- Push for quality and urgency despite constant challenges for one or the other. You need to enjoy this battle.

- Be the primary switchboard and gather feedback from customers directly, our sales/success teams, and others cross-functionally to create an opinion and get things iterated, built, and launched. You must be good at rational decision-making; not everyone will always agree, yet you'll still need their support.

- Be the point person to customers during beta or high-iteration periods in products. And you'll run internal dogfooding.

- Story-tell internally the importance of what we're building to engineering ICs, designers, researchers and the general company, encouraging bottoms up ownership, creative thinking and internal contribution.

- Own much of pricing and packaging, and you'll ensure sales training happens as you expect for your products. There is no throwing-over-the-wall allowed here.

- You'll bring your existing product processes and help us all elevate our product execution.

- And yes, it has to be said, roles change over time; this job description is dynamic, you need to be comfortable in an environment where things can change a lot.

Your values: Every company is unique, with its own culture and community, and specific values that make things gel. There is no one general fingerprint for what makes a 'good' company or a 'bad' one, it's all dependent on your personal values and how well they map to the values of the company you're part of. It's therefore critical you and us match well together. As you explore the list below, please be real with yourself – is this the kind of environment you really want? If not "yes absolutely", it's best to not apply, trust us, you're going to have a bad time. If however, these describe you, you're going to have an amazing time here with friends you'll retain for years to come. We hope this describes you!
- You have a passion for workplaces, have strong end-user intuition and demand products you yourself can proudly use daily

- You thrive in ambiguous, low-guidance environments. You seek accountability and to own the success (and failure!) of everything you work on.

- You have a high bar for everything you build, including the way it looks and feels, spending the time necessary to achieve quality to winning standards. Especially in Enterprise software, notorious for putting quality by the wayside.

- You create and hold yourself and your team to success metrics. You are data-driven, relying on numbers to persuade versus necessarily just high-paying customer anecdotes.

- You are impatient and expect things sooner than in a couple weeks, months or quarters

- You have high empathy and humility and understand you're always learning. You're also aggressively a believer that everyone you work with must be this way too.

- You rely on AI tooling and truly see it as a massive force multiplier and you are excited about constantly evolving yourself to best reap its benefits. You are also excited to share the AI discoveries that you're continuously making (and you expect the same of your peers too).

- You believe teams being in-office are the best way to solve problems fast and build great products.

- You look for all these same values from your current and future teammates and would be disappointed and even consider departing if we compromised too often. You want to be part of a like-minded team and culture.

By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have fully read and understand the job requirements and received the Envoy Privacy Notice for applicants, which is linked here. Completing this application requires you to provide personal data, such as your name and contact information, which is mandatory for Envoy to process your application. Envoy is an EEO Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by local, state or federal law.

jobs.description:
What we do and why we do it

As the leading end-to-end investment platform for single-family rental homes (SFR), our mission is to reinvent the rental housing ecosystem for the benefit of all. We successfully merge our passion for helping investors build wealth through real estate with cutting edge technology that transforms the way they do it.

How it's going (and growing)

With a talented team of 750+ Roofsters, our collaborative, can-do culture is what fuels our growth. In 2022, we closed on our Series E, raising $240 million, and have offices in the Bay Area and New York City. Our growth includes recent acquisitions of Stessa (financial and asset management software), RentPrep (tenant screening and placement service for landlords), and Mynd (property management platform for both Retail and Institutional investors).

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Manager, Accounting to lead our accounts payable, procurement, and corporate accounting functions. This is a hybrid role that pairs ownership of AP and procurement operations with hands-on general accounting: booking and reviewing journal entries, researching GL issues, preparing and reviewing reconciliations, owning payroll and benefits accounting, and producing cash reporting and the monthly close package. The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader who can both manage a team and dig into the details of the close.

Responsibilities

- Own AP & Procurement: Manage and oversee the full cycle of accounts payable and procurement operations, including invoice processing and approval routing, purchase order workflow, contract approvals, vendor onboarding/KYC, and vendor escalations

- Payroll & Benefits: Own payroll and benefits accounting, including related journal entries and account reconciliations

- Journal Entries & Account Reconciliations: Prepare and review journal entries. Reconcile 100% of balance sheet accounts monthly

- Month-end close: Support the monthly close process, ensuring deadlines are met and results are accurate and compliant with US GAAP, and speed up the close to a 4 to 5 day timeline

- Reporting: Produce recurring cash reporting (monthly at minimum, ideally weekly) and the monthly close package, including GAAP financials, reconciliation to non-GAAP measures (including EBITDA), and cash analysis

- Team management: Manage a team of two initially (may increase next year), including day-to-day supervision, workload assignment, and review

- Cross-functional: Partner cross-functionally with FP&A, external consultants, and other departments on special projects

- Process improvement: Identify opportunities for automation and process optimization to increase efficiency and accuracy

- AI & automation: Identify and implement AI-driven automation for journal entries and accounting workflows to improve accuracy and accelerate the close process

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance required

- 4+ years of progressive accounting experience

- 1-2 years in a supervisory or team-lead role

- Experience managing month-end and year-end close in a fast-paced environment

- Hands-on experience with accounts payable and procurement operations

- Solid working knowledge of US GAAP

- Advanced Excel skills and proficiency in financial reporting tools

Nice to Have

- Hands-on experience with major ERP systems (NetSuite)

- Experience with AP or procurement platforms (Zip, Ramp)

- Payroll and benefits accounting experience

- Big 4 or large regional public accounting experience

- CPA preferred

Travel Required

N/A

This position is classified as a HYBRID work environment in Oakland, CA.

This is a 2 day hybrid role in the Bay Area office, effective October 2026.

$120,000 - $145,000 annually

Compensation may be adjusted based on experience, skills, and interview performance.

Ultimately, in determining your pay it will be based on several factors including location, job-related knowledge, skills, experience and other job-related factors. Roofstock is a total compensation company; the base salary is only a part of our total compensation package.

jobs.description:
VTS is looking for an intelligent, self-motivated sales professional to join our team as an Account Executive in our New York office. Our Account Executives are hard working, coachable, curious, adaptable and take a process-oriented approach to closing new business on a quarterly basis. If this describes you and being at the forefront of innovation in the world’s second largest asset class, then we want you on our team!

As an Account Executive at VTS, you’ll lead net-new customer acquisition across strategic, high-value accounts. This role is designed for a consultative seller who thrives in complex sales cycles, can operate at the executive level, and consistently closes large, multi-year deals.

You will own the full sales lifecycle—from prospecting and discovery through negotiation and close—while partnering closely with Sales Development, Solutions Engineering, Product, and Leadership

To thrive in this role you must be driven, and possess an eagerness to learn. A high level of accountability towards a quality work product. You value collaboration, engaging cross-functional partners to solve challenges to ensure the best strategy is applied to the client. You should possess a natural curiosity and desire to understand the business, customer insights, and real estate industry.

** Please note that this opportunity is located in New York, NY, and requires this hire to work from our office 4 days a week. **

What Makes This Job Awesome?

- Help bring Commercial Real Estate into the 21st Century - map customer’s key issues to our solution

- Become an expert on the VTS product suite and value proposition (focus on driving tenant experience outcomes on an asset level through VTS RIse)

- Present to C-level executives on the value of the VTS solution through product demonstrations in person and via web tools

- Represent VTS and evangelize our vision through in-market events, industry groups, and CRE specific initiatives

- Prospect, nurture, and close new business

- Accurately forecast and execute on quarterly revenue targets

- Negotiate pricing and sales contracts to close new business while navigating multiple decision makers

- Work closely with sales, account management, and customer support teams to ensure our customers are successful

- Form relationships with senior decision makers, asset managers, and brokers at the top commercial real estate firms across the country

What Makes You a Great Fit?

- Proven track record of closing complex deals (typically $50K-$500K+ ACV)

- Experience selling to senior executives (VP, SVP, C-suite)

- Strong discovery, negotiation, and deal-strategy skills

- Ability to operate independently and manage long, consultative sales cycles

- Experience with CRM systems (Salesforce or equivalent)

Preferred

- Background in selling multi-year or usage-based contracts

What VTS Values & How We Show It:

- Strive for Excellence - We know your potential is unlimited. Take advantage of our executive coaches and our training and career development programs available to all employees!

- Be Customer Obsessed - We’re employee obsessed too! VTS offers competitive compensation, comprehensive health benefits (including dental and vision), pre-tax commuter benefits, and a 401(k) plan. Not to mention the fun stuff - quarterly happy hours, wellness events, clubs, and team lunches!

- Be Curious - Benefit from a culture that promotes new learning. VTS offers an education stipend to all employees!

- Move as One - We work in an open floor plan to promote cross-functional collaboration.

- Take Ownership - Be an owner of the company you’re building with our equity packages.

- Appreciate the Difference - VTS embraces and celebrates diversity. We understand the importance of a strong work-life balance. We offer a flexible PTO policy, generous family leave program, and more!

ABOUT VTS

VTS is the only AI-driven technology platform enabling intelligent real estate by unifying industry professionals, investors, and their customers at scale. In 2013, VTS revolutionized commercial real estate leasing operations with what is now VTS Lease. Today, VTS AI is the largest first-party insights and collaboration engine in the industry, transforming how strategic decisions are made and executed by the real estate industry globally.

With the VTS Platform, consisting of VTS Lease, VTS Market, VTS Activate, and VTS Data, every stakeholder in real estate is given real-time market information and workflow tools to do their job with unparalleled speed and intelligence. VTS is the global leader, with more than 60% of Class A office space in the U.S., and 13 billion square feet of office, residential, retail, and industrial space is managed through the platform worldwide. VTS is utilized by over 45,000 professionals and over 1.2 million total users each day, including industry-leading customers such as Blackstone, Brookfield Properties, LaSalle Investment Management, Hines, BXP, Oxford Properties, JLL, and CBRE.

VTS maintains offices in New York, London, Toronto, Chicago.

To learn more about VTS and view our open roles, visit us at vts.com or follow us on Instagram (@WeAreVTS) or LinkedIn.

Pay Transparency

At VTS, we pride ourselves on articulating a clear and transparent philosophy around equitable, impartial compensation that will allow us to recruit and retain an exceptional team. The base salary is market-driven at the time of offer and is based on tier 1 market data. The salary for this role will range between $110,000 - $130,000 and is determined by several factors, including your skills, prior relevant experience, quality of interviews, leveling, and geography. There is a commission structure for the position that will bring the OTE (on target earnings) to $270,000 - $290,000 depending on the base salary agreed upon and achievement to goals.

EEO Guidelines

VTS embraces diversity and equal opportunity in a serious way. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. For more information about what we collect and how we use it, please refer to the Candidate Privacy Statement.

jobs.title: VP, Product
jobs.summary: We live in a world where everything has become convenient. Now you can get a ride anywhere, buy anything, answer any question with just a couple clicks on your phone.
jobs.description:
We live in a world where everything has become convenient. Now you can get a ride anywhere, buy anything, answer any question with just a couple clicks on your phone. Convenience isn’t a luxury, it’s an expectation.
So why not renting? It’s still a chore to get utilities set up, buy renters insurance, get air filters changed, handle pest control, and more.
That’s why we’ve built the world’s first Resident Experience Platform that makes resident onboarding, resident services, and ancillary revenue effortless for property managers.
We’re passionate about turning friction into triple win experiences for residents, property managers, and investors. That way renting can be easy and rewarding for everyone.
And now you can join us. Apply today to join 300+ passionate, creative people who strive to make a difference each day so residents, property managers, and investors all win – creating the ultimate Triple Win.

Role Snapshot
Second Nature is seeking a senior product executive to lead Product Management as a portfolio of businesses. This is the most senior product management role at the company, reporting to the Chief Product & Technology Officer with regular, direct exposure to the CEO/Founder and executive team given the strategic weight of the portfolio.
This role leads a team of Group Product Managers, each accountable for a product line as a business. Working with that group as general managers of their product lines to drive business outcomes is central to the job.

Why This Role Exists
Second Nature is converting strong bookings growth into long-term enterprise value by expanding the Resident Benefits Package category. This leader owns whether expansion happens, through a Product Management organization accountable for unit economics, revenue, and retention. The scoreboard:
- Attach rates across the core portfolio, with the mechanisms understood well enough to repeat as product lines expand

- The share of new revenue carried by newer product lines, broadening the portfolio beyond its current base

- Retention and new logo acquisition, with clear attribution to the work that drove them

- Unit economics across the portfolio, improved without trading away growth

- A roadmap that is a rationalized allocation of investment against business outcomes, resourced to execute and delivered against

This is a business leadership role first, expressed through outstanding product management. The right person is as fluent discussing customer lifetime value, unit economics, and market opportunity as they are discussing a roadmap or a discovery plan.
They read a business review the way an operator does - what is working, what is not, and what needs to change - and translate that read into clear direction for the leaders and teams who report to them. This leader treats product excellence as something measured by customer experience as well as business outcomes and holds the same standard across the portfolio.

The First 100 Days
- Discovery is funded as protected capacity, and prioritization is running on demand-side customer data

- Investment is focused on what customer evidence supports, and the organization understands the reasoning

- Group Product Managers are accountable for enrollment, revenue, and retention targets within their Product Domains

- The attach rate growth mechanism is defined for the core lines and being tested

How This Leader Operates
- Commercial Curiosity: Asks what moves revenue and what customers will pay for before asking what to build

- Disciplined Prioritization: Allocates investment against a stated methodology, and can explain what was displaced, what it cost, and why, whenever priorities change

- Talent Multiplier: Raises the bar on product talent and develops product managers into general managers of their lines

- Bias to Action Under Ambiguity: Moves decisions forward with imperfect information, and is energized rather than destabilized by speed and ambiguity

jobs.description:
Software Engineer II, Home Automation Experience Team

Our Home Automation Experience (HAX) team owns the full home automation domain at Alarm.com including devices, device groups, rules, schedules, scenes, and automation-related notifications, for both customers and dealers, across web, mobile, and the backend services that make it all work. Alarm.com is a smart-home-as-a-service platform — our products reach end customers through a network of professional security and smart-home dealers who install, configure, and support our systems, which means HAX builds for two distinct audiences with very different needs. If 'intuitive, accessible, reliable home automation' is the kind of problem you want to spend the next several years on, this is a good place to do it.

As a Software Engineer II on HAX, you'll support the delivery of high-impact features end to end, from partnering with Product Management and Quality Engineering, collaborating with your peer engineers, to being involved in and owning technical designs and feature implementations. You'll move across the stack as the work demands: frontend, backend, data, infrastructure.

Alarm.com is one of the few places you can build consumer products that ship at a consumer scale across this kind of technology surface (wireless, software, hardware/device) without changing companies. Engineers here go deep in their area and stay curious about everything else.

WHY WORK AT ALARM.COM?

- Open Collaborative Environment: We have a strong focus on teamwork, and we work to create a collaborative and welcoming environment that enables our teams to excel

- Wide Technology Exposure: You’ll gain exposure to a broad spectrum of IoT and SaaS technology. Our tech stack includes C# .NET, SQL Server, Kafka, Ember.js, React, Node.js, Python, Kubernetes, Azure, Redis, as well as native iOS and Android applications

- Bring Your Full Self: We want to give you the freedom and trust to bring your own unique experiences to make best in class products

- Supportive Team: We place high value on our team’s inquisitive, collaborative, and supportive culture. We hold coffee chats, technical spotlights, team-building events, and offer pair programming rotations as ways to connect with our teammates beyond direct project work

- In-person Experience: com values working together and collaborating in person. You will be working from the office 4 days a week

WHAT CAN YOU DO FOR ALARM.COM?

- Develop full stack software for a wide variety of platforms and technologies.

- Take part in the entire project life cycle, from requirements development to deployment with heavy cross-team collaboration

- Engage in the research, evaluation, and application of new technologies and methodologies to solve challenging project goals

- Write coherent, organized code. Ideal candidates must be comfortable working on a complicated codebase with high levels of abstraction

- Exercise good judgment. Know when to work quickly, and when to build a robust solution

- Work hard and be flexible: we have quick development cycles, evolving requirements, and lots of cross-team collaboration

- Bring your ideas! We want our engineers to collaborate on product development, not blindly build to a spec

WHAT DO YOU NEED?

We are seeking someone who has:

- Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, a related field or equivalent work experience

- 2+ years of professional software development experience

- Solid frontend engineering skills with modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks (for example, React, Ember, Vue, or Angular)

- Solid backend engineering skills building and maintaining HTTP APIs/services (REST and/or GraphQL)

- Solid knowledge of object-oriented design, SOLID principles, and common design patterns, with a track record of applying them to real architectural decisions (Experience with C#, .NET Core is a plus)

- Solid database fundamentals including schema design, query optimization, indexing

- Fluency with the day-to-day toolchain of a modern engineer — version control (Git workflows), CI/CD, package managers, structured data formats (JSON, YAML), and observability tooling

- Demonstrated testing depth across unit, integration, and end-to-end test layers

- Experience providing feedback to peers and influencing code quality through design and code reviews

- Treats engineering as a craft that pursues mastery through deliberate practice, post-incident learning, and reflection on past decisions; comfortable revisiting and revising prior architectural choices when new information arrives

- Proven ability to communicate and collaborate across product, design, and QA and drive technical decisions through delivery

- Experience scoping and decomposing ambiguous problems into shippable increments

We would love if you have some of the below (but it is fine if you don’t):

- Experience working with enterprise-scale microservices architecture

- Familiarity with event-driven/distributed system design and distributed event streaming platforms (Kafka)

- Experience using AI-assisted development tools effectively while maintaining code quality and safety

- Familiarity with cloud-native infrastructure and containerized deployments (Docker + Kubernetes)

- Exposure to legacy-to-modern framework migrations

- Working knowledge of application security fundamentals (auth, authorization, input validation, secrets handling)

Please note that sponsorship of new applicants for employment authorization, or any other immigration-related support, is not available for this position at this time.

WHY WORK FOR ALARM.COM?

- Collaborate with outstanding people: We hire only the best. Our standards are high and our employees enjoy working alongside other high achievers.

- Make an immediate impact: New employees can expect to be given real responsibility for bringing new technologies to the marketplace. You are empowered to perform as soon as you join the Alarm.com team!

- Gain well rounded experience: Alarm.com offers a diverse and dynamic environment where you will get the chance to work directly with executives and develop expertise across multiple areas of the business.

- Community and Camaraderie: One of our core values is to 'Keep It Fun,' which to us means fostering a strong sense of community. Our culture is built on collaboration and connection, where we celebrate our successes and believe that a positive, engaging environment is key to doing our best work.

- Alarm.com values working together and collaborating in person. Our employees work from the office 4 days a week.

COMPANY INFO

Alarm.com is the leading platform for intelligently connected properties. Millions of homeowners and businesses rely on Alarm.com's technology to secure, monitor, and manage their environments from anywhere. Our comprehensive suite of solutions—including security, video surveillance, access control, active shooter detection, intelligent automation, energy management, and wellness—is delivered exclusively through a trusted network of thousands of professional service providers and commercial integrators across North America and worldwide. Alarm.com's common stock is traded on Nasdaq under the ticker symbol ALRM. Alarm.com delivers serious security for serious people.

For more information, please visit www.alarm.com.

COMPANY BENEFITS

Our total rewards package is designed to support you holistically—in your health, your finances, and your life outside of work. The package includes medical plans with company subsidies, a Health Savings Account (HSA) with a company contribution, and a 401(k) with an employer match. We encourage a healthy work-life balance with paid vacation that increases with tenure, paid holidays, wellness time, and paid maternity and bonding leave. To complete the package, we also provide company-paid disability and life insurance, all within a collaborative and casual work environment.

Alarm.com is an Equal Opportunity Employer

In connection with your application, we collect information that identifies, reasonably relates to or describes you ("Personal Information"). The categories of Personal Information that we may collect include your name, government-issued identification number(s), email address, mailing address, other contact information, emergency contact information, employment history, educational history, criminal record, and demographic information. We collect and use those categories of Personal Information about you for human resources and other business management purposes, including identifying and evaluating you as a candidate for potential or future employment or future positions, recordkeeping in relation to recruiting and hiring, conducting criminal background checks as permitted by law, conducting analytics, and ensuring compliance with applicable legal requirements and Company policies. By submitting your application, you acknowledge that we may retain some of the personal data that you provide in your application for our internal operations such as managing our recruitment system and ensuring that we comply with labor laws and regulations even after we have made our employment decision.

In the event we receive a resume or candidate referral for this position from a third-party recruiter or agency without a previously signed agreement, we reserve the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to you. jobs.description:
Envoy protects the places the world relies on most by unifying people, spaces, and communications in one secure, integrated workplace management platform and ecosystem. More than 16,000 workplaces around the world trust Envoy to run secure, compliant, and connected operations across every location.

From manufacturing sites and data centers to pharmaceutical labs, healthcare facilities, and corporate headquarters, Envoy makes safety, security and associated regulatory compliance something our customers can be proud of. The industry is littered with box-checking and arcane manual processes as the standard and we see our role as the company to bring experience, efficiency and simplicity everywhere. Great experiences bring great security – it's a requirement. We hope this problem space excites you and we hope you're ready to come sweat the details with us – we have a lot of customers counting on us! And it certainly won't be easy.

Learn more at envoy.com

This is an L3 opportunity. Successful candidates often come from senior engineering roles and are experienced in leading complex projects, mentoring peers, and making architectural contributions across teams.
 
About the Role
Fullstack engineering at Envoy sits at the intersection of product, systems, and real-world experience. The features you build touch everything — from the interfaces millions of people use to interact with their workplace, to the administrator experiences that help organizations manage users, access, permissions, and workplace settings at scale.

As a Fullstack Engineer, you'll own meaningful product areas end-to-end, partnering closely with Product, Design, and Engineering to translate complex problems into simple, high-quality solutions. Your work spans the full stack — from scalable backend systems and APIs to performant, accessible frontend experiences. We value engineers who move fluidly across the stack and take pride in the quality of everything they ship.

We hire for strong full stack fundamentals and a product mindset first. The balance between frontend and backend depth is flexible - some engineers skew heavier toward the frontend, others toward the backend. What matters most is end-to-end ownership and high-quality execution across the stack.

This role requires equal depth across frontend and backend. UI craftsmanship and backend systems carry the same weight — you'll move fluidly across the stack, and neither side is secondary. Full end-to-end ownership is the expectation.

This is an on-site position that requires 4 days a week (Monday through Thursday) in our San Francisco HQ office.
 
You will
- Build and ship high-quality, scalable features across the full stack — frontend UI, backend services, and APIs

- Partner closely with Product, Design, and Engineering to deliver thoughtful, user-centered solutions

- Design and evolve backend systems: APIs, data models, and services consumed by web and mobile clients

- Build performant, accessible, and maintainable frontend experiences using React and modern web technologies

- Contribute to architecture decisions, shared components, and engineering standards across the stack

- Design and optimize relational data models (Postgres) and improve system performance and observability

- Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and continuous improvement of engineering quality

- Own features end-to-end, from discovery and design through launch and iteration

- Build intuitive administrator experiences for managing users, access, permissions, identity, and authentication across complex organizations

You have
- A BS or MS in Computer Science or a related technical field

- 7+ years of experience building production software, with meaningful fullstack or cross-stack contributions

- Strong frontend fundamentals, including React and JavaScript/TypeScript, with a solid foundation in HTML and CSS

- Backend experience building and consuming APIs (RESTful and/or GraphQL), with production exposure to TypeScript, Java/Kotlin, and/or Ruby on Rails

- Experience building or integrating identity and authentication systems, including SCIM, SSO, OAuth, and SAML

- Experience designing relational schemas and working with Postgres

- Familiarity with Git/GitHub and CI/CD workflows

- A product mindset — you care deeply about usability, performance, and measurable impact

- Experience collaborating cross-functionally with Product, Design, and Engineering partners

- Comfort working in ambiguous problem spaces and taking ownership to drive outcomes

Your values
- You are product-minded and user-focused, with a strong sense of quality and craftsmanship across the full stack

- You take ownership for outcomes, driving work forward end-to-end and following through on impact, not just implementation

- You hold a high bar for everything you build — how it looks, how it performs, and how it scales

- You communicate clearly and value collaboration and constructive feedback

- You balance technical excellence with delivery, adapting as priorities evolve

- You are curious and motivated to continuously learn and improve

- You thrive in a team environment and take pride in shared success

You'll get
- The opportunity to work across the full stack on meaningful product areas, including customer-facing surfaces, platform systems, and internal tools

- A collaborative, cross-functional environment with a strong Product and Design partnership

- Ownership and autonomy over impactful work spanning frontend and backend

- A thoughtful team-matching process designed to align your strengths and interests with the right product team

- Competitive compensation, benefits, and growth opportunities
