jobs.description:
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

About the Role
Our Client Success org is the reason agents stay with Luxury Presence. Client Success Managers, Client Experience Specialists, Onboarding Specialists, and Client Support Representatives are the people our customers talk to every week, and we are hiring a lot of them in Scottsdale and Austin.
This seat comes with real ownership from day one. You will run searches across our client-facing teams, and the mix shifts with what the business needs that quarter. Some months you are closing a cohort of one role. Other months you are deep on Client Success Manager or Client Experience searches. You will own a good share of that work outright, from kickoff through offer, and partner with a senior recruiter on the searches that call for it.
If you want to do full-cycle recruiting at a company hiring at real pace, and you would rather be measured on numbers than on effort, this is a strong seat.
What You'll Do
Own your searches
Run reqs full-cycle across our client-facing teams, from kickoff through offer.
Close 5 to 6 a month at or under a 30-day time to fill.
Run the intake with the hiring manager, set the bar, and hold it.
Partner across the org
Source and screen into the searches you do not own so the funnel never runs dry.
Hand a senior recruiter a slate they can work from, and stay close through the close.
Flex with the mix. The roles you carry will change quarter to quarter as hiring plans move.
Sourcing
Find client-facing talent that does not come to us through inbound, using Boolean search, LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, and local channels in Scottsdale and Austin.
Write outreach in your own voice, test what works, and keep the messages that earn replies.
Deliver 60 or more qualified sourced candidates a month across the reqs you touch.
Screening
Run 15 to 20 candidate screens a week.
Screen against what each role actually requires. Work from the hiring manager's intake and the scorecard, know what good looks like before you take the first call, and be able to defend why someone made the slate.
Submit a first slate of 5 to 6 approved candidates within 10 business days of every intake you own.
Candidate experience and process
Respond to every candidate within 24 hours and schedule the next step within 48 hours of a hiring manager decision.
Keep Lever current daily so anyone can see where a search stands.
Deliver a weekly pipeline snapshot to your hiring manager.
What We're Looking For
Skills and Experience
Full-cycle recruiting or sourcing experience, at any depth. We are just as interested in someone a few years into the craft as someone running their first reqs.
Alternatively, a track record in high-volume people work such as client success, support, onboarding, sales development, or hospitality, plus a real reason for wanting to move into recruiting.
Comfort with high volume. You have held a role where the number of conversations you had each week was the point.
Clear, quick writing. You will send a lot of outreach and a lot of candidate updates.
Familiarity with an ATS or CRM. Lever experience helps and is not required.
No degree requirement.
Attributes
Coachable. You take direct feedback, apply it the same week, and ask for help early instead of quietly stalling.
Organized. You keep 20 or more candidates in flight without dropping anyone, using a system rather than memory.
Warm and direct. Candidates remember how you treated them, including the ones who do not get an offer.
Comfortable supporting as well as owning. Some of these searches are yours and some are not, and both matter.
Adaptable. The hiring plan moves, and the roles you carry move with it.
Curious about the craft. You want to get good at recruiting, not just get through the week.
Comfortable in a hybrid seat. This role is in office three days a week in Scottsdale or Austin.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.summary: About Crexi Commercial real estate is one of the largest asset classes on earth and one of the last to go digital.
jobs.description:
About Crexi

Commercial real estate is one of the largest asset classes on earth and one of the last to go digital. Deals still get done over email threads, PDFs, and relationships nobody can search for. Crexi is the exchange betting that doesn't have to be true anymore: we're building the platform where an entire industry finds, evaluates, and closes deals, and we're betting hard on AI to get there faster than anyone thought this industry could move. There's no playbook for turning a trillion-dollar, relationship-driven industry into a modern marketplace which means the people building it get to write it.

Crexi is looking for a Senior Product Designer to join our team hybrid in Los Angeles or remote in the US.

What You'll Do:

As a Senior Product Designer, you'll own end-to-end design for features and workflows across the Crexi platform, from discovery through launch. You'll lead design work streams independently, partnering closely with Product and Engineering to deliver high-quality, usable experiences. You'll bring strong individual craft together with the judgment to make sound decisions on ambiguous problems. You’ll help contribute to and evolve Crexi's design system along the way.

- Own end-to-end design for your product area from discovery, flows, interaction, to prototype and communicate the thinking clearly to stakeholders across the company.

- Contribute to and help evolve Crexi’s component library, tokens, and patterns, keeping design and code in sync with Engineering.

- Translate strategy into shipped work, partnering closely with Product and Engineering from spec through launch and staying in the details.

- Talk to brokers, investors, owners, and tenants, run usability testing, and turn what you learn into design decisions you can defend with evidence.

- Design for the numbers that matter: activation, conversion, retention, revenue, and define what success looks like before you ship.

- Prototype with AI tools instead of just describing the experience, so a working v1 gets in front of customers fast. Then treat evaluation as a first-class deliverable

- Work with Brand, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success so what you build lands with customers and looks like one Crexi.

What You'll Need:

- 5+ years of product design experience in B2B SaaS, enterprise software, or marketplace products, with a portfolio of shipped work you can speak to end-to-end: problem, process, constraints, outcome.

- Depth in complex, data-dense products: search, maps, dashboards, workflow tools, or similar.

- Strong craft across the stack: interaction design, information architecture, and visual design, with prototyping skill in Figma and comfort reading and reasoning about front-end implementation.

- Strong grasp of model capabilities and limits, and the ability to work fluently with engineers on technical product.

- Accessibility fluency: you design to WCAG standards as a default, not a retrofit.

- Experience in CRE tech, maps, marketplaces, platforms, or other data-driven products is a plus.

- Experience designing AI or agentic product experiences in production is a plus.

- Front-end skills (HTML/CSS/React) sufficient to prototype or contribute to the component library directly is a plus.

- Bachelor's degree in Design, HCI, or a related field is a plus.

Who You Are:

- Comfortable owning ambiguous, high-impact problems and operates independently, with little day-to-day direction, caring more about the outcome than who gets credit for it.

- A research-minded designer who runs your own discovery and usability testing when needed and can separate what users say from what they do.

- AI-native: you believe AI can improve people’s day-to-day work and bring that conviction to how you design.

- Energized by ambiguity: you bring structure to it rather than wait for it.

- A clear communicator with cross-functional range, able to bring stakeholders at every level along with you.

Why Crexi?

- Real impact, fast. Join a rapidly scaling startup where your work moves the needle from day one.

- Real ownership. Equity in Crexi's growth story.

- Built for growth. A flexible team structure designed for real career discretion.

- Time is yours. Discretionary PTO - take what you need, when you need it.

- Health & Future covered. Medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k), FSA/HSA options, and Life & AD&D insurance.

- Set up right. Home-office reimbursement for remote employees.

- A winning team. A collaborative culture with team activities that bring people together.

We believe in rewarding great work — the anticipated base and bonus range for candidates in our Playa Vista, California location is $160,000 to $300,000, and that's just the starting point. You'll also be eligible for a generous equity grant, giving you real ownership in Crexi's growth and serious upside as we scale. The package offered to a successful candidate will depend on several factors, which may include, but are not limited to, the type and length of experience applicable to the role and within the industry, education, geographic location, etc. Commercial Real Estate Exchange, Inc (“Crexi”) is a multi-state employer, and this salary range may not reflect positions that work in other states.

Crexi is an EEO Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Crexi will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.description:
POSITION OVERVIEW

A rapidly expanding, entrepreneurial technology company, Alarm.com, is seeking an ambitious and talented RF/EMC Engineer. Very few small companies innovate and develop across such a broad range of technologies as Alarm.com.

The RF/EMC Engineer position is ideal for candidates who want to work hands-on with technologies such as cellular networks (LTE, Cat-M, NB-IoT, RedCap, eRedCap), WiFi, Bluetooth, LoRa and mesh/star sub-GHz networks. Opportunities include testing, validating, and certifying the performance of cutting-edge security devices, innovative sensing applications, and life-safety devices. This is a lab-focused role for an engineer who enjoys owning test execution end-to-end — from bench measurement through external certification — while contributing to the RF and EMC quality of in-house hardware designs.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Independently plan and perform RF performance and EMC pre-compliance testing in accordance with product specifications and applicable regulatory requirements (FCC, ISED, CE/RED).

- Complete RF performance measurements (e.g., TRP/TIS, conducted power/spectrum, radiated/conducted emissions) to guarantee high performance across radios.

- Evaluate, troubleshoot, and help optimize the RF performance and EMC compliance of multi-radio, in-house designed hardware.

- Own the certification workflow: prepare test samples, develop test instructions, and witness/support testing at external certification labs.

- Clearly document and analyze test results, and communicate findings to design and program teams.

- Optimize and expand our testing capabilities using AI tools and other SW tools.

- Operate independently while working with senior management to stay fully aligned with company priorities, goals, and strategies.

- Other duties as assigned.

CANDIDATE PROFILE:

- Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering or a similar technical discipline, with a background in RF and/or EMC.

- 2-3 years of hands-on experience performing RF performance and/or EMC testing and interpreting results against pass/fail criteria.

- Familiarity with different wireless communication protocols (cellular, WiFi, Bluetooth, sub-GHz).

- Experience troubleshooting RF performance issues and EMC compliance failures.

- Ability to read and understand electronic schematics.

- Experience using electrical and RF lab equipment, such as: oscilloscope, DC power analyzer, spectrum analyzer, vector network analyzer, signal generator, and cellular communication tester.

- Rigorous attention to detail with focus on robustness, scalability, and quality of products.

- Self-motivation and the discipline to thoroughly test and vet wireless devices.

- Ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

BONUS POINTS FOR:

- Familiarity with regulatory certification processes and standards (FCC, ISED, CE/RED) and preparing devices for external certification.

- Skilled in antenna impedance matching, characterization, and optimization.

- Experience scripting/automating lab tests using Python or another scripting language.

- HW engineering design experience including schematic capture, layout design, and hardware bring-up.

- Experience conducting simulation using Ansys SIwave and HFSS software.

- Master of Science degree in Electrical Engineering.

Please note that sponsorship of new applicants for employment authorization, or any other immigration-related support, is not available for this position at this time.

- Collaborate with outstanding people: We hire only the best. Our standards are high and our employees enjoy working alongside other high achievers.

- Make an immediate impact: New employees can expect to be given real responsibility for bringing new technologies to the marketplace. You are empowered to perform as soon as you join the Alarm.com team!

Alarm.com is a rapidly expanding technology company developing innovative cloud and device solutions across a wide range of cutting-edge technologies that provide a unified, connected service to millions of residential and commercial properties in the US and abroad. - 0-2 years of professional experience; internships, co-ops, research, capstone, or personal projects involving embedded or systems software are welcome in place of industry experience.

- Proficiency in C and/or C++, with an understanding of software architecture and design principles.

- Proficiency in Linux and comfort working from the command line.

- Exposure to microcontrollers or single-board computers (e.g., STM32, ESP32, Arduino, Raspberry Pi, BeagleBone) and hardware peripherals such as UART, SPI, I2C, and ADC.

- Foundational understanding of electronics and the ability to read circuit schematics.

- Experience in building Linux kernels, device drivers, kernel modules, U-Boot, etc.

- Experience with cross-compilation and build frameworks such as Yocto, Buildroot, OpenWRT, or Android.

- Functional knowledge of security standards and protocols, such as TLS/SSL, OpenSSH, ECDSA/ECDH, AES256, HMAC, SHA256.

- Experience with designing firmware for video pipeline systems, image signal processing, or streaming protocols (RTSP, H.264/H.265) is a strong plus.

- Contribute to features that connect our devices to the cloud, working with software engineers across teams.

jobs.description:
POSITION OVERVIEW

Alarm.com (NASDAQ: ALRM) is a profitable, growing SaaS and technology company driving innovation across the Internet of Things (IoT) and connected property markets. We are seeking an FP&A Analyst to join our Financial Planning & Analysis team with a primary focus on supporting Alarm.com’s Commercial portfolio, one of the company’s high-growth markets, as well as several of our emerging businesses and subsidiaries.

This role provides a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience across the full spectrum of FP&A while working directly with business leaders and senior leadership across Alarm.com and its subsidiaries. The FP&A Analyst will serve as a financial business partner, helping leaders understand performance, evaluate investments, manage resources, and make informed strategic decisions.

Unlike a role focused exclusively on budgeting or reporting, this position offers exposure to full-stack FP&A, including commission planning, deal desk and pricing support, capital and investment management, the monthly close and forecasting cycle, annual planning, and long-term strategic planning.

The ideal candidate is intellectually curious, analytical, commercially minded, and comfortable developing relationships outside of Finance. This position will report to the Manager of Financial Planning & Analysis and work closely with members of the FP&A team, subsidiary leadership teams, and senior management across the organization.

RESPONSIBILITIES

The FP&A Analyst’s primary responsibilities will include:

- Serve as an FP&A business partner supporting Alarm.com’s Commercial portfolio and select emerging businesses and subsidiaries.

- Develop a strong understanding of the underlying business, including revenue drivers, customer economics, operating costs, headcount, investments, and key performance indicators.

- Support the monthly close and forecasting cycle by analyzing financial results, identifying key drivers of performance, explaining budget and forecast variances, and updating financial outlooks.

- Build and maintain financial models supporting revenue, operating expenses, headcount, capital investments, commissions, and other key business drivers.

- Partner directly with business and subsidiary leadership to develop annual operating plans, forecasts, and long-term strategic plans.

- Support deal desk and commercial decision-making, including pricing analysis, customer economics, profitability, investment requirements, and financial tradeoffs associated with strategic opportunities.

- Assist in the development, modeling, and administration of sales commission plans and incentive programs, including evaluating performance against established targets.

- Support capital planning and investment analysis, including business cases, ROI assessments, prioritization of investments, and ongoing tracking of financial performance.

- Analyze business trends and operational KPIs to identify risks, opportunities, and areas requiring additional management attention.

- Translate financial and operational data into clear insights and actionable recommendations for business leaders and senior management.

- Partner closely with Accounting during the monthly close process to ensure financial results are accurately reflected and understood.

- Assist with strategic and ad hoc analysis across the Commercial portfolio and emerging businesses as priorities evolve.

- Continuously improve financial models, reporting, processes, and analytical tools used by FP&A and its business partners.

- Other duties as assigned

REQUIREMENTS

- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related quantitative discipline.

- 2+ years of experience in FP&A, corporate finance, accounting, investment banking, consulting, or another analytical role with highly transferable experience.

- Strong understanding of financial statements, accounting concepts, and corporate finance fundamentals.

- Experience with financial modeling, budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and KPI analysis.

- Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and the ability to efficiently analyze and organize large datasets.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to define problems, identify relevant data, develop conclusions, and translate analysis into actionable recommendations.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain financial concepts to both financial and non-financial stakeholders.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities, operate independently, and take ownership of projects from analysis through recommendation.

YOU WILL LIKELY BE A SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE IF:

- You are naturally curious about how businesses operate and want to understand the drivers behind the financial results rather than simply report the numbers.

- You enjoy working directly with business leaders and are comfortable developing relationships across different functions and levels of an organization.

- You want exposure to the full FP&A lifecycle rather than specializing in only one area of corporate finance.

- You are comfortable moving between detailed financial analysis and broader strategic business questions.

- You have strong judgment and can identify when something in the numbers does not make sense and proactively investigate it.

- You are a team player who is willing to step outside of a narrowly defined scope when the business needs support.

- You have experience with SaaS, recurring revenue, subscription-based businesses, or a strong desire to learn these business models.

- You are detail-oriented while maintaining an understanding of the broader business and strategic objectives.

- You are motivated by the opportunity to develop into a trusted financial partner to business and subsidiary leadership.

jobs.description:
Manager, Corporate Accounting & Reporting

About Us

We are a high-growth SaaS company at the forefront of innovation in the Internet of Things (IoT) space, delivering connected solutions that transform how people interact with their environments. Over the past several years, we’ve experienced steady, healthy growth and built a high-performing accounting team that plays a key role in sustaining our success.

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Accounting, the Accounting Manager supports execution of the month-end and quarter-end close across our multi-entity structure and assigned financial statement areas, compiles the monthly Flash reporting package and quarterly flux analysis, and serves as the accounting team’s day-to-day owner of our finance systems including Microsoft Dynamics GP (Great Plains), Coupa, Expensify, and Power BI, using them to standardize and automate how the team works. With a migration to a modern cloud ERP ahead, this role will be a key contributor to that implementation and the process redesign that comes with it. The Manager will combine solid technical accounting knowledge with hands-on execution, a continuous-improvement mindset, and supervisory responsibility, including supervising and developing the Senior and Staff Accountants, performing first-level review of their work under US GAAP, and escalating complex or judgmental matters to accounting leadership.

The successful candidate will thrive in a highly collaborative, team-oriented environment and bring a humble, hands-on approach to their work. This role is best suited for someone who enjoys being in the office and working closely with teammates in support of the broader team goals.

Key Responsibilities

Close Execution & Support

- Execute assigned month-end and quarter-end close activities within the timelines and quality standards set by accounting leadership.

- Administer the monthly close calendar and close checklist, distribute the calendar and monthly FX rates, and track reconciliation completion and sign-off status.

- Review consolidated unposted entries and completeness reporting in Great Plains / Management Reporter to ensure the ledger is complete before close is finalized.

Management Reporting & Analytics

- Compile and analyze recurring management reporting for assigned areas, including the monthly Flash reporting package and quarterly flux analysis, developing clear explanations of variance drivers for review and distribution to Finance leadership.

- Build and maintain reports that support Flash, flux, and other recurring management reporting.

- Prepare supporting schedules and data inputs for the corporate reporting package and for audit and external reporting requests.

Accounting Review & Oversight

- Serve as first-level reviewer of journal entries, reconciliations, and supporting schedules prepared by staff, confirming accuracy, completeness, and GAAP compliance.

- Own or review the financial statement areas assigned to this role, which may include revenue and deferred revenue, accounts receivable, inventory and cost of sales, prepaid and other assets, fixed assets and depreciation, accruals and other liabilities, intercompany activity and consolidation eliminations, payroll and benefits, and equity and stock-based compensation.

- Review complex and judgmental accounts within assigned areas such as payroll and benefits accounts including ESPP, accrued vacation, accrued incentive compensation, and accrued sales commissions.

- Prepare select corporate reconciliations, including deferred transaction costs, and administer corporate credit card fee activity with the card program team.

- Perform assigned monthly control activities within the internal control framework, including reconciliation and chart of accounts maintenance.

Accounting Systems Administration & Process Standardization

- Serve as the accounting team’s day-to-day owner and subject matter expert for core finance systems, including Microsoft Dynamics GP (Great Plains), Coupa, Expensify, and Power BI.

- Partner with IT, Finance Transformation, and Procurement on ERP configuration, data integrity, and system upgrades or enhancements, serving as the accounting workstream lead on assigned system initiatives.

- Identify, design, and implement process improvements that standardize and automate recurring accounting activities across entities, within the systems and automation roadmap set by accounting leadership.

- Document standardized procedures and system workflows, and train the accounting team on new tools and processes.

Leadership & Business Partnership

- Supervise, coach, and develop the Senior and Staff Accountants supporting assigned areas, while fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

- Serve as a day-to-day contact for cross-functional teams on systems, expense, and procure-to-pay matters, and fulfill audit requests for owned areas, escalating significant or judgmental matters to accounting leadership.

- Assume responsibility for additional or different entities and financial statement areas as assigned, as business and organizational needs evolve.

- Lead or participate in ad hoc projects and other duties, as assigned, to support evolving business priorities.

Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting; Active CPA required

- 6+ years of progressive accounting experience, including public accounting (Big Four firm preferred), close and consolidation (public company preferred)

- Strong knowledge of US GAAP, financial close, and multi-entity consolidation

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail

- Proven project management, organizational and time management skills

- Hands-on experience across a range of financial statement areas, such as revenue, receivables, inventory and cost of sales, prepaids, fixed assets, accruals, intercompany and consolidation eliminations, payroll and benefits, equity, and debt

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and hands-on experience with a major ERP; Microsoft Dynamics GP (Great Plains) and/or a modern cloud ERP such as Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations strongly preferred

- Experience improving processes through technology and automation

- Experience building management reporting and analytics, including monthly flash and quarterly flux reporting

- Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop staff

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Preferred Qualifications

- Prior work in SaaS or subscription/technology industries

- Experience with international/multi-currency consolidation

- Experience in a SOX-compliant, publicly traded environment

- Power BI report and dashboard development, or comparable BI/data visualization experience

- Experience participating in an ERP implementation or migration, system upgrade, or finance process automation initiative

Core Competencies

- Analytical Thinking – Ability to interpret complex transactions and data to make sound accounting determinations.

- Attention to Detail – Precision and accuracy in reconciliations, consolidation, and reporting.

- Leadership – Develops staff and drives accountability across the close.

- Collaboration – Works effectively across teams and communicates complex concepts clearly.

- Systems Orientation – Leverages technology to eliminate manual effort and scale accounting operations.

- Ownership Mentality – Proactively takes responsibility for deliverables and drives process improvements.

Why Join Us

This is a unique opportunity to join a high-performance finance team in a fast-growing, publicly traded SaaS & IoT leader. You’ll work on complex accounting matters, contribute to process improvements that scale with our growth, and gain exposure to cross-functional operations that directly impact our success. We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a collaborative culture where your contributions are valued.

jobs.description:
The Principal Network & Security Engineer is responsible for the management, lifecycle operations, and security of the organization’s Cisco-based networking infrastructure. This individual will be expected to lead the administration, configuration, monitoring, and ongoing optimization of core network systems and platforms, as well as apply best practices in security management. The role combines technical operational management of critical Cisco platforms with broad information security responsibilities across hybrid cloud and on-premises environments

Responsibilities:

The Engineer's primary job responsibilities include:

- Administer, monitor, and optimize Cisco portfolio infrastructure, including firewalls, identity, and network analytics platforms.

- Execute routine software/firmware upgrades, patching, and configuration updates on network and security appliances.

- Ensure effective network segmentation and secure access by configuring and enforcing network access controls.

- Manage and maintain secure remote access solutions for users and devices.

- Deploy, configure, and tune next-generation network perimeter and detection tools to ensure consistent policy enforcement.

- Oversee application delivery and web application security solutions, assisting with WAF configuration and incident response.

- Monitor network telemetry and activity for anomalous behavior or security events.

- Respond to and investigate network, security, or operational incidents in both on-premises and cloud environments.

- Support DDoS and threat protection systems, maintaining readiness and reporting suspicious activity.

- Collaborate with infrastructure and app teams to design and implement secure, compliant architectures across cloud and datacenter.

- Participate in vulnerability management processes, remediating identified exposures across managed platforms.

- Contribute to security operations, including event and log analysis, and improving detection capabilities.

- Develop and maintain infrastructure documentation, runbooks, and operational standards.

- Enable automation for repeatable network and security processes using scripting and modern tools.

- Provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior staff on security best practices and platform operations.

- Other duties as assigned

REQUIREMENTS

- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field.

- Minimum 7 years of experience with enterprise networking and security, with significant hands-on Cisco platform management.

- Strong understanding of network firewalls, perimeter defense, and intrusion detection/prevention.

- Direct experience configuring and troubleshooting network access control systems and policies.

- Familiarity with cloud platform security fundamentals (AWS, Azure, or GCP) in hybrid enterprise environments.

- Practical knowledge of software, firmware, and patch management for large-scale infrastructure.

- Proficiency in troubleshooting layer 2/3 networking, VPNs, and secure remote access solutions.

- Experience with application delivery controllers and web application security.

- Ability to analyze network/endpoint telemetry and investigate security events or performance issues.

- Demonstrated skills using scripting or automation to streamline network/security management.

- Hands-on experience supporting vulnerability management and compliance requirements.

- Excellent communication, collaboration, and mentoring skills.

- Willingness to stay current on evolving security threats and industry best practices.

Core Sales Operations & Revenue Hygiene (Primary Responsibility)

- Partner with Sales leadership to identify operational gaps, remove friction, and ensure reps can focus on selling.

Senior Accountant – Corporate Close

About Us

We are a high-growth SaaS company at the forefront of innovation in the Internet of Things (IoT) space, delivering connected solutions that transform how people interact with their environments. Over the past several years, we’ve experienced steady, healthy growth and built a high-performing accounting team that plays a key role in sustaining our success.

The Senior Accountant (Corporate Close) is a newly created role supporting the execution of the company’s month-end and quarter-end corporate close, including international accounting operations. This hands-on role prepares and reviews journal entries, account reconciliations, supporting schedules and supports foreign subsidiary close, FX translation, intercompany accounting, inventory and cost accounting, fixed assets, and equity and stock-based compensation in accordance with US GAAP.

The Senior Accountant will combine solid technical accounting knowledge with strong attention to detail and a willingness to take ownership of assigned areas of the general ledger. This position may also provide guidance or informal mentorship to staff accountants.

The successful candidate will thrive in a highly collaborative, team-oriented environment and bring a hands-on approach to their work. This role is best suited for someone who enjoys being in the office and working closely with teammates in support of the broader team goals.

Key Responsibilities

Close Execution

- Prepare journal entries including cash, payroll, leases, and accruals.

- Prepare account reconciliations and supporting schedules to meet close timelines.

- Prepare and maintain prepaid expense schedules, including monthly amortization entries and related account reconciliations.

- Ensure completeness and accuracy of assigned reconciliations each period.

- Support adherence to close calendars and quality standards.

- Investigate and resolve reconciling items and variances on a timely basis.

- Prepare recurring and standard non-recurring journal entries for the parent company and its subsidiaries.

- Work with other departments to obtain the information needed to prepare monthly and quarterly accruals.

International Accounting

- Support foreign entity accounting and foreign subsidiary month-end close.

- Assist with foreign currency (FX) translation and related reconciliations.

- Prepare and review international subsidiary intercompany reconciliations and support intercompany settlements.

- Support consolidation activities for international entities.

Inventory, Fixed Assets & Equity

- Support inventory accounting, including cost of goods sold calculations and inventory reserve analysis.

- Travel semi-annually for physical inventory counts and to meet with stakeholders.

- Maintain the fixed asset subledger, including additions, depreciation, disposals, and construction in progress transfers.

- Prepare stock-based compensation entries under ASC 718 and related equity account reconciliations.

Reporting & Controls Support

- Support monthly Flash reporting and quarterly flux analysis.

- Assist with controls activities, including reconciliation and journal entry documentation.

- Support ad hoc accounting projects and process improvements as assigned.

- Assist with internal and external audits, including preparation of necessary work papers and documentation.

- Prior work in SaaS or subscription/technology industries

- Experience in a SOX-compliant environment

- Interest in learning automation and Artificial Intelligence tools

- Attention to Detail – Precision and accuracy in reconciliations and reporting.

- Analytical Thinking – Ability to investigate variances and resolve reconciling items.

- Collaboration – Works effectively with the close team and cross-functional partners.

- Adaptability – Thrives in a fast-changing, high-growth environment.

- Ownership Mentality – Takes responsibility for assigned deliverables.

- Self-Starter – Takes initiative and moves assigned work forward with limited direction.

This position will support the Corporate Controller and assume significant ownership of the month-end and quarter-end close, consolidation, corporate reporting, and international accounting operations. This role applies judgment under US GAAP, leads and develops a team of accounting professionals, and serves as a day-to-day liaison with internal stakeholders and external auditors under the direction of the Corporate Controller. The role is focused on operational execution of the close and reporting cycle within the governance framework and timelines set by the Corporate Controller, with accountability for the quality and timeliness of consolidated reporting deliverables.

The Senior Manager will combine strong technical accounting expertise with operational excellence, people leadership and process improvement capabilities. This role requires a highly driven, technically strong accounting leader with demonstrated ability to run the close, lead teams, partner cross‑functionally and proactively identify and solve problems. The successful candidate will be capable of independently owning large portions of the accounting function and elevating matters to the Corporate Controller.

The successful candidate will thrive in a highly collaborative, team-oriented environment and bring a humble, hands-on approach to leadership. This role is best suited for someone who enjoys being in the office and working closely with teammates and cross-functional partners in support of the broader organization and team goals.

Key Responsibilities

Close Management & Consolidation

- Coordinate the month-end and quarter-end close end to end, ensuring the timelines and quality standards set by the Corporate Controller are met across all entities, including monthly and year-end close.

- Execute consolidation across domestic and international entities, including intercompany activity and cumulative translation adjustment (CTA) accounting.

- Drive global close coordination across entities and maintain the detailed close checklists and standardized close procedures established by the Corporate Controller.

- Oversee operational execution of monthly revenue and deferred revenue close procedures.

- Coordinate with the Technical Accounting team on non-routine transactions and the adoption of new accounting standards.

Corporate Reporting

- Prepare corporate reporting packages, and review and approve monthly Flash reporting and quarterly flux analysis compiled by the team.

- Coordinate quarterly US GAAP financial reporting with external auditors and internal finance teams, escalating complex or judgmental technical accounting matters to the Corporate Controller and the Technical Accounting & SEC Reporting team.

Accounting Review & Oversight

- Review journal entries, reconciliations, and supporting schedules prepared by team for accuracy, completeness, and GAAP compliance.

- Review accounting areas including payroll, cash, accruals, credit cards and expense reporting, leases, prepaids, fixed assets, construction in progress (CIP), inventory, revenue, and deferred revenue.

- Review fixed asset rollforwards, depreciation, disposals, and CIP balances, coordinating with Facilities and Operations as needed.

- Oversee international entity accounting, including foreign currency (FX) translation review, intercompany balance reconciliations, and the upload and reconciliation of international entity financials.

- Operate and monitor monthly control activities within the internal control framework established by the Corporate Controller, including reconciliation, flux analysis, and chart of accounts governance.

- Own and maintain SOX key controls for assigned processes, including documentation, testing support, and remediation of identified gaps.

Leadership & Business Partnership

- Manage and develop a team of accounting professionals, including people managers and/or individual contributors, supporting corporate close and general accounting, as part of the broader Accounting Operations organization led by the Corporate Controller, while fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

- Serve as a day-to-day accounting contact for cross-functional teams and external auditors, escalating significant or judgmental matters to the Corporate Controller.

- Contribute to and execute accounting systems and process improvement initiatives led by the Corporate Controller, providing close and reporting requirements and reviewing changes proposed by the team's systems and process owners, to enhance efficiency, scalability, and control environment maturity.

- Lead or participate in ad hoc projects and other duties, as assigned, to support evolving business priorities.

Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting; Active CPA required

- 8+ years of progressive accounting experience, including public accounting (Big Four firm preferred), close and consolidation (public company preferred)

- Strong knowledge of US GAAP, SEC reporting requirements, financial close, and multi-entity consolidation

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail

- Proven project management, organizational and time management skills

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and hands-on experience with a major ERP; Microsoft Dynamics GP (Great Plains) and/or a modern cloud ERP such as Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations strongly preferred

- Experience improving processes through technology and automation

- Demonstrated people management and team leadership experience, including prior experience managing both people managers and individual contributors

- Strong executive‑level communication skills and confidence interacting with senior leadership and auditors along with the ability to communicate complex accounting concepts clearly to both finance and non-finance stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

- Prior work in SaaS or subscription/technology industries

- Experience in a SOX-compliant, publicly traded environment

- Experience with international/multi-currency consolidation

Core Competencies

- Analytical Thinking – Ability to interpret complex transactions and data to make sound accounting determinations.

- Attention to Detail – Precision and accuracy in reconciliations, multi-currency consolidation, and reporting.

- Business Acumen – Understanding of SaaS metrics and the operational drivers behind reported results.

- Leadership – Builds and develops high-performing close and reporting teams, and drives accountability across the global close.

- Collaboration – Works effectively across Finance, Accounting, and operations functions and communicates complex concepts clearly.

- Ownership Mentality – Proactively takes responsibility for deliverables and drives process improvements.

- System Savvy – Identify opportunities to streamline, automate and improve accounting processes and systems, including assisting with ERP enhancements, system implementations and reporting tool improvements through the use of AI.

jobs.summary: The Staff Security Engineer will identify security risks within our IoT device ecosystem, communicate those risks to management, and assist with the mitigation efforts.
jobs.description:
The Staff Security Engineer will identify security risks within our IoT device ecosystem, communicate those risks to management, and assist with the mitigation efforts. This role requires hands-on experience with reverse engineering, networking, operating systems, and programming. The ideal engineer will bring these skills to bear on complex IoT security challenges. The Senior Security Engineer will also document security policies and procedures and ensure they remain up to date with applicable industry standards and compliance requirements.

Responsibilities:

The Staff Security Engineer primary job responsibilities include:

- Perform IoT penetration testing, including firmware extraction, reverse engineering, and vulnerability discovery

- Perform security research, analysis, and testing via threat modeling, vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, and/or social engineering across a wide variety of applications, platforms and systems

- Use a combination of manual and automated techniques to assess risks and circumvent security mechanisms of devices and application

- Oversee and manage the deployment, integration, and configuration of security solutions and enhancements to existing IoT infrastructure and the enterprise’s security documents

- Select and acquire additional security solutions or enhancements to existing security solutions to improve overall IoT enterprise security

- Clearly outline and document risk impacts of test findings in reports

- Test, triage, and drive remediation of security issues reported by external parties

- Actively partner with infrastructure, application, product, and other stakeholders to ensure deployed solutions minimize security and privacy risks

- Other duties as assigned

REQUIREMENTS

- B.A. or B.S. (or higher) in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering program with strong academic performance preferred

- 10+ years of information security experience, with a strong focus on offensive security, penetration testing, or vulnerability research

- Prior experience performing security testing and assessment in IoT, embedded, or firmware based environments

- Working knowledge of embedded system design and constraints (development experience a plus, but not required)

- Familiarity with using hardware debugging equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzer and other tools

- Familiarity with interface protocols such as UART, I2C, SPI, JTAG, and related tooling.

- Experience analyzing embedded Linux systems and firmware images.

- Familiarity with ARM CPU architectures with exposure to x86, RISC-V, or others as a plus

- Experience with reverse-engineering tools such as IDA Pro, Ghidra, and/or Binary Ninja

jobs.summary: Alarm.com is a rapidly expanding technology company developing innovative cloud and device solutions across a wide range of cutting-edge technologies that provide a unified, connec…
jobs.description:
Alarm.com is a rapidly expanding technology company developing innovative cloud and device solutions across a wide range of cutting-edge technologies that provide a unified, connected service to millions of residential and commercial properties in the US and abroad. We are looking for a talented and passionate Staff Embedded Software Engineer for the Device Engineering team to help us define the future of the Internet-of-Things for residential and commercial properties by creating and integrating devices that connect with our robust cloud using next-gen communication stacks. As a Staff engineer you will act as a technical leader and subject-matter expert, architecting software systems, driving technical decisions across teams, and mentoring engineers across a diverse set of technological backgrounds to design devices, build and manufacture hardware, architect and implement software, and collaborate in an agile and fast-paced environment.

Required Technical Skills:

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.

- 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong focus on native/embedded systems development. Experience developing and working with a large complex C++ codebase.

- Expert-level proficiency in C++ (C++11/14), including modern language features, templates, and memory management. Expertise in highly efficient design and implementation for (disk, RAM and compute) constrained devices.

- Experience with C++ in bare-metal and RTOS-based environments (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, ThreadX, or similar).

- Expertise in implementing large complex systems. Expertise in CMake, Makefile and other build systems. Expertise in cross-compilation.

- Expertise in threading, processes and other Linux systems knowledge. Expertise in asynchronous and messaging-based designs (e.g., protobuf/nanopb).

- Expertise in IP networking and networking software development.

- Experience in building Linux kernels, device drivers, kernel modules, U-Boot, etc.

- Experience with static and dynamic analysis tools.

- Hands-on experience with wireless communication protocols relevant to IoT and security devices, such as Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE, Zigbee, Z-Wave, 802.15.4, LoRa, or cellular (LTE-M/NB-IoT).

- Proficiency with Git and CI/CD pipelines adapted for embedded environments.

Responsibilities:

- Drive technical decision-making across teams, including evaluating trade-offs and building consensus around architectural approaches. Ability to analyze the architecture of a large existing codebase.

- Ability to analyze & architect C++ code for various use cases, such as monolithic vs modular design, static vs dynamic memory allocation, etc.

- Implementing software patterns such as state machines, event-driven design, and publish/subscribe models across large codebases.

- Drive cross-platform software design that supports multiple hardware variants or product SKUs from a shared codebase.

- Strong oral and written communication skills. Ability to create and own technical design documents, architecture decision records (ADRs), and system-level specifications.

- Skilled at translating complex technical constraints and firmware requirements into a clear set of tasks and communicating with product managers, hardware engineers, and other stakeholders.

- Ability to proactively identify systemic risks, technical debt, and architectural shortcomings, and to champion long-term remediation plans.

- Other duties as assigned.

Nice to Have:

- Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.

- Experience with porting glibc, musl or bionic.

- Experience with formal software development processes such as Agile/Scrum adapted for hardware-dependent teams.

- Functional knowledge of security standards and protocols, such as TLS/SSL, OpenSSH, ECDSA/ECDH, AES256, HMAC, SHA256.

- Experience with designing firmware for video pipeline systems, image signal processing, or streaming protocols (RTSP, H.264/H.265) is a strong plus.

- Experience with Android and AOSP.

- AI-aided design and software architecture.

- Contributions to open-source embedded projects.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager, Corporate Systems
jobs.summary: Funnel Leasing Inc., is hiring for a Technical Project Manager, Corporate Systems.
jobs.description:
Funnel Leasing Inc., is hiring for a Technical Project Manager, Corporate Systems. The Technical Project Manager, Corporate Systems is responsible for delivering the technology projects that keep Funnel’s business teams running efficiently. This role is deliberately hybrid and requires employees to work from the company’s Headquarters office in Odessa, Florida a minimum of one day per week. This person will run projects end to end and also serve as the hands-on technical resource who configures, integrates, and administers the corporate systems those projects depend on. Rather than gathering requirements and handing implementation to someone else, the Technical Project Manager owns the outcome, from discovery through configuration, testing, launch, documentation, and adoption.
Project work spans the organization and covers corporate and internal systems, with a strong emphasis on making those systems work together through native integrations, automation platforms, and vendor APIs. This role partners closely with the IT Manager on prioritization, technical standards, security, and compliance. The salary range for this role is $115,000–$135,000 per year.

Location Requirement: This role is open to candidates who currently reside in the Tampa Bay area or surrounding communities. Please note that relocation assistance or reimbursement is not available for this position.

Why Funnel?
We are a 'work from anywhere' in the U.S. SaaS company that centers our services on the renter experience. We develop amazing software that has revolutionized the #proptech industry. And did we mention we have an amazing team that is on #FunnelFire!? Oh, did we forget to tell you we have unlimited PTO, benefits that begin on your first day of employment, P.I.N.K. core values that ROCK, and our team puts the FUN in Funnel!
Who is Funnel Leasing?
Have you ever rented an apartment and wished the process could be better? At Funnel we do too. We know we need to make the process of renting an apartment as easy as purchasing socks on Amazon. We’ve created cloud-based marketing and leasing software that delivers the ultimate rental experience for everyone involved in the process. We’re in the process of transforming the real estate industry through cutting-edge technology built, sold, and supported by the most passionate people you’ll meet.
The Technical Project Manager, Corporate Systems essential roles and responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:
Roles and responsibilities
- Own corporate technology projects end to end, including intake, scoping, requirements, timeline, stakeholder communication, testing, launch, and post-implementation support.
- Serve as the primary technical resource on assigned projects, personally performing system configuration, integration, data migration, and testing work.
- Design, build, document, and maintain integrations between corporate systems using native connectors, integration and automation platforms, vendor APIs, webhooks, and file-based transfers.
- Monitor integrations and automations in production, troubleshoot failures, and build appropriate error handling and alerting.
- Partner with business teams across the organization to understand how they work, then configure and integrate the systems they rely on to improve process, productivity, and outcomes.
- Automate manual and repetitive business processes, including employee onboarding and offboarding workflows and account provisioning and deprovisioning in coordination with identity and endpoint management systems.
- Connect corporate systems to the reporting layer and build operational dashboards and reporting that business owners can rely on and maintain.
- Translate business requirements into system requirements, solution designs, and configuration plans, and run discovery and design sessions with stakeholders.
- Maintain a clear intake and prioritization process for corporate project requests, and provide regular status reporting and visibility into the corporate project portfolio.
- Evaluate technology options and recommend solutions to the IT Manager and business stakeholders, including requirements definition, vendor demos, proof of concept work, and a documented comparison of alternatives.
- Ensure changes to corporate systems follow established change management, access control, and audit requirements (SOC 2), and produce the documentation and evidence those controls require.
- Create and maintain system documentation, integration diagrams, runbooks, and administrator and end-user training materials so that solutions remain supportable after launch.
- Provide escalated technical support for the corporate systems and integrations this role implements, and partner with the IT Manager on day-to-day support coverage.
- Identify opportunities to retire redundant tools, reduce manual work, and improve business processes through better system design and automation.
- Liaise with security, DevOps, engineering, and data teams to ensure corporate solutions align with company technical standards.
- Performs other duties as assigned and modified at the manager’s discretion.
- May be expected to work irregular hours to support a distributed workforce across the United States and to complete implementation and cutover work outside of business hours.
- Create a culture of continuous improvement and learning
- Foster collaboration within team and across the company
- Performs other duties as assigned and modified at manager's discretion
- Travel: Location Requirement: Must currently reside in Tampa Bay or surrounding areas

Education, Work Experience, and Certifications
- A high school diploma or GED equivalent is required; a bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or a related field preferred.
- 3-5 years of experience in business systems, IT project management, systems administration, solutions engineering, or a similar role, ideally at a SaaS or technology company.
- Demonstrated track record of delivering system implementations or integration projects end to end while serving as both the project manager and the hands-on implementer.
- Hands-on configuration and administration experience with corporate SaaS platforms; experience with systems such as Salesforce, Jira, Notion, Rippling, and Looker is preferred.
- Experience building integrations between business systems using native connectors, integration and automation platforms, REST APIs, webhooks, or file-based data transfers.
- Working knowledge of identity and access management concepts, including SSO, role-based access, and least-privilege provisioning.
- Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to run multiple concurrent projects with competing priorities and unclear requirements.
- Excellent written communication and documentation habits; this role is expected to leave behind documentation that others can operate from.
- Ability to translate technical concepts to non-technical audiences and to translate business needs into technical solutions.
- Self-starter mindset, with attention to detail and a willingness to “roll up your sleeves” for hands-on configuration and troubleshooting.
- Track record of building trust with business stakeholders and fostering a collaborative, service-oriented culture.
- Light scripting and data skills (e.g., Python, JavaScript, SQL) used to build, debug, or maintain integrations and reporting are a nice to have.
- Experience operating in a compliance-focused environment (SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar), including change management and audit evidence practices, is a nice to have.
- Certifications such as Project Management Professional (PMP), CAPM, Scrum, ITIL, or platform administrator certifications (e.g., Salesforce Administrator) are a plus, but not required.

Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Funnel, we are committed to building a proptech company that is as diverse as the multifamily industry we serve, and that means to not only live our inclusivity, but also to support and encourage it among all of society. If you are excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.
Equal Employment Opportunity
Funnel provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals without regard to race, creed, color, citizenship, religion, national origin, age, sex, familial or marital status, pregnancy, military or veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, disability, or any other legally-protected status in accordance with applicable local, state, and federal laws, regulations, and ordinances.
Americans with Disabilities Act
Employees must be able to perform all essential job functions, with or without reasonable accommodation.
Job Responsibilities
The above statements reflect the general duties, responsibilities and competencies considered necessary to perform the essential duties and responsibilities of the job and should not be considered as a detailed description of all the work requirements of the position. Funnel may change the specific job duties with or without prior notice based on the needs of the organization.

Benefits
Employees may be eligible for various benefits. Generally, we provide employee access to:

- Health insurance
- Dental and Vision insurance
- Company paid Life/AD&D
- Long-term Disability insurance
- Short-term Disability insurance
- Term Life insurance
- Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
- Health Savings Account (HSA)
- Retirement Plan - 2% company match
- EAP

In addition to these benefits, we also offer
- Remote/Hybrid Opportunities
- Uncapped Discretionary Time off
- Sick Leave
- 14 paid holidays
- One time remote work stipend
- Employee recognition program
- Employee-led Groups (ELG’s)

We don't just use AI. We build with it, ship with it, and think with it. With a generous budget for tokens, our engineers use AI agents to write, review, and ship production code every day. We are building toward a world where humans design systems and AI builds them, and we are already far along that path.

Your customers are our own people: Customer Success, Sales, Onboarding, and fellow engineering teams. If an internal team needs a tool to move faster, automate a bottleneck, or serve our clients better, you will build it or support the architecture to make it happen.
This role requires a true “10x engineer” who leverages AI development workflows (like Claude Code and Orca) to ship high-quality code at an unprecedented pace. You will be touching everything from complex UI dashboards in React to background job processing in NestJS, and deeply integrating it with our core data ecosystem.
What You'll Do
Lead internal product development. Partner with teams across Customer Success, Sales, Onboarding, and Engineering to uncover operational bottlenecks and design intuitive, high-leverage tools that multiply their effectiveness.
Own the internal tool ecosystem. Architect and scale our internal platform (Scout) across the full stack. You'll weave together our React frontends, NestJS backends, and complex data integrations (spanning our CRM, data warehouse, and communication platforms) into a unified, reliable experience.
Accelerate delivery through AI. Integrate AI natively into your daily workflow. You will use agents to write, review, and ship production code, turning complex requirements into working software at an elite pace.
Turn ambiguity into impact. Take ownership of open-ended business challenges. You will act as both product manager and lead engineer for internal tools—scoping the true need, designing the solution, and shipping it end-to-end.
What We're Looking For
Attributes:
You are an AI-native developer. You have deep experience with AI development workflows and tools (Claude Code, Cursor). You understand how to prompt, iterate, and use AI to output 10x the impact of a traditional engineer.
You get joy from helping others. You are deeply empathetic to your internal users. You measure your success by the time you save others and the headaches you eliminate.
You are highly product-oriented. You care deeply about the how and why of software. You view your internal coworkers as your highest-priority customers, always asking if a feature actually solves their core problem before writing a line of code.
You are hungry and autonomous. You don't wait for a perfectly scoped Jira ticket. You are a problem solver who digs into the business need, proposes a technical solution, and ships it.
You think in systems. You can reason about the whole request path from UI to data, understanding how internal tooling impacts the broader platform architecture.

Extensive experience as a Senior or Staff-level full-stack engineer in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Deep expertise in TypeScript, Node.js, and React.
Experience building scalable backend services (NestJS preferred) and designing robust GraphQL APIs (code-first resolvers).
Strong database fundamentals using ORMs (Sequelize) over PostgreSQL, and experience writing integration tests against real databases.

jobs.description:
Company Overview
Evernest is a full-service real estate and property management company with a national presence and an outstanding reputation. We operate in 50+ of the nation's most investable markets and manage over 12,000 homes. We are a high-performing team, and our culture is second to none. Built on core values that drive collaboration, innovation, and the relentless pursuit of excellence, we’re not just another property management company. Our dedicated people, proprietary technology, and commitment to continuous improvement are changing an industry.
Our goal is to manage 250,000 homes by 2030, and we’re looking for driven individuals who share our vision. Join us on this exciting journey to build something great, and play a key role in shaping the future of property management, making a lasting impact on our clients and the communities we serve.
 
Position Overview
Evernest is seeking a motivated, proactive and highly organized Property Manager to oversee the day-to-day operations of a residential portfolio. The Property Manager’s primary responsibility is owner satisfaction which requires excellent communication and impeccable coordination. The role touches marketing, leasing, collections, resident relations, retention, maintenance and renovations so you will partner with Resident Services, Accounting, Leasing and Property Services to deliver best in class results. The ideal candidate should have a background in real estate, strong leadership and communication skills, and a passion for providing exceptional service. 
Responsibilities:
Provide outstanding service to our property owners.
Partner with cross functional teams and oversee day-to-day operations of residential properties including leasing, rent collection, and maintenance.
Ensure that all properties are in compliance with local, state, and federal regulations.
Partner with our Property Services team to coordinate with technicians, contractors and vendors for maintenance and repair work.
Manage budgets and financial records for the properties.
Execute portfolio level operations in line with company targets and KPIs.
Dispatch field team members to conduct inspections of properties to ensure they are in good condition and well-maintained.
Develop and implement policies and procedures to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of property management.
Stay up-to-date on local market trends and competitor activity.
Drive financial performance by maximizing NOI.
Prepare additional reports as required by the Regional Manager, Executive Director, Partners, or Owners.

Requirements: 
Bachelor's degree is preferred.
A minimum of an Active Texas Real Estate Sales License is required.
Minimum of 2 years of experience in single family or multi-family property management.
You will work daily from the Evernest office in your market.
Compensation: 
Base salary + opportunity to earn additional incentives up to 20% of your base salary if KPIs are met.
 
What You Can Look Forward To
Limitless Learning & Growth: Uncapped professional development opportunities, including weekly company-wide sessions focused on both personal and professional growth.
Comprehensive Benefits Package: Substantial health, dental, and vision coverage to keep you and your family well taken care of.
Time for yourself: Enjoy unlimited PTO, plus 8 paid company holidays — because balance matters.
Culture That Prioritizes People: Weekly company-wide Q&A sessions with our CEO and leadership team — your chance to connect, be recognized, and have your voice heard.
Innovation Starts Here: Weekly team meetings dedicated to process improvement, collaboration, and solving real challenges — your ideas. matter. 
Feedback-Driven Culture: Quarterly check-ins focused on growth, empowerment, and constructive feedback— because we want you to thrive, not just survive.
Core Values
To be considered for this position, you must connect deeply with Evernest’s company core values:

Win Together – Without sacrificing our core beliefs, we will always put the Team (our Owners, our Residents, and each other), first. Individually, we can only achieve so much; as a team, everyone can meet, and exceed their goals.

Do the Right Thing - We will always be honest with each other, our residents, and our owners. We operate a truth-based property management company with high levels of accountability, regardless of how it affects us individually or as a company. 

Own the Outcome – We will continuously strive for the best way to serve our Owners by frequently updating our processes, pushing ourselves never to be stagnant and never accepting the status quo. We are determined to revolutionize this industry.

Embrace the Grind – Beginning with just 30 houses to now almost 15,000, it has taken an extreme amount of hustle and perseverance to grow Evernest. We believe this benefits our clients because we are committed to whatever it takes to lease your home to a well-qualified tenant, collect rent, communicate effectively, and manage the day-in and day-out processes that keep you happy.

Grow Daily – Our team of professionals commits themselves to daily disciplines both inside and outside the office. The positive habits we create in life impact our company and our clients. It´s not an easy business, and there´s no substitute for disciplined habits if you want to remain successful.

Steadily is hiring a Head of Revenue Operations!

You know what it feels like when lead routing is broken, when a comp plan has an unintended incentive baked into it, or when the CRM fights the team instead of helping them. You fix those things before anyone has to ask, and you identify and pursue opportunities autonomously.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
- Own the end-to-end operational funnel across Independent and Direct, from lead creation and routing through bind and the critical first 4 months of retention.

- Design and manage lead routing logic so the right lead reaches the right agent at the right time, and keep it tuned as volume, sources, and team structure change.

- Identify where the funnel is leaking, whether that's a routing rule, a data gap, a broken handoff between teams, or a process nobody owns, and fix it.

- Ensure the team exceeds all SLAs across the funnel (speed to lead, follow up, conversion, etc…) and hold the org accountable to them.

- Act as the connective tissue between Sales, Finance, Product, and Data so growth initiatives actually ship instead of stalling at the handoff.

- Experienced: You've run revenue operations or sales operations at a fast-growing company, ideally one with multiple go-to-market channels.

- Technical: You're fluent in Salesforce administration and configuration, or you've worked closely enough with Salesforce admins to speak the language and know what's possible.

- Cross-functional: You've worked directly with Finance on commission structures and with Product/Engineering on tooling, and you know how to get both sides to a decision.

- Operational: You think in systems and processes, and you default to fixing the root cause instead of patching the symptom.

- Driven: You can own a broad, ambiguous mandate with limited oversight and figure out what matters most.

- Insurance: Medical, dental, vision, life, disability, HSA, FSA

LOCATION

Envoy protects the places the world relies on most by unifying people, spaces, and communications in one secure, integrated workplace management platform and ecosystem. From manufacturing sites and data centers to pharmaceutical labs, healthcare facilities, and corporate headquarters, Envoy makes safety, security and associated regulatory compliance something our customers can be proud of. The industry is littered with box-checking and arcane manual processes as the standard and we see our role as the company to bring experience, efficiency and simplicity everywhere. We hope this problem space excites you and we hope you're ready to come sweat the details with us – we have a lot of customers counting on us! And it certainly won't be easy.

We are looking for a Product Designer who is self-motivated, curious, and high-craft. In this role, you will own key product areas within Envoy’s platform, while collaborating with other designers who lead adjacent surfaces. You’ll partner closely with cross-functional team members, including product managers, engineers, and customer success managers to frame the problem, define the product direction, and translate the complexity of the real world into thoughtful design solutions.

- 8+ years of experience in product design, with a strong portfolio showcasing your work.

- Lead GTM for new features and products, including multi-quarter, cross-product strategies that define narrative, packaging, launch approach, and best practices.

- Rally teams across Research, Sales or Partnerships, Communications, Legal, and other partner functions to execute launches and strategic initiatives on time.

- Develop and maintain product positioning and messaging frameworks that differentiate our products in market and translate technical capabilities into customer value.

- Manage early-access testing programs, and work with sales to identify strong pilot partners and gather adopter feedback to guide product iteration prior to general availability.

What You'll Need:

- 5–8+ years of product marketing experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, marketplace, or platform businesses, with a track record of leading go-to-market for major product launches.

- Experience partnering closely with Product, Sales, and Sales Enablement teams to drive adoption and revenue outcomes.

- Strong analytical skills, with comfort setting, tracking, and reporting against adoption and activation metrics.

- Experience building competitive intelligence programs and sales enablement assets such as pitch decks and objection-handling guides.

- Strong project management skills and the ability to lead multiple concurrent launches and cross-functional initiatives on tight timelines.

- Bachelor's degree required; MBA a plus.

- Experience in commercial real estate, marketplaces, or other two-sided platform businesses is a plus.

- Experience working directly with sales leadership on territory- or segment-level go-to-market plans is a plus.
