jobs.title: Investor Real Estate Specialist
jobs.summary: COMPANY OVERVIEW Evernest is a full-service real estate and property management company with a national presence and an outstanding reputation.
jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW                                             
Evernest is a full-service real estate and property management company with a national presence and an outstanding reputation. We operate in 50+ of the nation's most investable markets and manage over 12,000 homes. We are a high-performing team, and our culture is second to none. Built on core values that drive collaboration, innovation, and the relentless pursuit of excellence, we’re not just another property management company. Our dedicated people, proprietary technology, and commitment to continuous improvement are changing an industry.
Our goal is to manage 250,000 homes by 2030, and we’re looking for driven individuals who share our vision. Join us on this exciting journey to build something great, and play a key role in shaping the future of property management, making a lasting impact on our clients and the communities we serve. 
POSITION OVERVIEW
Are you an agent who is tired of bugging your friends to let you list their house? Do you hate being a buyers agent showing houses every weekend? Do you want to do more deals that close fast with cash investors? Do you want to help investors build their portfolio of rental properties?We have what you have been looking for.This isn't your typical Real Estate Agent role. You'll have company provided buyer/seller investor leads and marketing support for your local networking efforts. This combination will help provide an opportunity that you will not find at another brokerage. We’ve already helped investors buy and sell hundreds of properties this year...and we’re just getting started! We’re building something special at Evernest which means you'll help build the go-to shop for serious individual investors.. As an agent with us, you'll have access to a whole host of services designed to provide serious investors everything they need to grow their portfolio. From handling acquisitions to rehab management, property management, and service work -- our goal is to make working with us an (almost) passive investment for investors.
What can Evernest offer you?
High quality buyer and seller leads from existing and new Evernest clients.
Errors and Omissions at no cost. 
No transaction fees, marketing fees.
Access to off market deals for buyers.
Collaboration from the existing property management team in your local market to help convert leads.
Robust CRM along with transaction support. 
Supportive and growth driven culture with a focus on personally and professionally developing you.
When you work with Evernest, you can leverage the reputation we have built amongst investors. We are driving leads through our relationships and marketing directly to you.
We reward hustle. If you want to do more deals and make more money, perfect - we want that for you too.

Our Vision
We’re Evernest, and we have a big, hairy, audacious goal to grow our business to managing 25,000 single family and small multifamily properties by the end of 2024. To get there, we're looking for a licensed agent who wants to work with investors to help them grow their rental portfolio.We have a large network of investors we work with who are actively looking to purchase investment properties. Typical clients are looking to purchase anywhere from 2 properties a year to 30 properties a month. Our property management business provides built in listing leads as well as clients looking to purchase investment properties.The ideal candidate has 1-3 years of real estate experience and has worked with investors to purchase/sell properties.We will teach you everything you need to know about working with real estate investors. From how to underwrite/analyze a property, estimate rehabs, run rental comps and learn what it takes to manage and own rental property. This is an independent contractor relationship. You can set your own hours and are free to work your own leads along with leads we provide.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Work with existing clients to source and purchase rental properties
Assist clients underwriting properties
Network with investors, agents and wholesalers to drive leads
List properties for sale
Walking properties & creating rehab scopes for properties
REQUIREMENTS
Must have an active real estate license for the market you want to work in
Able to work in G-suite and learn software systems quickly
Strong communication skills
Interest in Real Estate Investing

jobs.title: Senior Technical Solutions Consultant
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.summary: As a Senior Technical Solutions Consultant, you will be the principal technical liaison between our product, sales, and customer success teams.
jobs.description:
As a Senior Technical Solutions Consultant, you will be the principal technical liaison between our product, sales, and customer success teams. You will provide tailored solutions for clients in the commercial real estate sector, specifically focusing on the complex VTS Activate product landscape (including Activate, Activate Workplace, Activate Multifamily, CBRE Host, and CBRE Host Building). Your unique combination of property management experience and deep technical proficiency will help ensure that our clients maximize the value of our software.

** Please note that this opportunity is located in New York, NY, and requires this hire to work from our office 4 days a week. **

What Makes This Job Awesome?

- Act as the definitive subject matter expert (SME) and technical leader for the VTS Activate suite's integration landscape and partnerships, both internally and externally (e.g., Braxos, Kastle, CCure, AMAG, etc.).

- Design and deliver advanced, in-depth technical demonstrations for prospects and clients, specifically showcasing how the VTS Activate product suite solves specific challenges.

- Provide advanced technical support during the sales process, addressing complex questions and concerns about system integrations and core functionalities, serving as the technical closer for Activate deals.

- Provide support during the sales process for qualifying opportunities with hardware requirement and implementation. Provide handover details to cross-functional stakeholders to ensure smooth implementations.

- Own the solution reporting process for VTS Activate deals, including documenting deal journals and synthesizing won/loss reasons. This reporting provides critical intelligence for the Product team (feature gaps), the Sales team (competitive analysis), and the Executive team (market/product trends).

- Lead knowledge transfer and cross-functional upskilling initiatives for the Sales, Customer Success, and Services teams. This involves supporting the creation of documentation and providing semi-formal training specific to technical discovery, deep integration enablement, and complex ongoing support for the Activate product family.

- Collaborate with clients to understand their property management workflows and identify opportunities to implement our software effectively.

- Act as a bridge between customers and internal teams, providing technical feedback to influence product development.

- Partner with the sales team to develop and execute strategies for prospect engagement and client retention.

- Partner with Clients, Product and Engineering teams to help shape API roadmap through scoping capabilities for native and third-party applications.

What Makes You a Great Fit?

- Deep technical proficiency and ability to understand and communicate complex software solutions, with a strong emphasis on API integrations and technical solution delivery.

- Demonstrated expertise in the VTS Activate product suite, with a specific focus on Activate Multifamily and CBRE Host/Host Building products.

- 3+ years of relevant experience, with commercial real estate property management a plus.

- Proficiency with property management software platforms such as Angus and Building Engines.

- Proven experience creating and delivering complex software demonstrations and sales presentations.

- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and with clients.

- Proven experience working with property managers, tenants, and real estate stakeholders.

Preferred Experience

- Deep experience with VTS Activate, CBRE Host, or comparable tenant experience/access control software platforms.

- Demonstrated knowledge of access control and building management systems (e.g., Kastle, CCure, AMAG, Building Engines, MRI, etc and their integration points.

- Experience with additional property management or tenant experience software platforms.

- Knowledge of commercial real estate operational workflows, including tenant relations, maintenance, and reporting.

What VTS Values & How We Show It

- Strive for Excellence - We know your potential is unlimited. Take advantage of our executive coaches and our training and career development programs available to all employees!

- Be Customer Obsessed - We’re employee obsessed too! VTS offers competitive compensation, comprehensive health benefits (including dental and vision), pre-tax commuter benefits, and a 401(k) plan. Not to mention the fun stuff - quarterly happy hours, wellness events, clubs, and team lunches!

- Be Curious - Benefit from a culture that promotes new learning. VTS offers an education stipend to all employees!

- Move as One - We work in an open floor plan to promote cross-functional collaboration.

- Take Ownership - Be an owner of the company you’re building with our equity packages.

- Appreciate the Difference - VTS embraces and celebrates diversity. We understand the importance of a strong work-life balance. We offer a flexible PTO policy, generous family leave program, and more!

ABOUT VTS

VTS is the only AI-driven technology platform enabling intelligent real estate by unifying industry professionals, investors, and their customers at scale. In 2013, VTS revolutionized commercial real estate leasing operations with what is now VTS Lease. Today, VTS AI is the largest first-party insights and collaboration engine in the industry, transforming how strategic decisions are made and executed by the real estate industry globally.

With the VTS Platform, consisting of VTS Lease, VTS Market, VTS Activate, and VTS Data, every stakeholder in real estate is given real-time market information and workflow tools to do their job with unparalleled speed and intelligence. VTS is the global leader, with more than 60% of Class A office space in the U.S., and 13 billion square feet of office, residential, retail, and industrial space is managed through the platform worldwide. VTS is utilized by over 45,000 professionals and over 1.2 million total users each day, including industry-leading customers such as Blackstone, Brookfield Properties, LaSalle Investment Management, Hines, BXP, Oxford Properties, JLL, and CBRE.

VTS maintains offices in New York City, London, Toronto, Chicago.

To learn more about VTS and view our open roles, visit us at vts.com or follow us on Instagram (@WeAreVTS) or LinkedIn.

Pay Transparency
At VTS, we pride ourselves on articulating a clear and transparent philosophy around equitable, impartial compensation that will allow us to recruit and retain an exceptional team. The base salary is market-driven at the time of offer and is based on tier 1 market data. The base salary for this role will range between $135,000 and $165,000 and is determined by several factors, including your skills, prior relevant experience, quality of interviews, leveling, and geography. There is a bonus structure for the position that will bring the OTE (on target earnings) between $145,000 and $190,000, depending on the base salary agreed upon and achievement to goals.

EEO Guidelines

VTS embraces diversity and equal opportunity in a serious way. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. For more information about what we collect and how we use it, please refer to the Candidate Privacy Statement.

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation at any time during the recruitment process, please let us know at ta@vts.com

Privacy Policy

jobs.title: Integrations and API Support Advisor
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.summary: VTS's Lease integrations connect our platform to the property management and accounting systems - Yardi, MRI, JDE, and others - that our customers run their portfolios on.
jobs.description:
VTS's Lease integrations connect our platform to the property management and accounting systems - Yardi, MRI, JDE, and others - that our customers run their portfolios on. When those integrations are healthy, data flows automatically and customers trust what they see in VTS.

The Integrations and API Support Advisor owns the health of these integrations end-to-end - proactively monitoring for failures before customers notice them, and resolving the inbound requests that come in when something breaks or needs to change. Success in this role is simple to state and hard to deliver: every integration stays active, and customers can always rely on the integrity of the data VTS is showing them.

** Please note that this opportunity is located in New York, NY, and requires this hire to work from our office 4 days a week. **

What you can expect as an Integrations and API Support Advisor:

At VTS, you'll join the Integrations Support team as a critical layer between our customers' source systems and the VTS platform. You'll:

- Own Integration Health: Monitor active Yardi, MRI, SAP, and custom API integrations for failures, stalled syncs, and missed feeds. Proactively identify and resolve issues - such as failed nightly imports, integrations stuck in "processing," or ETL files not arriving via SFTP - before they escalate into customer-reported problems.

- Resolve Data Integrity Issues: Investigate and fix discrepancies between VTS and source systems, including mismatched square footage, missing or duplicated leases, orphaned records, incorrect rent or lease terms, and unit/space mapping errors. Trace root causes across the integration pipeline rather than just patching symptoms.

- Manage the Customer Support Queue: Respond to and resolve inbound tickets covering the full integration lifecycle - API credential and access requests, asset archiving and disposition processing, source ID/BU remapping, stacking and site plan corrections, and MRI/Yardi version upgrades and migrations.

- Partner Across Teams: Work closely with Engineering to escalate systemic integration bugs, with Account Management to keep customers informed during longer-running technical issues, and with customers' IT/PM teams directly to resolve credential, connectivity, and data-mapping issues.

- Build for Scale: Identify recurring or templated request types (e.g., monthly orphaned-lease cleanup, batch asset archiving) and work with the team to streamline or automate them, reducing manual ticket volume over time.

What makes you a great fit?

This role demands someone equally comfortable reading a support ticket and reading an API log.

- Technically Curious: You're comfortable working with APIs, credentials, SQL, and structured data (SFTP/ETL feeds, JSON/XML payloads, source ID mappings) and you're not afraid to dig into logs or ask an engineer a sharp question.

- AI-First Instinct: You reach for AI tools by default to triage tickets, draft root-cause writeups, or prototype fixes for recurring request types - not as a novelty, but because it's how you naturally work. Bonus if you can point to something you've already built (a script, an n8n flow, a Claude-based tool) that closed a gap without being asked.

- Pattern Recognition Under Volume: You move quickly through a high-volume ticket queue without treating every ticket as a one-off - you're the one who notices three "unrelated" tickets are actually the same upstream failure.

jobs.title: Senior Salesforce & Integration Engineer

jobs.summary: VTS runs a complex, high-volume revenue motion — Salesforce CPQ feeding NetSuite via middleware, with mid-contract amendments involving upsells, cross-sells, volume changes, downgr…
jobs.description:
VTS runs a complex, high-volume revenue motion — Salesforce CPQ feeding NetSuite via middleware, with mid-contract amendments involving upsells, cross-sells, volume changes, downgrades, and product churn happening continuously. The integration layer that connects these systems is functional but manual-heavy, underdocumented, and not built to scale. Furthermore, our CRM and CPQ system requires customization in order to optimize deal workflows to ensure accuracy and timely contract execution.

This is not a Salesforce admin role with a developer title. We need someone who writes clean Apex, understands how CPQ order data needs to land in an ERP, knows what good middleware design looks like, and treats release management as a professional discipline — not an afterthought.

Alongside our RevOps system team and Salesforce Architect, you'll work closely with our Finance and Sales teams. You will be one of the internal technical voice that evaluates and challenges what those partners propose — knowing when to push back when something is wrong.

** Please note that this opportunity is located in New York, NY, and requires this hire to work from our office 4 days a week. **

What you can expect as a Senior Salesforce & Integration Engineer:

 Salesforce / CPQ

- Own the technical customization and development of Salesforce — LWCs, Apex classes/triggers etc along with flows

- Manage the scaling of custom objects that drive pre/post sales teams in meeting customer needs and internal workflow management

- Write and maintain Apex triggers, classes, and flows that support Salesforce and CPQ business logic — with test classes that hit 90%+ coverage as a floor, not a ceiling

Integration Architecture & Development

- Partner with third-party implementation firms on the integration build and growth connecting Salesforce CPQ to NetSuite — be the internal technical reviewer, not just the observer

- Own the internal integration layer as it matures: field mappings, error handling, retry logic, and monitoring

- Keep business logic out of the middleware — understand why that principle matters and enforce it in design decisions

- Help define what a middleware-agnostic data model looks like and make decisions today that don't create technical debt tomorrow

- Understand how integration data feeds Revenue and Billing systems downstream — you don't need to be a rev rec expert, but you need to know what breaks when the data is wrong

- Create integrations with other tools in the overall revops stack as needed to support all business units to enhance processes and data reliability

- Understand and leverage AI (Claude Code) toolsets to increase velocity and breadth of development leveraging SF APIs and MCP

Release Management & Developer Discipline

- Own and enforce a proper release process — Gearset or Copado, Git-based version control, branching strategy, and environment management across dev, QA, UAT, and production

- Eliminate change set deployments. Full stop. If something is being deployed via change set after you join, that's a gap to fix, not a process to accept

- Write test classes that test behavior, not just coverage percentages — and hold the bar on code quality in any code you review or inherit

- Document everything you build in plain language — architecture decisions, field mappings, integration flows, known edge cases. You own this environment; your documentation should mean someone else could too

- Require the same release discipline from third-party partners — their code goes through the same pipeline, not a separate ad-hoc process

What makes you a great fit?

- Salesforce CPQ knowledge with real hands-on experience — amendment flows, product configuration, pricing rules, renewal logic. Not a generalist SF developer who has touched CPQ.

- Apex development: you write clean, testable code. Test classes are part of your practice, not something you bolt on at the end. 90%+ coverage is your floor.

- Integration experience: you understand how Salesforce data needs to be structured for ERP consumption, you've worked with middleware (Celigo, Workato, Boomi, or equivalent), and you know what a well-designed field mapping looks like

- Release management: you've used Gearset, Copado, or an equivalent Git-based deployment tool in a real environment. You understand branching strategy and can set one up, not just follow one

- NetSuite literacy: you don't need to be a NetSuite developer, but you need to understand the data model well enough to design an integration that lands correctly on the ERP side

- Awareness of where AI tooling is relevant in the Salesforce ecosystem — Agentforce, Einstein, or AI-augmented workflow automation — and where it isn't

What VTS Values & How We Show It

- Strive for Excellence - We know your potential is unlimited. Take advantage of our executive coaches and our training and career development programs available to all employees!

- Be Customer Obsessed - We’re employee obsessed too! VTS offers competitive compensation, comprehensive health benefits (including dental and vision), pre-tax commuter benefits, and a 401(k) plan. Not to mention the fun stuff - quarterly happy hours, wellness events, clubs, and team lunches!

- Be Curious - Benefit from a culture that promotes new learning. VTS offers an education stipend to all employees!

- Move as One - We work in an open floor plan to promote cross-functional collaboration.

- Take Ownership - Be an owner of the company you’re building with our equity packages.

- Appreciate the Difference - VTS embraces and celebrates diversity. We understand the importance of a strong work-life balance. We offer a flexible PTO policy, generous family leave program, and more!

ABOUT VTS

VTS is the only AI-driven technology platform enabling intelligent real estate by unifying industry professionals, investors, and their customers at scale. In 2013, VTS revolutionized commercial real estate leasing operations with what is now VTS Lease. Today, VTS AI is the largest first-party insights and collaboration engine in the industry, transforming how strategic decisions are made and executed by the real estate industry globally.

With the VTS Platform, consisting of VTS Lease, VTS Market, VTS Activate, and VTS Data, every stakeholder in real estate is given real-time market information and workflow tools to do their job with unparalleled speed and intelligence. VTS is the global leader, with more than 60% of Class A office space in the U.S., and 13 billion square feet of office, residential, retail, and industrial space is managed through the platform worldwide. VTS is utilized by over 45,000 professionals and over 1.2 million total users each day, including industry-leading customers such as Blackstone, Brookfield Properties, LaSalle Investment Management, Hines, BXP, Oxford Properties, JLL, and CBRE.

VTS maintains offices in New York City, London, Toronto, Chicago.

To learn more about VTS and view our open roles, visit us at vts.com or follow us on Instagram (@WeAreVTS) or LinkedIn.

Pay Transparency

At VTS, we pride ourselves on articulating a clear and transparent philosophy around equitable, impartial compensation that will allow us to recruit and retain an exceptional team. The base salary is market-driven at the time of offer and is based on tier 1 market data. The salary for this role will range between $150,000 and $190,000 and is determined by several factors, including your skills, prior relevant experience, quality of interviews, leveling, and geography.

EEO Guidelines

VTS embraces diversity and equal opportunity in a serious way. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be.

Why Funnel?
We are a 'work from anywhere' in the U.S. SaaS company that centers our services on the renter experience. We develop amazing software that has revolutionized the #proptech industry. Job Title: Director of Reinsurance and Capacity
Location: Kansas City Metro or Austin, TX

Steadily is an insurance technology company that specializes in rental property insurance for landlords. We’re four years old, just over 160 people, manage $20B in risk, and are intent on becoming the world’s best and largest insurer of rental properties.
We exist to deliver fast, affordable insurance and to pay claims quickly and fairly. To do that, we hire the best engineers, actuaries, sales, and service people in the country to build the experience that we’d want if we were the client.
Steadily is hiring a Director of Reinsurance and Capacity who will be responsible for laying the runway for us to continue to scale while also managing existing capacity relationships. If you thrive on complexity and lofty goals, this is the role for you. This is an opportunity to bend the growth curve of your career. You will get exposure that could take decades at more established companies. Since we only hire the best, if selected, you'll get to work alongside other team members who are as sharp as you are which will just serve to make you even sharper.

- Secure new capacity at favorable terms to enable the company to continue to scale rapidly while producing excellent loss ratios for our partners.

- Manage the day-to-day interactions and relationships with capacity partners such as reinsurance brokers, fronting carriers, carriers, reinsurers, auditors, etc.

jobs.summary: Alarm.com (ADC) is a rapidly expanding technology company developing innovative cloud and device solutions that deliver a unified, connected service to millions of residential and…
jobs.description:
Alarm.com (ADC) is a rapidly expanding technology company developing innovative cloud and device solutions that deliver a unified, connected service to millions of residential and commercial properties in the US and abroad. We are seeking a hands-on Senior Mechanical Engineer to join our hardware team in Taiwan and drive the mechanical design of connected-home devices, including video doorbells, cameras, sensors, and control modules.

This is an execution-focused senior engineering role. You will personally own the mechanical design of your products from concept through mass production — modeling, prototyping, analyzing, and validating — while working shoulder-to-shoulder with our industrial design, electrical, optical, acoustic, RF, and quality teams, and directly with our manufacturing partners across Asia in the fast-paced development cadence that defines consumer electronics.

Key Responsibilities:

-
Own your product's mechanical design end-to-end: Independently execute detailed mechanical design of consumer electronics products from concept and industrial-design intent through prototyping, validation, and mass production.

-
Design in CAD daily: Create and manage detailed part and multi-part assembly models, maintaining design intent, robust part relationships, and revision discipline (Creo strongly preferred).

-
Build mockups and prototypes: Create mockups and functional prototypes to evaluate concepts, validate fit and function, and accelerate design iteration.

-
Solve build problems with rigor: Plan and execute DOEs and engineering analysis to resolve issues found at EVT/DVT/PVT — sealing and air-tightness, gasket compression, thermal, structural, and cosmetic — and carry solutions into production.

-
Integrate dense subsystems: Package Wi-Fi/BT antennas, camera optics, IR and light guides, speakers/microphones, and thermal solutions into compact, sealed, weatherproof enclosures that meet product requirements across the full range of environmental conditions.

-
Design for manufacturing: Design parts for injection molding, over-molding, silicone (LSR), double-shot molding, die-cast metal, CNC, sheet metal, die-cut, and stamped processes; perform tolerance stack-up analysis and drive DFM/DFA/DFX resolution with vendors.

-
Prepare manufacturing documentation: Produce 2D manufacturing drawings with critical dimensions, tolerances (GD&T), materials, finishes, and colors; prepare BOMs and RFQ packages; document decisions, analyses, assumptions, and risks per team standards.

-
Support builds at the factory: Work directly with tooling vendors and ODM partners through tool bring-up, first articles, and EVT/DVT/PVT builds, including on-site support at manufacturing sites in Asia.

-
Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner closely with Industrial Design, Optics, Acoustics, EE, RF, and QE, and with supplier-quality teams on component and finish issues, to deliver a fully validated product.

Required Qualifications:

-
Bachelor's degree or above in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.

-
5+ years of hands-on mechanical design experience in consumer electronics, with demonstrated personal ownership of products from concept to mass production.

-
Proficient daily 3D CAD skills with solid assembly-management practice (Creo strongly preferred).

-
Working knowledge of designing parts for injection molding, over-molding, silicone injection molding, double-shot molding, die-cast metal, CNC, sheet metal, die-cut, and stamped processes.

-
Proven experience with tolerance stack-up analysis, GD&T, and resolving DFM/DFA/DFX feedback with tooling vendors.

-
Experience producing manufacturing-ready 2D drawings, BOMs, and clear engineering documentation.

-
Hands-on experience supporting EVT/DVT/PVT builds at Asia-based manufacturers, with willingness to travel to factory sites.

-
Self-motivated, collaborative, and effective in cross-functional teams under fast development schedules.

-
Strong communication skills with professional working proficiency in both English and Chinese.

Preferred Qualifications:

-
Direct experience developing cameras, video doorbells, or similar connected-home devices.

-
Experience with outdoor/sealed products — IP-rated enclosures, gasket and seal design, condensation and solar-load considerations, IK impact resistance.

-
Experience with thermal design for passively cooled, sealed devices.

-
Familiarity with acoustics integration (speaker/microphone sealing), camera optics, IR illumination, and light pipes.

-
Experience running DOEs for process/design problem resolution at builds.

WHY WORK FOR ALARM.COM?

- Collaborate with outstanding people: We hire only the best. Our standards are high and our employees enjoy working alongside other high achievers.

- Make an immediate impact: New employees can expect to be given real responsibility for bringing new technologies to the marketplace. You are empowered to perform as soon as you join the Alarm.com team!

- Gain well rounded experience: Alarm.com offers a diverse and dynamic environment where you will get the chance to work directly with executives and develop expertise across multiple areas of the business.

- Community and Camaraderie: One of our core values is to 'Keep It Fun,' which to us means fostering a strong sense of community. Our culture is built on collaboration and connection, where we celebrate our successes and believe that a positive, engaging environment is key to doing our best work.

COMPANY INFO

Alarm.com is the leading platform for intelligently connected properties. Millions of homeowners and businesses rely on Alarm.com's technology to secure, monitor, and manage their environments from anywhere. Our comprehensive suite of solutions—including security, video surveillance, access control, active shooter detection, intelligent automation, energy management, and wellness—is delivered exclusively through a trusted network of thousands of professional service providers and commercial integrators across North America and worldwide. Alarm.com's common stock is traded on Nasdaq under the ticker symbol ALRM. Alarm.com delivers serious security for serious people.

For more information, please visit www.alarm.com.

Alarm.com is an Equal Opportunity Employer

In connection with your application, we collect information that identifies, reasonably relates to or describes you ("Personal Information"). The categories of Personal Information that we may collect include your name, government-issued identification number(s), email address, mailing address, other contact information, emergency contact information, employment history, educational history, criminal record, and demographic information. We collect and use those categories of Personal Information about you for human resources and other business management purposes, including identifying and evaluating you as a candidate for potential or future employment or future positions, recordkeeping in relation to recruiting and hiring, conducting criminal background checks as permitted by law, conducting analytics, and ensuring compliance with applicable legal requirements and Company policies. jobs.title: Pre Sales Solutions Engineer
jobs.summary: Envoy protects the places the world relies on most by unifying people, spaces, and communications in one secure, integrated workplace management platform and ecosystem.
jobs.description:
Envoy protects the places the world relies on most by unifying people, spaces, and communications in one secure, integrated workplace management platform and ecosystem. More than 16,000 workplaces around the world trust Envoy to run secure, compliant, and connected operations across every location.

From manufacturing sites and data centers to pharmaceutical labs, healthcare facilities, and corporate headquarters, Envoy makes safety, security and associated regulatory compliance something our customers can be proud of. The industry is littered with box-checking and arcane manual processes as the standard and we see our role as the company to bring experience, efficiency and simplicity everywhere. Great experiences bring great security – it's a requirement. We hope this problem space excites you and we hope you're ready to come sweat the details with us – we have a lot of customers counting on us! And it certainly won't be easy.

Learn more at envoy.com

About the Role
The Solutions Engineering team at Envoy lives within the Customer Success organization but touches every team (sales, product, engineering, finance, etc). The team is adaptable and has the uncanny ability to pick up new skills quickly. Each day is different and involves assisting Account Executives with the pre-sales process, fielding security questions, QA’ing experimental functionality, or jumping on a call to triage and solve customer issues. The Solutions Engineering team is multifaceted at Envoy and includes elements of Sales Engineering, API Development, Support escalations, and world-class enterprise customer support. You might be a Solutions Engineer if you are technology-forward, enjoy learning new third-party SaaS products, and love playing with the latest technology to build customer trust and win deals.
This is a hybrid role requiring 4 days per week in our NYC office, Monday through Thursday. Because you support our London office, your working hours will start early. Expect a 6-7am ET start on days with EMEA coverage.
 
You will
- Partner with EMEA account executives across Mid-Market, Enterprise, and Channel to co-lead the technical side of the sale: technical demos, requirements discovery, proof-of-concept scoping, and realistic expectation-setting.

- Own security and compliance review for EMEA deals — security questionnaires, RFPs, DPAs, data residency and sub-processor questions, and direct conversations with prospect security, privacy, and legal teams.

- Work fluently across our integration ecosystem (identity providers, access control, calendar, HRIS) and speak credibly about our Developer & Integration Platform and API capabilities to customers building their own extensions.

- Investigate issues through logs and data to isolate and escalate product bugs, rather than handing them off unqualified.

- Act as the voice of the EMEA customer in roadmap discussions, and bring regional requirements — regulatory, cultural, and competitive — back to Product with enough specificity to act on.

- Level up the wider revenue team on technical topics: SAML, SCIM, OAuth, directory sync, and cloud infrastructure.

You are
- Scrappy. You find the workaround, and you know when a workaround is the wrong answer.

- A self-starter who owns projects end to end and does well on a small team where the scope isn't fully defined.

- Security-conscious. You treat our customers' data posture as something to be able to defend, not just describe.

- Genuinely interested in helping teammates get better — the team is small enough that what you learn should not stay with you.

You have
- Working knowledge of EU data protection as it shows up in enterprise deals: GDPR, DPAs, data residency and transfer mechanisms, and sub-processor disclosure. You've been in these conversations before and don't need Legal in the room for the first one.

- Comfort with identity and access: SAML, SSO, SCIM, OAuth, and directory services.

- Solid grasp of how the internet works — DNS, HTTP, TLS, certificates — and intermediate SQL knowledge to answer your own questions about customer data.

- Strong written and verbal communication with senior technical stakeholders (IT directors, CISOs, privacy counsel) and the ability to switch registers for a conversation with a developer.

- Demonstrated effectiveness working across time zones and cultural contexts.

- Willingness to travel to prospect and partner engagements, including international travel to EMEA, on a per-request basis (approximately 30% annually).

Nice to Have
- Fluent in multiple languages with the ability to conduct technical discussions and product demonstrations across diverse markets.

- Working with Tech/Alliance Partners or Channel Managers

- You have the ability to learn Ruby on Rails Active Record Query Interface

- Understanding of SAML (Security Assertion Markup Language) and Active Directory. Knowledge of SSO (Single Sign-On) access control is also a plus.

- Experience installing/configuring IT infrastructure (e.g. switches, routers, VOIP, wireless).

- Experience with badge/ID printers, physical security, and digital security cameras.

- You're excited about working in a nimble and challenging startup environment.

- You have experience with efficiently completing security reviews and RFPs using tools such as Loopio or Whistic.

- Nice to have languages and technical knowledge: Node, JavaScript, Python, Kubernetes

By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have fully read and understand the job requirements and received the Envoy Privacy Notice for applicants, which is linked here. Completing this application requires you to provide personal data, such as your name and contact information, which is mandatory for Envoy to process your application. Envoy is an EEO Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by local, state or federal law.

jobs.title: Security Engineering Manager
jobs.summary: Blend is a diverse team of problem solvers who believe that the world’s financial resources should be more accessible. Our cloud banking platform is used by Wells Fargo, U.S.
jobs.description:
Blend is a diverse team of problem solvers who believe that the world’s financial resources should be more accessible. Our cloud banking platform is used by Wells Fargo, U.S. Bank, and over 330 other financial services firms to acquire more customers, increase productivity, and deliver end-to-end digital experiences. Our software enables our customers to process an average of more than $5 billion in loans per day, making it possible for consumers to reach their financial goals faster and lead better lives. Come do work that matters.

About the role

As the manager of security engineering, you'll own the day-to-day operations of a team dedicated to the security of our product, platform, and overall software development lifecycle. You'll manage and help shape the security engineering team's roadmap, its overall hiring and expansion, and its overall technical execution. In addition to thinking of the defensive nature of our SDLC, you'll also orchestrate our red teaming capabilities and ensure we incorporate adversarial testing into our development pipeline. Aside from growing and directing the team through active and empathetic coaching, you'll also be able to focus on deep, technical work in order to help ship impactful security frameworks, methods, and tooling across the organization. You'll partner closely with the rest of the security team, as well as the broader product, platform, and infrastructure teams in order to embed security up and down the software development lifecycle.

What you’ll bring

In addition to general management ability and a proactive leadership philosophy, you should bring demonstrated web application penetration testing ability, allowing you to scope and execute assessments and threat models against a modern web stack. You should be proficient in Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, or similar in order to perform in-the-trenches pen testing work when needed. You should be able to chain findings together into a meaningful threat narrative and write up results in a way that mobilizes engineers to act. You should have strong secure coding capabilities across TypeScript/JavaScript and Go, strong fluency with Linux systems and tooling, and practical experience threat modeling using STRIDE to help guide architecture-level decisions. You should be familiar with SAST/DAST tooling and how to use their signals to drive meaningful risk reduction.

You'll also help define our approach to AI security: evaluating risks introduced by LLM-backed features, agentic systems, and MCP servers, and establishing the scalable review patterns and guardrails we need to keep our engineers shipping secure software.

Experience we value

Prior experience in financial services or another highly regulated industry is a plus. You should be comfortable making decisions at the intersections of compliance, regulatory obligations, and the mission of the business. Above all, we're looking for someone who levels-up the people around them, both technically and collaboratively, and who sees good security as the potential to improve the productivity of a company while hindering the productivity of a threat actor.

Compensation:

- Base Salary Range: $152,000 – $179,000 (This applies to full time hires. Final offer determined by multiple factors, including but not limited to function, level, geographic location, job related knowledge, skills, and experience.)

- Bonus (if applicable): Eligibility is contingent upon both company performance against established goals and achievement of individual performance objectives.

- Equity : Meaningful Restricted Stock Units in public company stock (NYSE: BLND) so you share in Blend’s long-term growth and success.

Our Benefits at a Glance

We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support your health and work-life balance.

Health & Wellbeing

- We offer medical, dental, and vision benefits, with a generous employer contribution that helps keep your medical insurance costs low.

- Company-paid life, short-term, and long-term disability coverage

- Generous PTO, holidays, and maternity/parental leave

- Employee Assistance Program (EAP): mental health, legal, childcare & eldercare, financial planning, college search, and more

- Voluntary benefits: accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity, identity theft, and legal insurance

- Monthly wellness stipend for fitness, mental health, and well-being

- Additional perks: Milk Stork, pet insurance, and paid volunteer time off

Growth & Future

- 401(k) retirement plan with company match

- Pre-tax savings: healthcare & dependent care FSAs, Limited Purpose FSA, and HSA

jobs.description:
About Ownwell:

Ownwell is building the future of property tax. We combine proprietary technology, licensed property tax professionals, and deep market expertise to lower what real estate owners pay in property taxes. From single-family rental landlords to institutional REITs, our platform provides assessment monitoring, property tax appeals, and strategic advisory services.

Our Culture

People are our superpower! Centered in everything we do is a true sense of team. We listen and we learn from each other. We are on this rocketship together and embrace a fast-paced, truly collaborative environment. We are here to win as a team and as a company.

We’ve brought together General Appraisers, Certified Public Accountants, Property Tax Consultants, Data scientists, PhDs, best-in-class customer support representatives, and more to deliver top results for our customers.

Our core values are our guiding principles in everything we do

- Customer Obsession

- Take Ownership

- Do The Right Thing

- Go Far Together

- Accelerate Innovation

Role Overview:

We're hiring a Client Success Manager who will own a portfolio of real estate investor accounts, ranging from established SFR and multifamily operators to larger institutional platforms. You'll bring deep real estate fluency to the role, but you'll also operate the way a fast-growing tech company does - data-driven, fast-moving, and closely connected to how the product itself evolves.

What You'll Do:

- Build real trust with asset managers, CFOs, and owner-operators by understanding their portfolio strategy and what's actually driving their decisions, not just their case file

- Own appeal strategy for your accounts at the county level. Know when to push, when to settle, and how to explain the why to an owner who wants more than a form letter

- Coordinate between our internal operations team, outside property tax consultants, and your clients to keep every appeal on track across your entire book, without losing the thread on any single one

- Deliver results with real candor, good or bad. Flag the properties that need a second look before they turn into a bigger problem

- Look for ways to expand the relationship: a new entity, a new market, a bigger ask. Go after them instead of waiting for renewal season

- Bring what you're seeing across your accounts back to Product, Engineering, and our property tax strategy team, helping sharpen both the tools and the tax approach the next CSM and client will use

What We're Looking For:

- Meaningful experience in real estate, proptech, property tax, or institutional account management. We care more about how well you understand this world and how fast you can operate independently in it than a specific number of years

- Fluency with real estate fundamentals: valuation methods, cap rates, NOI, occupancy trends, rent rolls, and how sophisticated investors evaluate portfolio performance

- A natural ability to earn trust with high-net-worth individuals, and to hold your own with C-suite executives and other senior decision-makers

- Comfort using data to identify opportunities and communicate value, whether that's through reporting, analysis, or client-facing presentations

- Curiosity about how technology and product decisions shape the client experience. You don't need a technical background, but you should want a voice in how we build

- None of the following are required, but they help: time at a property tax, valuation, or appeal firm; experience inside an investment platform, asset manager, or family office; or hands-on use of CRM/proptech tools

This role is perfect for someone with strong real estate or finance fundamentals who wants to apply that expertise in a technology-driven environment while helping build the future of property tax management.

Ownwell offerings

jobs.title: Senior Analytics Engineer
jobs.summary: Who We Are Digible is a privately owned and operated digital marketing company founded in 2017 with a mission to bring cutting-edge solutions to the multifamily industry.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Digible is a privately owned and operated digital marketing company founded in 2017 with a mission to bring cutting-edge solutions to the multifamily industry. We offer a full suite of digital services, alongside Fiona, our predictive analytics platform—the first of its kind.

At Digible, we take pride in our collaborative, transparent, and authentic culture. Since 2021, we've been recognized as a Top Workplace in Colorado and secured the #8 spot in the Best Places to Work Multifamily rankings. From our hiring process to our All Hands meetings and Town Halls, our values are at the core of everything we do.

We believe diversity fuels innovation, and we strive to create an inclusive environment where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work. If you're ready to do the best work of your career, we'd love to have you on the team!

Core Values

- Authenticity — The commitment to be steadfast and genuine with our actions and communication toward everyone we touch.

- Curiosity — The belief that a deep and fundamental curiosity (the "why") in our work is vital to company innovation and evolution.

- Focus — The collective will to remain completely devoted and ultimately accountable to our deliverables.

- Humility — The recognition and daily practice that "we" is always greater than "I".

- Happiness — The decision to prioritize passion and love for what we do above everything else.

The Role

Digible is looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to join our team!

Our Data team owns the platform and analytics that power Fiona and the decisions made across Digible — from ingestion, through a governed semantic layer, to the BI our ~1,000 multifamily clients and internal teams rely on. The team sits within a ~20-person technology department and partners closely with Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders.

This is a deeply hands-on role at the center of our data warehouse strategy. You'll own the Silver and Gold layers of our medallion architecture, build and govern the semantic layer that gives every metric a single, authoritative definition, and shape the BI tooling and standards our stakeholders rely on every day. Where our Data Engineers own ingestion and the Bronze layer, you own the path from modeled data to decisions — making our numbers consistent, our warehouse fast and cost-efficient, and our analytics self-serve.

You'll report to the Director of Data, partner with Data Engineering on the Bronze-to-Silver handoff, and work with analysts and business stakeholders to translate their questions into trustworthy models and metrics.

If you live in SQL and dbt, care deeply about metric integrity and warehouse performance, leverage AI to accelerate your work, and believe data quality is a product — we'd love to meet you.

You'll Love This Job If You

- Embrace Digible's core values: authenticity, curiosity, focus, humility, and happiness

- Enjoy writing production-grade SQL and dbt models, and think in terms of clean, layered, well-tested transformations

- Have experience across the modern data stack (we use dbt, Snowflake, Fivetran, Prefect) and an opinion on where it should go next

- Believe a metric should be defined once and trusted everywhere — and get satisfaction from killing metric drift and duplicate definitions

- Care about warehouse performance and cost as a first-class concern, not an afterthought

- Enjoy turning ambiguous stakeholder questions into governed, reusable data products and self-serve BI

- Use AI tools as a natural part of your engineering workflow — you see AI as an accelerator for how you build, debug, and deliver

- Have an insatiable appetite for learning and always want to be working on your craft

- Approach challenges with a customer-first mentality and curiosity

- Thrive in ambiguity, leaning on resourcefulness and customer understanding in an open and empathetic culture

- Are excited to contribute to team growth through pairing and shared learning

What You'll Do

- Drive data warehouse strategy and performance — shape our modeling standards, materialization strategy, and query performance; tune for both speed and cost; and help evaluate and execute the direction of our warehouse (Snowflake today, with alternatives under active consideration)

- Own Silver- and Gold-layer modeling in dbt — build clean, documented, tested, and governed models, and lead the effort to consolidate redundant pre-materialized views, resolve metric drift, and correct non-additive measures at risk of bad re-aggregation

- Build and govern the semantic layer — establish a single source of truth for metric definitions, eliminate divergent measure definitions across models, and keep definitions portable as our warehouse evolves

- Lead BI tooling strategy and enablement — standardize our BI stack, build governed data products, and enable trustworthy self-serve analytics

- Partner with stakeholders and analysts — translate business questions into durable models and metrics, and establish the best practices, governance standards, and tooling that let upstream teams own their domain data well without it becoming the wild west

- Troubleshoot data quality and consistency issues — drive toward root cause and long-term fixes across the transformation and consumption layers

- Contribute to platform evolution — identify opportunities to optimize, refactor, or scale our analytics infrastructure, and stay informed on developments in the modern data stack, introducing tools and processes that improve our workflows

How Success Will Be Measured

- Core metrics have a single, governed definition in the semantic layer, and metric drift and duplicate or ad-hoc definitions are measurably reduced.

- Silver and Gold models are documented, tested, and performant — with warehouse cost and query times flat or improving as data volume and client count grow.

- Analysts and business stakeholders self-serve trusted metrics through standardized BI, cutting down on one-off data pulls and disputes over what the numbers mean.

What You Should Have

- 5-7+ years of data/analytics engineering experience, including at least 2 years in a senior capacity

- Expert proficiency with SQL and data modeling tools (dbt, dataform, SQLMesh) for modeling, testing, documentation and macros and strong command of dimensional modeling and medallion/layered architectures

- Hands-on depth with at least one cloud data warehouse (Snowflake and/or BigQuery), including performance and cost optimization

- Experience with a semantic / metrics layer (e.g., dbt Semantic Layer / MetricFlow, Cube, LookML, or similar) and a track record of standardizing and governing metric definitions

- Proficiency with one or more modern BI tools (e.g., Hex, Sigma, Omni, Tableau, Looker, Metabase, Lightdash)

- Working proficiency with Python for transformation, tooling, and automation

- Strong proficiency with Git and version control practices

- Demonstrated fluency with AI-assisted development tools in your engineering workflow

- Experience working with modestly-sized, fast-paced teams

- Strong communication skills and the ability to partner across engineering, product, and business stakeholders

- Working knowledge of iterative, value-focused technical delivery

What Will Set You Apart

- Familiarity with digital marketing data or the multifamily/real estate industry

- Experience leading or contributing to a data warehouse migration (e.g., Snowflake ↔ BigQuery)

- Experience operating a semantic layer or large dbt project at scale, including metric governance and drift remediation

- Experience with BI write-back, reverse ETL, or finance-focused analytics

Physical Requirements

- Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

- Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times.

This role is open to candidates located within the United States.

While this job description outlines the core expectations of the role, it's not a full list of everything you'll do at Digible. We believe in leaning in by hitting your key goals, sharing insights, and finding new ways to elevate performance, process, and client success.

Pay, Perks and More!

- Salary Range: $140,000 to $160,000

- 4-Day Work Week (32-Hour Work Week)

- US Remote — Work From Anywhere

- Discretionary bonus

- 3 weeks PTO + Sick Leave + Bereavement

- 11 paid holidays (not counting ones that fall on a Friday)

- 401(k) + Match

- 75% Employer-Paid Health Benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision)

- Mental and Physical Wellness Reimbursement ($75/mo each)

- $1,000/year travel fund (after 3+ years)

- Paid Parental Leave

- Dog-Friendly Office

- Monthly Social Events

- Weekly lunches and snacks for in-office employees

HEADS UP! We believe in transparency throughout our hiring process. To help us ensure a great fit, we'll ask you to share a few professional references during the hiring process who can speak to your experience and skills. It’s all part of our commitment to open, honest communication and our core values: Focus, Authenticity, Humility, Curiosity, and Happiness.

Company Background:

Ownwell has developed a leading end-to-end property tax solution that is purpose-built for SFR and CRE investors, operators, and property managers. We have brought Data Science and Machine Learning to a space that is ripe for disruption. We combine a best-in-class technology stack with local market expertise to reduce expenses, increase Net Operating Income, and drive operational efficiency for both our institutional clients and individual homeowners. Ownwell’s solution ensures you have the necessary tools, resources, and information to confidently manage your property taxes.

Ownwell has been recognized both in Austin and Nationally, as a top workplace by the likes of Fortune, BuiltIn, Inc, and Best Places To Work. We are well-funded and venture-backed by some of the best investors in the world such as First Round Capital and Bessemer Venture Partners. Our customer base has grown by more than 300% year-over-year with exceptional feedback demonstrating clear product market fit. We are looking for driven and passionate team members who thrive in a collaborative, positive culture where we all win together. If this sounds like the place for you, come help us change the way everyday homeowners manage their real estate across the country.

Our Culture

People are our superpower! Centered in everything we do is a true sense of team. We listen and we learn from each other. We are on this rocketship together and embrace a fast-paced, truly collaborative environment. We are here to win as a team and as a company.

We’ve brought together General Appraisers, Certified Public Accountants, Property Tax Consultants, Data Scientists, PhDs, best-in-class customer support representatives, and more to deliver top results for our customers.

Our core values are our guiding principles in everything we do

- Customer Obsession

- Take Ownership

- Do The Right Thing

- Go Far Together

- Accelerate Innovation

Meet The Growth & Marketing Team

Ownwell’s Growth & Marketing team is the company’s growth engine. We bring in hundreds of thousands of customers through performance marketing, partnerships, lifecycle marketing, SEO, content, brand, sales, and emerging channels - working hand-in-hand with Product, Engineering, Data, Sales, and Operations to build one of the fastest-growing and most valuable property technology companies in the country.

We move quickly, obsess over results, and aren’t afraid to rethink how things have always been done. If you’re energized by solving hard problems, building from first principles, and turning ideas into execution, you’ll fit right in.

The Role:

We’re looking for a growth lead for new markets - someone who can operate as a strategic thought partner, an operator, and a builder to expand our markets.

This isn’t a traditional growth role. You’ll own some of our highest-priority initiatives, help shape strategy, and personally drive execution on the problems that matter most to the business. One day you may be building the go-to-market strategy for a new market expansion. Next, you could be working with Product, Engineering, Legal, and Operations to unlock a completely new growth opportunity.

You’ll have an unusually broad view of the company and work directly with senior leaders across nearly every function.

What you’ll do:

- Own strategic growth initiatives. Lead one of Ownwell’s most important geographic expansion efforts with full accountability for growth, customer acquisition, and business performance.

- Solve the company’s hardest cross-functional problems. Partner with Product, Engineering, Operations, Data, Sales, Finance, and Legal to identify bottlenecks, align teams, and drive business outcomes.

- Turn ambiguity into action. Break down complex problems, develop thoughtful recommendations, and execute quickly with minimal oversight.

- Act as a force multiplier. Help the VP of Growth & Marketing focus on the highest-leverage work by driving key initiatives from idea through execution.

- Build new growth opportunities. Evaluate new products, partnerships, pricing strategies, acquisition channels, operational improvements, and market expansion opportunities.

- Drive operational excellence. Establish goals, improve planning, track execution, and ensure high-priority initiatives stay on track across teams.

Who you are:

- 2–4 years of experience in strategy consulting, investment banking, private equity, venture capital, or a high-growth startup.

- Exceptionally ambitious with a strong desire to accelerate your career and take on outsized responsibility early

- A first-principles thinker who enjoys solving ambiguous, high-impact problems with creativity and rigor.

- Highly analytical with the ability to quickly structure complex problems and develop practical, data-driven solutions.

- Equally comfortable with strategy and execution - you enjoy developing the plan just as much as rolling up your sleeves to make it happen.

- A natural owner who proactively identifies opportunities, drives alignment across teams, and follows through until the work is complete.

- An outstanding communicator who can distill complex ideas, influence stakeholders, and build trust across every level of the organization.

- Highly organized and detail-oriented, capable of managing multiple high-priority initiatives without letting things fall through the cracks.

- Resourceful and resilient, with a bias toward action and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, constantly evolving environment.

- Committed to excellence and willing to make the tradeoffs required to produce exceptional work and accelerate your own growth.

- You care more about learning, ownership, and impact than title or hierarchy.

Why this role:

This is one of the highest-leverage roles at Ownwell.

You’ll work directly with executive leadership, influence company strategy, and own initiatives that materially impact growth. You’ll gain exposure to nearly every part of the business, from product and engineering to finance, operations, and marketing, and help shape how Ownwell scales over the coming years.

If your long-term ambition is to become a General Manager, founder, or CEO, there are few opportunities that offer this level of ownership, breadth, and learning.

Ownwell offerings

- Supporting parental journey. We offer up to 16 weeks of fully paid parental and bonding leave to support your journey as a new parent.

- Equity participation. Bring a founder’s mindset to grow and scale us.

- Complimentary real estate and tax consulting licensing and renewal

Base Salary Range: $120,000 – $150,000 USD annually

This range reflects Ownwell's good faith belief at the time of posting of what we are prepared to pay the successful candidate for this role. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for an annual performance bonus, a grant of stock options, and Ownwell's benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage and a 401(k) plan.

jobs.description:
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

About the Role
This role sits at the intersection of data and finance. You will be the analytical engine behind our go-to-market decisions, partnering with Sales, CS, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to forecast the business, model go-to-market efficiency, and turn data warehouse queries into insight that shapes where we invest. The ideal person has lived in both worlds, a data or analytics role and a finance or FP&A role, and moves comfortably between a SQL query and a financial model. This is a role for someone who likes hard problems, is genuinely curious about how Sales and CS drive growth, and wants their analysis to shape real decisions.
What You'll Do
GTM Planning and Reporting: Own the Sales, Marketing and CS annual and long term planning across revenue, staffing and resourcing.
Cross-functional partnership: Work closely with Sales, Marketing, CS and Analytics to align go-to-market spend and targets with the financial plan, and to model ongoing investment decisions.
Unit economics and GTM efficiency: Build and maintain models for CAC, LTV, payback, and sales and CS capacity and productivity, and use them to recommend where go-to-market spend should go.
Data and SQL analysis: Query the data warehouse directly to build datasets, validate numbers, and answer questions that mix financial and operational data.
Automation and efficiency: Automate recurring GTM reporting to speed the path from data to decision.
What We're Looking For
Skills and Experience
4+ years spanning both a data or analytics role and a finance or FP&A role, ideally at a high-growth SaaS or technology company.
Hands-on experience with go-to-market or SaaS metrics: pipeline, bookings, ARR, CAC, LTV, payback, and sales efficiency.
Expert in SQL, comfortable working directly in a data warehouse to build and validate datasets.
Advanced Excel and strong financial modeling, budgeting, and forecasting.
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Attributes
Fluent in both data and finance, comfortable moving between a SQL query and a financial model.
Genuinely curious about go-to-market and how sales and marketing drive growth.
Execution-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership over accuracy and deadlines.
AI-forward, always looking for ways to automate and sharpen the work.

- Translate product positioning, market trends, and sales intelligence into campaign concepts that actually move buyers.

- Own the campaign calendar: prioritize programs based on business impact, pipeline goals, and what's happening in the market.

- Partner tightly with sales to understand where deals get stuck, what accounts need attention, and how marketing can help move them.

- Define and own how marketing success is measured in a modern buying environment - think account engagement, pipeline influence, buyer journey progression, and revenue impact rather than traditional lead volume metrics. Work closely with Revenue Operations and GTM Engineering to build the instrumentation, attribution models, and reporting frameworks that connect campaign activity to real business outcomes.

- Oversee distribution and amplification across paid and organic channels, including paid media, SEO, email, social, content, and beyond. You don't need to pull every lever yourself, but you need to deeply understand how each works, how they interact, and how to get the most out of the agencies and partners executing against your strategy.

- Leverage AI tools to move fast - rapidly prototype campaign concepts, test messaging and creative, explore new channels and activations, and iterate without always needing to wait on resources. You'll have a creative team to work with, but you should be comfortable using AI to get to a first version, test a hypothesis, or launch something scrappy before scaling it.

- Build and leverage cross-functional relationships, including activating internal thought leaders and execs to help shape narrative, amplify campaigns, and bring the VTS point of view to market authentically.

What Makes You a Great Fit?

- 7-10 years in B2B marketing, with meaningful experience in growth marketing, demand generation, or integrated campaign strategy at a SaaS or technology company

- Have built and run a growth motion from the ground up, not just executed campaigns through channels already in place

- Have incorporated AI into how you research, write, test, and build, and are always looking for ways to move faster and get to better work.

- A strong, versatile writer: you can produce campaign copy, messaging, and content yourself across formats, not just brief someone else to do it.

- Deep understanding of the full funnel: how enterprise or mid-market buyers move from awareness to consideration to purchase, and how marketing accelerates that at every stage

- Experience working closely with sales: you've been in deal reviews, you understand the pipeline, and sales teams trust your work

- Ability to lead and hold agencies accountable across paid and organic channels; you've managed vendor relationships and know when they're performing

- Strong analytical instincts where you’ve defined your own success metrics, pulled your own data, and made decisions based on what's actually working.

- An integrated campaign thinker: you start with the audience and the insight, not the channel

- Background that includes both startup and larger company experience — you know how to move fast, own a lot, and operate without a lot of infrastructure, but you also have exposure to what good looks like at scale

What VTS Values & How We Show It

VTS is the only AI-driven technology platform enabling intelligent real estate by unifying industry professionals, investors, and their customers at scale. jobs.description:
Blend is a diverse team of problem solvers who believe that the world’s financial resources should be more accessible. Our cloud banking platform is used by Wells Fargo, U.S. Bank, and over 330 other financial services firms to acquire more customers, increase productivity, and deliver end-to-end digital experiences. Our software enables our customers to process an average of more than $5 billion in loans per day, making it possible for consumers to reach their financial goals faster and lead better lives. Come do work that matters.

As a Software Engineer at Blend, you will design, implement, and maintain the platform that powers 20% of mortgages in the US. You'll work closely with our product development team to translate customer needs into functional, scalable software — and you'll do it the modern way: with AI coding agents woven into every stage of your development lifecycle. We're an engineering organization that builds AI-first, and we're looking for early-career engineers who already work that way instinctively.

Please note this role is in-office in Raleigh, North Carolina.

How you'll contribute:

- Build features end-to-end across the stack — from responsive, accessible user interfaces to resilient, scalable back-end services.

- Use AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex daily across the software development lifecycle: planning, design, codebase analysis, implementation, testing, documentation, code review, and refactoring.

- Apply and help evolve our AI-driven development lifecycle (AIDLC) practices — spec-driven development, agentic workflows, and effective context and prompt engineering — and share what you learn with the team.

- Review, test, and harden AI-generated code to production quality. You own everything you ship, no matter who (or what) wrote the first draft.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical specifications and code.

- Work with product managers and UI/UX designers to implement new features and enhancements with a seamless, accessible user experience across devices.

- Design and develop applications that scale, with maintenance, resiliency, and robustness in mind.

- Identify and troubleshoot software defects and issues, ensuring timely resolution.

- Participate in code reviews to maintain code quality — including thoughtful review of AI-assisted contributions — and offer peer mentorship and guidance.

- Participate in the team's on-call rotation.

- Create your own story! Some of Blend's best features have come from engineering initiatives. You'll have an opportunity to propose new ideas and build features end-to-end.

Who you are:

- You have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience) with 1–3 years of experience building production software.

- You use AI to write code every day. Tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex aren't experiments for you — they're core to how you work, and you stay current as they evolve.

- You're proficient in the latest AIDLC techniques: decomposing problems into well-scoped tasks an agent can execute, writing effective specs and prompts, managing context, and critically evaluating AI output for correctness, security, and maintainability.

- You're a full-stack developer: comfortable in back-end development with languages such as Node.js, TypeScript, or Golang, and in front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern frameworks like React.

- You have experience working with databases like Postgres, MongoDB, or similar technologies.

- You're hungry to learn. You have high learning velocity, you're curious about new tools and techniques, and you treat a fast-changing toolchain as an opportunity rather than a burden.

- You're an excellent communicator who can operate independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment, driving projects to a successful outcome.

Compensation:

- Base Salary Range: $92,000 – $109,000 (This applies to full time hires. Final offer determined by multiple factors, including but not limited to function, level, geographic location, job related knowledge, skills, and experience.)

- Bonus (if applicable): Eligibility is contingent upon both company performance against established goals and achievement of individual performance objectives.

- Equity : Meaningful Restricted Stock Units in public company stock (NYSE: BLND) so you share in Blend’s long-term growth and success.

Our Benefits at a Glance

We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support your health and work-life balance.

Health & Wellbeing

- We offer medical, dental, and vision benefits, with a generous employer contribution that helps keep your medical insurance costs low.

- Company-paid life, short-term, and long-term disability coverage

- Generous PTO, holidays, and maternity/parental leave

- Employee Assistance Program (EAP): mental health, legal, childcare & eldercare, financial planning, college search, and more

- Voluntary benefits: accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity, identity theft, and legal insurance

- Monthly wellness stipend for fitness, mental health, and well-being

- Additional perks: Milk Stork, pet insurance, and paid volunteer time off

Growth & Future

- 401(k) retirement plan with company match

- Pre-tax savings: healthcare & dependent care FSAs, Limited Purpose FSA, and HSA

jobs.description:
Alarm.com is a rapidly expanding technology company developing innovative cloud and device solutions across a wide range of cutting-edge technologies that provide a unified, connected service to millions of residential and commercial properties in the US and abroad. We are looking for a talented and passionate early-career embedded software engineer to join the Device Engineering team and help us define the future of the Internet-of-Things for residential and commercial properties by creating and integrating devices including security panels, networking gateways, and video cameras. This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate to learn embedded Linux development from the ground up: you will be paired with experienced engineers, own increasingly independent pieces of real shipping firmware, and work with a team across a diverse set of technological backgrounds to design devices, build and manufacture hardware, architect and implement software, and collaborate in an agile and fast-paced environment.

Required Qualifications:

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or related field, completed or expected within the year.

- 0-2 years of professional experience; internships, co-ops, research, capstone, or personal projects involving embedded or systems software are welcome in place of industry experience.

- Proficiency in C and/or C++, with an understanding of software architecture and design principles.

- Coursework or project experience with Linux and comfort working from the command line.

- Exposure to microcontrollers or single-board computers (e.g., STM32, ESP32, Arduino, Raspberry Pi, BeagleBone) and hardware peripherals such as UART, SPI, I2C, and ADC.

- Foundational understanding of electronics and the ability to read circuit schematics.

- Familiarity with version control systems such as Git.

- Strong problem-solving skills, curiosity about how hardware and software meet, and eagerness to learn from code review and mentorship.

- Experience with cross-compilation and build frameworks such as Yocto, Buildroot, OpenWRT, or Android.

- Hands-on use of debugging tools such as JTAG, SWD, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers.

- Experience with scripting (Python, Bash), RTOS concepts, networking fundamentals, or automated testing.

Responsibilities:

- Work alongside senior engineers to develop and maintain embedded Linux applications, platform frameworks, and board support packages using C/C++.
